izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.name: XLogcatManager
izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.summary: improve LogcatManager added in Android 13 using Xposed hooks
izzyondroid:dev.agnosticapollo.xlogcatma.description:
XLogcatManager is an Android app to improve LogcatManager added in Android 13 using Xposed hooks. The app requires a rooted device to work.
 Android 13 added LogcatManager which shows a dialog when an app runs logcat command that has READ_LOGS permission before it is allowed to read system wide logs and access is only allowed for the next 60s, after which approval is required again. Access dialog will only be shown if the app is on the top, even if it has a foreground service, and access will be denied for all other background apps automatically. On previous android versions, the app only needed to be granted READ_LOGS permission once with adb or root and then could read logs whenever it wanted.
 The XLogcatManager xposed module was created to allow rooted users to not have to grant adb or root access to apps that shouldn't require it just to read logs by solving LogcatManager design issues and some bugs.
 Features 
 Allows access till next reboot to the app if users selects allow button in the allow access dialog instead of just for the next 60s.
 No 60s timeout to reshow dialog if access was (accidentally) denied by user.
 The dialog will also show for apps with foreground service instead of just top apps.
 Fixes the bugs mentioned in the issuetracker issue based on the solutions provided, but implementation is slightly different in some cases due to method hooking limitations.

fdroid:app.kryfo.name: Kryfo
fdroid:app.kryfo.summary: Private messages over Tor. No phone number, no account, no metadata trail.
fdroid:app.kryfo.description:
A private messenger. No phone number, no email, no account. You are a key
pair generated on your device. On the default route, nobody, including us,
can tie your chats to a real identity, and no one can look you up unless
you claim a public handle.
By default everything travels over Tor. Content is end to end encrypted with
the Signal protocol. Messages travel through relays, sealed so no relay can
read them, and on the default route the relays never learn your IP address
or who you are. No address book upload, ever.
Features:
* Works where Tor is blocked: Kryfo finds a way around it by itself
* Delivery through Nostr relays, so messages reach a phone that was offline
* Groups with photos, files, voice messages, replies, reactions, pins and polls
* Animated stickers that travel as a name, so no picture leaves the phone
* Search across all your chats, kept in the encrypted database
* Timed messages that burn after a set time
* Encrypted local database and encrypted backups
* App lock with PIN or biometrics, a decoy PIN that opens an empty Kryfo, and hidden chats behind a PIN of their own
* Panic wipe that removes everything, including media on disk
* A chat with the person who builds Kryfo, anonymous if you like
* 17 languages
* No analytics or telemetry
Funding: no ads, no investors. It runs on what backers give. Backing is
optional and anonymous, and every feature works the same either way.

fdroid:com.android.gpstest.osmdroid.description:
GPSTest displays real-time information for satellites in view of your device. A
vital open-source test tool for platform engineers, developers, and power users,
GPSTest can also assist users in understanding why their GPS/GNSS is or isn't
working.
Supports:
* GPS (USA Navstar)
* GLONASS (Russia)
* QZSS (Japan)
* BeiDou/COMPASS (China)
* Galileo (European Union)
* Various satellite-based augmentation systems SBAS (e.g., GAGAN, Anik F1, Galaxy 15, Inmarsat 3-F2, Inmarsat 4-F3, SES-5)
GLONASS satellites are shown as squares on the Sky view, U.S. NAVSTAR satellites
are shown as circles, Galileo and QZSS and SBAS satellites are shown as
triangles, and BeiDou satellites are shown as pentagons.
Menu options:
* Inject Time Data - Injects Time assistance data for GPS into the platform, using information from a Network Time Protocol (NTP) server provided by the device OEM using an Android API in AOSP
* Inject XTRA Data - Injects XTRA assistance data for GPS into the platform, using information from a XTRA server provided by the device OEM using an Android API in AOSP
* Clear Assist Data - Clears all assistance data used for GPS, including NTP and XTRA data provided by the device OEM
* Settings - Switch between light and dark themes, change map tile type, auto-start GPS on startup, minimum time and distance between GPS updates, keep screen on.

Lumolight is an open-source flashlight app that can perform both front and back flash. The app is designed based on the "Material You" design system and it looks stunning. The app supports both light and dark themes and supports dynamic theming.
It uses the screen as a front flash by brightening up and showing some static colors that the user chooses and it uses the flashlight for the torch mode. It has "Tile support" where you can use the front flash without even opening the app, and also adjust the brightness using the volume keys

fdroid:com.prayer_times.name: Mihrab: The Muslim Companion
fdroid:com.prayer_times.summary: Prayer times matching Diyanet, Kemenag & more to the minute. Quran, dua, qibla.
fdroid:com.prayer_times.description:
Prayer times that match the published timetable to the printed minute: Diyanet’s in Türkiye and worldwide, Islamiska Förbundet’s in Sweden, and those of Morocco’s Ministry of Habous, Algeria’s Ministry of Religious Affairs and Indonesia’s Kemenag.
Each authority’s own method is calculated on your phone and checked, day by day, against its published timetables: 0 of 77.6 million times off the printed minute, last checked 17 November 2026.
Singapore (MUIS), Malaysia (JAKIM) and Türkiye Takvimi are their published tables, used as printed. Everywhere else, times come from AlAdhan or a calculation method you choose, with per-prayer offsets to match your mosque.
Around the prayers, Mihrab is a calm companion for a Muslim’s day: the Quran, and the remembrance in between, with no ads and no account.
PRAY
- Today, the week and the month ahead — shareable as an image or a PDF
- The adhan for each prayer, from built-in recordings or your own, a reminder before it, and a snooze that offers only what the prayer’s time still allows
- A full-screen prayer alert over the lock screen, like an alarm clock, with Stop, Snooze and Log prayer
- Silence the phone for the prayer itself and let it come back on its own, with its own length for Jumu'ah
- A pinned countdown to the next prayer on the lock screen and in the notification shade
- Minimal: only the sky and the countdown on Today, and the day's times a swipe away
- Hanafi or standard Asr, and a minute offset for each prayer
- Qibla compass with signal strength and a cross-check against the sun
- Log each prayer with one tap; the journal keeps the record, the streak and the graph
- Home-screen widgets for the prayer times, today's log, the Hijri date, tasbih and reading
READ AND LISTEN
- The Madinah mushaf, drawn as text from the King Fahd Complex's page fonts and sharp at any size — Warsh, Qalun, Shu'bah and the 15-line IndoPak print beside it
- Tajweed colours, every rule explained — on Hafs and on Warsh
- The word reader: hold a word to hear it read on its own
- A choice of reciters, and for those with word timings, the recited word lit on the page
- Tilawah: surah into surah with the screen off, with a sleep timer
- Translations and classical tafsir, kept for offline reading
- Hifz: what you know by heart, revised on its own cycle; drills, bookmarks, khatmah plans
REMEMBER
- Duas from Hisn al-Muslim, with transliteration and translation
- A tasbih counter for the dhikr after prayer and beyond
- A fasting log for Ramadan and the Sunnah fasts, with reminders
- The Hijri calendar with Ramadan, Eid and Jumu'ah
YOURS
- No ads, no analytics, no trackers, no account
- Sync between your own devices with no account and no server of ours: sealed files in a folder you already keep in sync
- Backup and restore to a file you keep
- Android, iPhone, iPad and Mac, with Arabic and Urdu fully right-to-left
WHAT GOES OVER THE NETWORK
Where your times come from decides what is sent. For Sweden, Diyanet’s places, Morocco, Algeria and Indonesia the times are calculated on the phone and no prayer-time request is made. Elsewhere, AlAdhan (api.aladhan.com) receives your coordinates and the date. Malaysia’s and Singapore’s tables come from Mihrab’s GitHub repository by city, with the authority’s own service as a backup; Türkiye Takvimi by a map tile around you, and namazvakti.com only a city’s number. With automatic location, your city’s name is looked up from your coordinates through OpenStreetMap Nominatim; place search sends what you type. The app checks Mihrab’s GitHub repositories for correction-list and Hijri-date updates, and downloads Quran pages, translations, tafsir and recitation when you ask. Nothing is sent to the developer.
Mihrab is independent. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Diyanet, Islamiska Förbundet, the Moroccan or Algerian ministries, Kemenag, MUIS, JAKIM or Türkiye Takvimi: it matches their published timetables and does not speak for them. Open source under AGPL-3.0-or-later.

Your trusty companion for every game night – simple, ad-free, free!
Sound familiar? You want to start game night, but you don't have the right die, there's an argument about who goes first, and keeping score on paper is a hassle? Boardgame Pal solves all of these problems in a single, minimalist app.

fdroid:fr.hellpc.mirror.description:
Mirror is a multi-protocol mirror-type backup application for Android.
Designed to be simpler and lighter than synchronization software, it allows you to use your own infrastructure rather than third-party cloud services.
You can configure multiple backups as follows:
- Select a source directory
- Select a destination directory
- Choose filtering options (optional)
- Configure automatic scheduling (optional)
Mirror will analyze the contents of both directories, compare them and reproduce the structure of the source directory (subdirectories and files) in the destination directory, respecting the filtering options you have chosen.
The source and destination can be located on:
- Your device's internal or external storage
- An NFS share
- An SMB share
- An FTP or FTPS server
- An SFTP server
- A WebDAV server
 SECURITY & PRIVACY 
- Local Storage: Sensitive information is encrypted (AES-GCM + Android KeyStore) and stored locally on your device using a Room database.
- No Tracking: This application does not contain any analytics, trackers, advertising or proprietary software development kits (SDKs).
- Open Source: Mirror is an independent project. The source code is available on GitHub for transparency and audit.
fdroid:fr.hellpc.mirror.category: Cloud Storage & File Sync, File Transfer, System

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlycircuit.description:
Privacy Friendly Circuit Trainer is an Android App that supports the user during their circuit training session. It provides a configurable set of timers for the exercises and the rest phases as well as multiple other features.
Workout Timer
After configuring the set of timers in the main menu you can start the workout routine by pressing the start button. The workout view has animations and sound output features which can be turned on and off inside the settings menu.
Motivation Alert
The app can show you motivation alerts to remind you of planned workout sessions. You can define the time of day and the notification texts inside the settings menu.
Block Periodization
When scheduling the timers you may also choose the block periodization feature. This feature allows you to configure longer, separate breaks in between the exercises. This way the workout can be split into multiple high intensity workout cycles.
Workout History
The app can collect statistics about your performed workout sessions. The collected data comprises of the time spend working out and the calories burnt while exercising. The accuracy of the calories calculation can be improved by configuring the necessary user data in the settings menu. The collection of this data can be deleted as well as turned on and off inside the settings menu.
Exercise Sets
The app allows you to create your own Exercise Sets for the circuit training. Therefore you can combine your own exercises to exercise sets. The image assigned to an exercise is displayed during the workout. In addition, the exercise sets can be repeated during a workout. For this you can set the number of rounds before starting the workout.
How does Privacy Friendly Circuit Trainer differ from other similar apps?
1. No permissions
Privacy Friendly Circuit Trainer does not require any permissions. The selection of images is done by a task to the gallery so the app does not have any access to the device's storage without the user's control and interaction.
2. No advertisement
Many other free apps in the Google Play Store dazzle annoying advertising and also shortens battery life.
Privacy Friendly Circuit Training is part of the Privacy Friendly Apps group developed by the research group SECUSO at Technische Universität Darmstadt. More information at: https://secuso.org/pfa

Cairn is a private personal finance app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It reads the bank accounts you authorize through SimpleFIN, then does everything else on your device.
NO ACCOUNT. NO SERVER. NO TRACKING.
NO CAIRN ACCOUNT. NO CAIRN BACKEND. NO TRACKING.

Cairn is free: it has no subscription, account, or service fee. Automatic bank sync requires your own SimpleFIN Bridge account, a separate paid service billed by SimpleFIN—not Cairn. Cairn can identify transfers between your accounts, but it never moves money.
Thank you to SimpleFIN for the Bridge service and SimpleFIN protocol that make direct, read-only bank connections possible. Cairn is not affiliated with SimpleFIN or any financial institution.
KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
• See accounts, balances, and transactions, with net worth kept separate per currency.
• Net-worth history that builds from your own data.
• Investments and holdings, with cost basis and gain.
CATEGORIZE YOUR OWN WAY
• Write your own rules to categorize transactions by description or amount.
• Add free-form tags and notes to any transaction.
• Automation always yields to you: a category you set by hand is never overwritten.
• Everything is enriched on your device.
FIND SUBSCRIPTIONS AUTOMATICALLY
• Cairn spots subscriptions and other regular payments, and shows the expected next charge.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Financial fields are end-to-end encrypted in iCloud, independent of Advanced Data Protection — Apple stores the record, not the amount.
• Your SimpleFIN credential lives in the Keychain, never in the database or logs.
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID app lock.
• Export everything to CSV or JSON, or delete it all.
REQUIRES SIMPLEFIN
Cairn connects to SimpleFIN Bridge or a bank-hosted SimpleFIN server. It is read-only: Cairn can reconcile money between your accounts, but it never moves money.
Cairn is open source under Apache-2.0. Cairn is not affiliated with SimpleFIN or any financial institution.

A bloody path behind you
 In the world of Chuckle Express you are the driver of a train commissioned by logistics company. They have built their private tracks everywhere these days and your job is to move whatever is necessary for the society to expand. It's important work for well respected workers. But you might be one of the notorious slackers that are late all the time. If there wouldn't be all these people around you crossing the tracks in front of your train, you wouldn't need to brake and your boss might hate you a little less. Blessed be the day the brakes fell off, giving you nothing but a chuckle while the train keeps rolling...
 Gameplay:
 As train driver you are able to steer the train across the rails built into the world to find a path to the next station for your requested charges. At times it might be helpful to jump from one rail to another to shorten the time your boss is waiting. Also other trains might be just ahead. So keep your head up.
 It's a classical endless-runner that offers you to beat current high scores as in other arcade games. However the high score to beat comes with a twist.
 Cross-Platform:
 The game can be played with keyboard, mouse, touchscreen or gamepad. It is explicitly implemented to be playable across a wide range of display resolutions and input devices. You generally only control the train to the left or right while it rolls ahead.
 Mature Content Description
 The developers describe the content like this:
 The game is using stylistic art to display a lot of violence containing blood in cases trains collide with people, barriers or other trains. Players can dodge these obstacles if preferred. It's up for the player to decide which track they choose... think of it like the trolley problem in a very graphical form.

flathub:me.njean.shootingpactris.name: Shooting Pactris
flathub:me.njean.shootingpactris.summary: A coop retro game with Tetris, Pacman and shmup gameplay.
flathub:me.njean.shootingpactris.description:
A fun cooperation multiplayer game which mixes universes of
 Pacman, Tetris and shoot’em up (shmup) games.
 The player(s) move around Pacman and the ship. They must
 cooperate to control falling tetris pieces which shoot at the ship,
 while ghosts follow Pacman in a maze!
 It can be played on a same machine with the keyboard or with game pads.
 A network option is also made available.

flathub:net.blockattack.game.name: Block Attack - Rise of the Blocks
flathub:net.blockattack.game.description:
This a puzzle/blockfall game inspired by Nintendo’s Tetris Attack (or “Panel de Pon”) for the
 Super Nintendo. It might seem like any other match-3 style game but it is generally much faster.
 The game requires fast decisions compared to other puzzle games. While you can setup the perfect
 chain it is much more likely that you will construct chains while blocks are still dropping around
 you.
 In addition to traditional game types like endless, time trial and stage clear the game does
 also feature a VS-mode. The VS mode is a dual like you rarely see in a puzzle game.
 The game can be played with keyboard, gamepad or mouse. Keyboard or gamepad are strongly recommended.
 The game allows two players to compete on the same machine.

flathub:net.blockbench.Blockbench.name: Blockbench
flathub:net.blockbench.Blockbench.description:
Blockbench is a free, modern model editor for low-poly and boxy
 models with pixel art textures. Models can be exported into
 standardized formats, to be shared, rendered, 3D-printed, or used
 in game engines. There are also multiple dedicated formats for
 Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition with format-specific features.
 Blockbench features a modern and intuitive UI, plugin support and
 innovative features. It is the industry standard for creating
 custom 3D models for the Minecraft Marketplace.

flathub:org.dupot.littleescape.name: Little Escape
flathub:org.dupot.littleescape.summary: Escape from the flat by solving its puzzles
flathub:org.dupot.littleescape.description:
You are locked in a small flat: search the bedroom, the bathroom, the living room and the kitchen
 to find clues, keys and secret codes, and open the exit door
 Explore in first person with the keyboard, a gamepad or the touch controls. Available in English
 and French
 This Game was made with Godot 4.7

flathub:org.kde.kfind.name: KFind
flathub:org.kde.kfind.description:
KFind can be used as a standalone search tool, launched by KRunner or from your menu. It is
 also integrated into Dolphin as "Open KFind" in the "Tools" menu. It allows you to find files by
 name, type or content.

flathub:org.kde.killbots.name: Killbots
flathub:org.kde.killbots.summary: Outsmart the killer robots to win
flathub:org.kde.killbots.description:
How will you get away from the killer robots bent on destruction? Figure it out in this simple,
 entertaining game. You may be outnumbered by an endless stream of robots, but with your intelligence
 and handy teleportation device you can defeat them. Outsmart all of the killer robots to win and
 live to tell the tale!

flathub:org.skaven.ratic.name: Ratic
flathub:org.skaven.ratic.description:
Offline music player with lots of features.
 Support most music file types
 Entirely offline
 Fully responsive while loading a library
 Sort and group by album, artist, full-text searching
 Dynamic blurred background with light/dark modes
 Music queue with several play modes
 Supports M3U playlists
 Supports MPRIS controls

fedora-packages:cyrus-imapd/cyrus-imapd.description: The Cyrus IMAP (Internet Message Access Protocol) server provides access to personal mail, system-wide bulletin boards, news-feeds, calendar and contacts through the IMAP, JMAP, NNTP, CalDAV and CardDAV protocols. The Cyrus IMAP server is a scalable enterprise groupware system designed for use from small to large enterprise environments using technologies based on well-established Open Standards. A full Cyrus IMAP implementation allows a seamless mail and bulletin board environment to be set up across one or more nodes. It differs from other IMAP server implementations in that it is run on sealed nodes, where users are not normally permitted to log in. The mailbox database is stored in parts of the filesystem that are private to the Cyrus IMAP system. All user access to mail is through software using the IMAP, IMAPS, JMAP, POP3, POP3S, KPOP, CalDAV and/or CardDAV protocols. The private mailbox database design gives the Cyrus IMAP server large advantages in efficiency, scalability, and administrability. Multiple concurrent read/write connections to the same mailbox are permitted. The server supports access control lists on mailboxes and storage quotas on mailbox hierarchies.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension that converts footnote references and definitions to HTML footnotes.

fedora-packages:ghc-HTTP/ghc-HTTP.name: ghc-HTTP
fedora-packages:ghc-HTTP/ghc-HTTP.description: The HTTP package supports client-side web programming in Haskell. It lets you set up HTTP connections, transmitting requests and processing the responses coming back, all from within the comforts of Haskell. It's dependent on the network package to operate, but other than that, the implementation is all written in Haskell. A basic API for issuing single HTTP requests + receiving responses is provided. On top of that, a session-level abstraction is also on offer (the 'BrowserAction' monad); it taking care of handling the management of persistent connections, proxies, state (cookies) and authentication credentials required to handle multi-step interactions with a web server. The representation of the bytes flowing across is extensible via the use of a type class, letting you pick the representation of requests and responses that best fits your use. Some pre-packaged, common instances are provided for 'ByteString' and 'String'.

firefox-addons:2710143.name: Privacy Focused Website Blocker (by Avrodh.com)
firefox-addons:2710143.summary: Website blocker with a focus on privacy. Block unlimited websites with schedules, password protection, and custom blocked pages
firefox-addons:2710143.description:
Privacy Focused Website Blocker (by Avrodh.com )
It installs without any extra permissions. For any site you want to block, we explicitly ask for permission for that website. The extension will only have access to websites you want to block. It does not track user behaviour nor use any analytics software. We do not share or send your lists, schedules, or how you are using various features that the extension provides.
✪ FEATURES ✪
In "Privacy Focused Website Blocker (by Avrodh.com )", you can manage multiple website-blocking lists, each of which can be enabled or disabled independently. This allows for customized control over website access with specific rules for each list.
★ Creating and Managing Lists ★
You can create various lists to handle different websites, with each list being independently enabled or disabled.
★ Custom Schedules ★
Set custom schedules for each list to specify the exact days and times when it is active. You can also configure a list to allow access to websites for a defined duration per hour or per day.
★ Website Blocking ★
On a per-list basis, you can choose to block websites or redirect them to other sites. For example, you might block https://example.com during the morning hours or redirect https://explicit.website to https://safe.website.
★ Customizable Blocked Pages ★
Customize the appearance of blocked pages with different images, text, and colors.
★ Password Protection ★
Settings can only be modified after entering a valid password, providing an added layer of security.
★ Import/Export Feature ★
Manage backups of your lists and settings efficiently through the Import/Export feature.
✪ CHANGELOG ✪

firefox-addons:3004700.name: Mira Translator – Web Translation & Vocabulary
firefox-addons:3004700.summary: Web, PDF, EPUB & YouTube/X subtitle translation, plus AI translation, sentence analysis, vocabulary tools and cross-device sync.
firefox-addons:3004700.description:
【Translation Services】
Built-in basic translation is available without configuring an API key. Free AI translation is not provided. To use AI features, you must obtain and configure your own API key from a third-party provider. Any related costs are your responsibility.
【Webpage, Document, and Video Translation】
• Immersive webpage translation with customizable page regions.
• PDF translation: Supports text-based PDFs and preserves mathematical formulas and symbols during translation, making it useful for academic papers, technical documents, and other specialized materials. Scanned and image-based PDFs are not supported.
• EPUB translation: Read and translate ebooks in other languages.
• YouTube and X (Twitter) video subtitle translation with bilingual subtitle display.
• Generate and translate subtitles for YouTube and X videos without captions using AI speech recognition.
• YouTube subtitle preview in real time and subtitle downloads. You can also look up and save words directly from subtitles.
【AI Translation and Learning Support】
• Supports compatible AI models and third-party translation services, with customizable API endpoints.
• Context-aware translation: Uses surrounding context to better understand meaning, reduce awkward literal translations, and produce more natural results.
• Custom AI translation styles: Set different translation styles for individual websites. For example, use lively, natural wording for entertainment content and precise, rigorous wording for study materials and professional documents.
• AI sentence analysis: Breaks down sentence structure, grammar, and expressions to help you understand sentences and learn languages.
• AI test generation: Creates personalized exercises and tests based on words saved in your vocabulary list, helping you check your progress and reinforce what you have learned.
• AI image recognition and translation: Send webpage images to your selected AI service to recognize and translate the text they contain.
【Language Learning Tools】
• Vocabulary list: Save words and sentences in various ways and manage your personal learning materials in one place.
• Vocabulary highlighting: Automatically highlight saved words on webpages and in YouTube subtitles.
• Daily review cards: Review words from your vocabulary list with daily cards to reinforce memory.
• Vocabulary tests: Test yourself on words saved in your vocabulary list.
• Glossary: Add specialized terms and fixed translation rules to keep terminology consistent in specialized content.
• Glossary highlighting: Automatically identify and highlight glossary terms on webpages.
【Website Settings and Translation Engines】
• Set global default translation settings to apply across websites.
• Turn automatic translation for the current website on or off directly from the extension popup. Your choice is remembered for each website.
• Manage translation behavior for the current website without manually entering URLs or opening a separate settings page.
• Use the smart selector to choose which webpage elements should be translated.
• Configure translation engines independently for different tasks, including webpage translation, text selection, video subtitles, instant translation, and quick input. Combine different translation services to suit your needs.
【Quick Translation Tools】
• Hover translation: On desktop, hover over a paragraph or word and use a keyboard shortcut to translate it.
• Input field translation: Translate text directly in webpage input fields without copying and pasting.
• Quick translation window: Open a translation window on any webpage with a keyboard shortcut, so you can enter and translate text without leaving the current page.
• Smart caching: Save and reuse translation results for different translation engines to reduce repeated requests. Cached AI translations can also be reused by traditional machine translation engines (NMT).
【Cross-Device and Cross-Browser Sync】
Use your own WebDAV, Google Drive, or OneDrive account to sync your vocabulary list, glossary, and related settings in both directions across devices and supported browsers.
Save words on your computer and sync them to your phone, or save words on your phone and sync them back to your computer for easy access, learning, and review.
Sync data is transferred directly through your selected cloud service using your own account. It does not pass through Mira Translator's servers.
【Privacy】
This extension does not collect your browsing content. API keys are stored locally. AI requests are sent directly from your browser to the third-party provider you choose and do not pass through Mira Translator's servers. The handling of related data is subject to the privacy policy of the selected provider.

firefox-addons:986969.name: Tab Stash
firefox-addons:986969.summary: Easily save and organize batches of tabs as bookmarks. Clear your tabs, clear your mind. Only for Firefox.
firefox-addons:986969.description:
Tab Stash is a no-fuss way to save and organize batches of tabs as bookmarks. Sweep your browser clean with one click of the Tab Stash icon (if configured). Your open tabs will be stashed away in your bookmarks, conveniently organized into groups. When it's time to pick up where you left off, open Tab Stash and restore just the tabs or groups you want.
Because Tab Stash stores your tabs as bookmarks, they will even sync to your other computers or mobile devices. Uses Firefox Sync, if configured—no need to keep track of yet another account.
 NEW IN 3.5: Tab Stash now supports Firefox's native tab groups! Use Tab Stash's convenient UI to keep your tab groups organized, and move tabs between your stash and your open tab groups with just a click.
 Features 
 Stash your open tabs with the Tab Stash toolbar button, or individual tabs with the button in the address bar
 View your stash in the Firefox sidebar, a popup, or a full-browser tab view
 Restore individual tabs, or whole groups of tabs, with a single click
 Search your stash with the quick-search bar
 Organize your stash into groups and sub-groups
 Recover recently-deleted items
 Drag and drop items to re-organize them (multi-select supported)
 Import and export your stash in rich text, Markdown, OneTab and more
 Customize the behavior of Tab Stash's toolbar button
 Dark mode
For more usage tips, privacy information, and details about how Tab Stash uses its permissions, check out the website .

bluejetty:00068328:ios.description:
İşTurkcell Online uygulamasını kullanarak şirket hatlarınız ile ilgili işlemleri kolayca yapabilirsiniz. Tüm hatlarınızın paket bilgilerini kontrol edebilir, paketi bitmek üzere olan hatlarınıza ek paket tanımlayabilirsiniz. Faturalarınız kesildiğinde beklemeden görüntüleyebilir tek tek ya da tüm faturalarınızı tek seferde ödeyebilirsiniz. Hatlarınızın yurt dışı, internet gibi ayarlarını değiştirebilir, şirket çalışanlarının taleplerini onaylayabilirsiniz. Şirket hatlarınızla ilgili daha birçok işlemi saniyeler içerisinde İşTurkcell Online uygulamasından yapabilirsiniz.
• Hızlı ve Kolay Giriş Deneyimi
İşTurkcell Online uygulamasına şirketlerin İmza Sirküleri Yetkilileri ve Özel Şifre Yetkilileri Hızlı Giriş seçeneği ile giriş yapabilirler. Şirketinize, Özel Şifre Yetkilisi tanımlamak için Turkcell müşteri yöneticiniz ile görüşebilirsiniz.
• Hatlarınızın Kullanımını İlk Bakışta Görün
İşTurkcell Online ana sayfasında yer alan Kalan Kullanımlar bölümünden paketi azalan veya paketi bitmiş olan hatlarınızı anında görebilirsiniz. Paketi azalan veya paketi bitmiş hatlarınıza İşTurkcell Online’a özel teklifler ile kolayca ek paket tanımlayabilirsiniz. 
• Sözleşmelerinizi Onaylayın
Dijital ortamdan onaylanabilen sözleşmelerinizi İşTurkcell Online üzerinden tek tıkla onaylayabilirsiniz.
• Hat Ayarlarınızı Düzenleyin
Şirket hatlarınızın gelen/giden iletişim ayarları, PUK kodu bilgileri, kullanıcı bilgi güncellemesi gibi birçok hat işlemini İşTurkcell Online’dan yapabilirsiniz.
Ayrıca giriş ekranından İşTurkcell Online kampanyalarını görebilir, yapabileceğiniz işlemler ile ilgili bilgi sahibi olabilir, güncel piyasa verilerine ulaşabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00166821:ios.summary: Learn drums with the only drum app that syncs with any drum kit and gives you instant feedback on your playing. Whether you use acoustic drums, electronic drums, or just a practice pad, Melodics offers interactive drum lessons that help you
bluejetty:00166821:ios.description:
Learn drums with the only drum app that syncs with any drum kit and gives you instant feedback on your playing. Whether you use acoustic drums, electronic drums, or just a practice pad, Melodics offers interactive drum lessons that help you improve every time you play.
Our fun, step-by-step drum learning system, designed by pro players, caters to all skill levels. Plus, access a wide range of drum songs across rock, pop, metal, jazz, and more.
Real drumming, real feedback, real results - all from your phone.
HOW IT WORKS
Melodics uses your iPhone’s built-in mic and smart audio tech to recognize your drum kit or practice pad - no extra gear required. Just calibrate your drum set-up and the app will give immediate insights on every beat. 
For electronic drum kits, connect easily via Bluetooth or wired options. Follow the setup instructions in the app to get going.
Whether you're working on your first drum beat on a pad or tightening up your fills across the whole drum kit, you’ll be building better habits from day one.
STICK WITH IT, GET RESULTS
With Melodics, drum practice becomes something you look forward to - not a chore. Just 10 minutes a day can lead to serious improvement.
Choose from 500+ drum lessons, featuring a huge range of drum content: drum rudiments, drum grooves, drum fills, drum drills, and drum songs for all levels. Use practice tools to slow things down, loop tricky parts, and track your progress. It’s like having a drum tutor or drum trainer in your pocket.
WHY CHOOSE MELODICS
- With Melodics, you're 6x more likely to improve than with traditional drum learning methods.
- It is the only drum app that provides feedback on your playing, on all drum setups (acoustic, electronic or practice pad)
- Our catalog covers everything from fundamental drum techniques to advanced rhythmic patterns.
- You’ll start learning drums through structured lessons, and get playing your favourite songs in no time.
- Build speed, strength, and control with focused warm-ups, drum rudiments, and exercises.
- You can practice anytime, anywhere, on any surface with just a pair of drum sticks!
- Join a global community of passionate drummers, all growing together.
WHAT PRO DRUMMERS SAY ABOUT MELODICS
"I wish I’d had Melodics when I was learning drums!" - Butch Vig - Award-winning producer of Nevermind, drummer for Garbage.

bluejetty:00013984:ios.description:
Cost Track allows you to:
- Use your money wisely
- Keep track of your personal and family budget
- Quickly enter your income and expenses 
- View income and expenses grouped by category and location
- Know exactly where your money goes, how to save money and where to get the best deals
- View your current balance for all accounts and each one separately and know the amount of money you currently have 
- Save your spending history where you can always find the required entry
An overview of key features:
• Cost sheets
- A cost sheet is a list of entries (income and expenses) grouped by various features, for example, accounts (Cash, Debit Card, Bank Account, etc.) or events (Wedding, Summer Holidays, Apartment Renovation, etc.)
- Create and manage as many cost sheets as you need*
- Each cost sheet can have its own currency
- The app calculates and displays your overall balance and statistics in the base currency
- Remove a cost sheet from tracking if you don’t want it to impact your overall balance and statistics
- Make transfers between cost sheets in various currencies
• Income and Expenses
- Create new entries in seconds specifying a category as the only required field
- Change date and time of your entries, add a comment to know exactly when and how you spend your money
- Specify a location to see where you spend your money and also get statistics by location
- Add a photo of a paper receipt, a product, etc. to your entries 
- In case you’re busy and don’t have time to add a comment and the amount of income or expenses, then add an audio recording and get back when you are free
- Calculate your expenses with the built-in calculator
- Convert currencies directly in the Expenses
• Sync via Dropbox for joint budget management*
• The app supports more than 150 different currencies and automatically updates currency exchange rates
• The app contains more than 25 pre-installed income and expenses categories. You can change, delete, or add new categories to customize them in a convenient way
• Statistics – view statistics of your income and expenses grouped by time, category, and location
• Diagrams – get a visual image of your income and expenses
• Customize your statistics and diagrams in a convenient way using a filter
• Create PDF reports in Diagrams and Statistics
• Search entries by description, category, and location
• PIN and TouchID/FaceID – protect your data with a PIN number and use your TouchID/FaceID for better experience
• Save and download data via iCloud for backup and data transfer between devices
• 3D Touch support
*Please note that the free version is intended to provide users a preview of the functions of the app. It has a limited number of cost sheets and entries (5 cost sheets and 20 entries in a cost sheet), no synchronization feature (via Dropbox) for joint budget management. To remove all restrictions, please upgrade to the full version with a one-time purchase or buy a subscription (monthly or annual).
The current subscription price is specified on the purchase screen of the app. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at the confirmation of purchase. The monthly subscription automatically renews every month, and the annual subscription automatically renews every year, being charged to your iTunes Account, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renew can be turned off anytime by going to your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://www.artezio.com/products/cost-track/privacy_en.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
If you like Cost Track, please take a moment to rate it in the App Store!

bluejetty:00176384:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00176384:ios.description:
WELCOME TO THE HOUSE
You're a tiny spider in a big home. Climb anything, swing everywhere, and weave webs across entire rooms. The humans are out. Now it's your time to get to work. 
Every surface is yours to explore: walls, ceilings, furniture, even the aquarium. The house is enormous from Silky's perspective, and every room is packed with secrets to uncover and plenty of opportunities to make a beautiful mess.
BECOME A WEB DESIGNER
Stretch your webs from wall to wall, lift objects, build bridges, and create structures nobody asked for. Your webs, your rules. 
Whether you build a carefully engineered web to transport objects across the room or fling your webs at everything in sight, the physics system responds to every decision you make. Connect objects, suspend them from the ceiling, and use your webs to swing yourself to new heights.
CHORES HAVE NEVER BEEN THIS FUN
The humans are out fighting the mysterious mortgage. Now it's time for Silky and the Web Scrubbers to pick up the slack, tackle chores, solve mysteries, and make the house their own. One web at a time.
Each room is home to a cast of new spiders with their own personalities, tasks, and problems that need solving. Cook breakfast, fix the aquarium, chase down runaway balloons, or help Vera crack the case of the mysterious Prof. Quack. 
No two quests are the same, and most of them can be solved in more than one way.
EXPERIENCE LIFE AS A SPIDER
- Climb any surface, even upside down and underwater
- Build intricate web structures across entire rooms
- Swing freely with precise, responsive web mechanics
- Interact with hundreds of physics-based objects
- Customise Silky with hats, shoes, and various levels of fluffiness
- And cause as much chaos as you want

The red
bluejetty:00175293:ios.description:
Your phone, reimagined as a car screen
Car Connect turns your phone into a full in-car display — a professional driving experience with no extra hardware required. Clean interface, everything at your fingertips, built for the road.
The redesigned Driving Mode gives you a native-feeling smart dashboard right on your phone — navigation, calls, music, and vehicle stats in one distraction-free layout. Dock your phone on the dash and drive. And with built-in car display support, the full experience extends directly to your car's screen — seamlessly and wirelessly.
Personalize your drive with Widgets — add live weather, your photos, or other glanceable info directly to your in-car display, making every journey feel like yours.
Beyond the driving interface, Car Connect keeps your car in check: real-time monitoring of fuel, battery, oil life, tire pressure, and more — with smart alerts before small issues become bigger ones. The built-in Service Tracker logs maintenance history and reminds you what's coming up.
Key features:
Driving Mode — professional in-car interface, no extra devices needed
Built-in car display support — extend your experience to your car's screen
Widgets — personalize your drive with weather, photos, and more
Real-time dashboard — fuel, battery, oil, tire pressure, mileage
Smart alerts — get notified when something needs attention
Service Tracker — maintenance log and reminders
Map integration — locate your car and find nearby dealerships
Digital Garage — manage multiple vehicles in one place
***************
Premium access to Car Connect
To access all the premium features and content of Car Connect, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://bloomupapps.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://bloomupapps.com/policy

bluejetty:00145177:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the heartfelt journey of Annie, a young protagonist navigating the complexities of family and high school life in 'Love Matters.' Join Annie as she uncovers the joys and challenges of growing up, forming friendships, and discovering herself in a world filled with love and memories.
Experience a nostalgic tale filled with emotional twists and turns as Annie's story unfolds before your eyes. Delve into the intricacies of familial bonds, the highs and lows of teenage life, and the power of relationships that shape our identities.
Embark on a captivating adventure through Annie's past, reliving moments that resonate with the essence of love, friendship, and self-discovery. Explore beautifully crafted environments, interact with engaging characters, and make decisions that will influence Annie's journey in profound ways.
Engage in heartwarming conversations, solve intriguing puzzles, and unlock memorable achievements as you progress through Annie's narrative. Immerse yourself in a rich storytelling experience that will tug at your heartstrings and leave a lasting impression.
With stunning visuals, a captivating soundtrack, and a narrative that resonates with players of all ages, 'Love Matters' offers a unique gaming experience that celebrates the beauty of life's precious moments. Join Annie on her quest to unravel the mysteries of her past and create unforgettable memories that will stay with you long after the game ends.
Download 'Love Matters' now and embark on a touching adventure that will inspire, entertain, and remind you of the enduring power of love and nostalgia. Get ready to embark on a journey that will touch your heart and soul in ways you never imagined."

bluejetty:00027612:ios.description:
Plantaria makes identifying plants easier than ever! Discover flowers and nature in a brand new way! 
Have you ever wished to know more about plants around you without having to spend hours reading catalogs and Wikipedia? How about obtaining a know-it-all assistant who is always there to give you the information you need? That's exactly what Plantaria is for! 
Discover a unique world of plants and become a plant recognition expert by using an easy and intuitive step-by-step process. All it takes is focusing your phone camera on a flower, bush or tree and snapping a picture. The plant identifier app will identify the plant and provide you with detailed info about it. 
Advanced features of Plantaria:
- 10 000+ plants database with 95% identification accuracy guaranteed
- Plant identification from both saved photos and freshly snapped pictures
- Detailed description for every plant
- Search history to ensure that each plant search is stored in the app
- Beautiful and intuitive interface 
Plantaria is a unique mix of the latest technology and nature admiration. It will fill all your knowledge gaps in gardening and make every trip more fun and unforgettable as you will keep a record of all the exotic and unknown plants you come across. Give it a try and start your plant identification journey today. Becoming a plant expert is as easy as the app download!

This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service. 
Additional Subscription Information:
– Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase

– Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period and the cost will be identified.

Mobiography Magazine is a digital only magazine focussing in on the subject of smartphone photography. Mobiography Magazine is bi-monthly and showcases the work of talented iphoneographers as well as featuring:
* Interviews with iPhone photographers
* How to guides and tutorials
* Reviews of the latest photo apps
* Reviews of iPhone accessories.
Subscribe today and save on the single issue price.
---------------------------------------------- 
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues. 
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest issue. 
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product. 
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period. 
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased. 
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.

We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved. 
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store 
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags. 
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com

bluejetty:00115792:ios.description:
Easily convert handwritten notes into editable digital text with our handwriting to text converter app. Scan notes, recognize cursive writing, and export text instantly—perfect for students and professionals.
Convert your PDF files into editable, searchable text in seconds. Easily extract content from scanned PDFs or documents and copy, share, or edit without retyping. Fast, accurate, and user-friendly.
Advanced handwriting to text scanner OCR (Optical Character Recognition) engine accurately extracts handwritten content from scanned paper notes and converts it into editable digital text. Unlike typical OCR Handwriting to text apps, it’s purpose-built to recognize handwriting — even cursive or messy styles — making it ideal for converting images of handwritten notes into clear, readable text.
OCR is the core of image to text apps and document scanners.
Key Features of Handwriting to Text Converter app:
Image to Text Conversion:
Accurately convert handwritten notes into editable and searchable digital text.
Image-Based Scanning:
Capture handwritten content using your phone’s camera or upload existing images for instant conversion.
PDF to Text Converter:
Easily convert PDF documents into editable text in seconds. Extract content from scanned or digital PDFs with accuracy and use it for notes, editing, or sharing—fast, simple, and reliable.
Ai Summarize Text:
AI text summarization uses artificial intelligence to shorten long texts by extracting key points. It helps users quickly grasp important information from articles, emails, or documents using natural language processing for clear, concise summaries.
 Advanced OCR Engine:
Powered by smart OCR specifically trained to recognize cursive, messy, and printed handwriting styles.
 History Management:
Automatically saves converted texts so you can revisit, copy, or delete them anytime.
 Multi-Language Support:
Supports handwriting recognition in English, Hindi, and several other regional languages.
Voice Outputs:
Hear your handwritten notes aloud with voice output. Great for quick reviews and accessibility.
Export & Share:
Easily export your converted text to Notepad, Word, email, or share via social media and messaging apps.
How to use Handwriting to Text Converter app...?
1. Open the App
Launch the app from your home screen.
2. Scan or Upload a Handwritten Note
Tap the Camera icon to take a picture of your handwritten text
 OR
Tap the Gallery icon to upload an image from your phone
3. Adjust and Crop (Optional)
Select the handwritten area. You can rotate, crop, or enhance the image for better accuracy.
4. Tap 'Convert' or 'Extract Text'
The OCR engine will process the image and extract the handwritten text into editable digital format.
5. Edit or Copy the Text
Make quick edits if needed. You can now copy, share, or save the text.
6. Export or Save
Export the converted text as a .txt, .pdf, or send it directly via email, or other apps.
7. View History
All your conversions are saved in the History section so you can access them anytime.

bluejetty:00077507:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00077507:ios.description:
Stop unwanted catalogs, credit card offers and other paper junk mail. Snap a photo with PaperKarma and we'll handle the opt-out request for you.
Spend less time sorting, shredding and recycling mail you never asked for. PaperKarma helps you contact the senders and get off their mailing lists, without researching each company's opt-out process yourself.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo of the mailer's name, logo or return address.
2. Confirm the sender and select the name and address shown on your mail.
3. Tap Unsubscribe. We send the opt-out request on your behalf.
CHOOSE WHAT YOU WANT TO STOP
Request removal from mailing lists for catalogs, credit card and insurance offers, charity solicitations, and other unwanted mail from national and local businesses.
Your bills, statements and important account mail are not affected. You choose which senders to unsubscribe from.
MAIL FOR SOMEONE WHO MOVED OUT?
Save multiple names and addresses, including name variations and previous residents receiving junk mail at your home. Select the exact name and address printed on each piece for the best match.
PRIVACY MATTERS
We do not sell, rent or trade your mail photos, name or address. We share the information needed to carry out the opt-out you request. If a mailer requires your email address or phone number to verify an opt-out, we ask for your specific consent first. See our Privacy Policy for details.
WHAT TO EXPECT
Stopping mail takes time. Allow 8-12 weeks after your request is processed for mail already scheduled or printed to work through the system. Timing and results depend on the sender.
PaperKarma works with addressed postal junk mail in the 50 United States. It cannot stop Every Door Direct Mail (EDDM), unaddressed flyers, or election and ballot-issue postcards. Mail addressed only to a generic recipient such as "Current Resident" is generally not supported.
SUPPORTED MAILERS
PaperKarma helps you request removal from mailing lists for 100,000+ national and local mailers, charities and organizations. Examples include Capital One, American Express, Discover, Allstate, GEICO, State Farm, Restoration Hardware (RH), Wayfair, Valpak, Money Mailer, Save.com, AT&T and Xfinity.
From credit card offers and insurance promotions to shopping catalogs and coupon mailers, choose the senders you want to stop hearing from.
AS FEATURED IN
The New York Times, NBC, TechCrunch, Lifehacker and Real Simple. PaperKarma was also selected for Apple's Best Apps in the Disruptive Services category and is an evergreen featured app in the Apple App Store Lifestyle category.
TRY 4 REQUESTS FREE
Your first 4 opt-out requests are free. To submit more, choose a monthly, 6-month or annual subscription, or a one-time Lifetime Plan.
All paid plans include unlimited opt-out requests to supported mailers. The 6-month, annual and Lifetime plans also let you submit new mailers for research. We add a new mailer when we can establish an opt-out process.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Recurring subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account subscription settings. The Lifetime Plan is a one-time purchase and does not renew.
Terms of Use: https://www.paperkarma.com/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://www.paperkarma.com/privacy/

GoKid takes the chaos out of school pickup and drop-off. Whether you're coordinating with three families or thirty, GoKid gives parents an easy, trusted way to share the driving — and actually stick to it.
If your school uses GoKid Connect, you're already connected. Find nearby families, join carpools instantly, and manage everything in one place — no spreadsheets, no group texts.
WHY PARENTS LOVE GOKID
Smart Scheduling — Set up recurring carpools in minutes. GoKid handles the calendar, reminders, and route assignments automatically.
Real-Time Visibility — Know who's driving, when they're arriving, and where your kids are. GPS tracking and live updates keep every parent in the loop.
In-App Messaging — No need to switch to text. Coordinate with your carpool group right inside the app.
Save Time and Money — Share the driving, cut your trips in half, and reduce gas costs.
Invitation-Only — You control who's in your carpool. Only trusted, invited families can join your group.
GETTING STARTED TAKES 3 MINUTES
Download GoKid and add your family members
School on GoKid Connect? You'll be prompted to connect automatically.
Not on GoKid Connect? Invite trusted families directly and set up your carpool group manually.
Set up your first carpool and start sharing the driving.
Love GoKid? Ask your school about GoKid Connect — the easiest way to coordinate carpooling across your entire school community.
GoKid Connect users get all Pro features included — ask your school about GoKid Connect.
Available in the US and Canada.
FOR SCHOOLS
GoKid partners with schools and districts across 14 US states and Canada. Email schools@gokid.mobi or visit www.gokid.mobi/schools

With a perfect blend of asmr simulator offline, make important decisions in our dentist games that impact patient care.
The addictive gameplay of our hospital time management games awaits you! Join and play our surgery games, and experience the challenges of life. bluejetty:00069229:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00069229:ios.description:
Discover your body’s rhythm with a scientifically based fertility tracker designed to help you plan or avoid pregnancy naturally.
Simply enter the first day of your last period, and the app predicts your next period, ovulation day, and the most fertile and least fertile days of your cycle.
With Apple Health sync, your data stays automatically updated across all your Apple devices — so your fertility insights are always with you.
* Scientifically Backed Methods *
Our app includes two baby gender prediction methods:
 • Popular Method – a theoretical approach based on the well-known theory by Landrum Shettles, which suggests that the timing within the fertile window may influence the baby’s gender.
 • Scientific Method – a statistical, research-based approach developed by Rodrigo Guerrero, grounded in large-scale data from thousands of women.
You can switch between them anytime in Settings.
Please note: both methods provide probabilistic insights, not guaranteed results.
* Full Version Features *
Unlock deeper insights with the full version:
 • Daily pregnancy probability for any selected date.
 • Gender prediction probabilities for each fertile day.
 • Overall fertility chances during your current cycle.
 • Automatic Apple Health sync between devices.
* How It Works *
To create your personal fertility calendar, simply provide:
 • The first day of your last period.
 • Your average cycle length.
 • Your luteal phase length (default works for most users).
Ideal for women with regular cycles — but also reliable for estimating ovulation using your average cycle length.
* Empower Your Reproductive Journey *
Whether you’re trying to conceive or prefer natural birth control, this app provides clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind — backed by science and made even smarter with Apple Health integration.
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational and educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider before making decisions related to contraception, fertility, or pregnancy. Accuracy may vary depending on individual factors.

bluejetty:00177415:ios.name: ActiveCaptain®
bluejetty:00177415:ios.summary: The free ActiveCaptain app creates a powerful connection between your compatible mobile device and Garmin chartplotter, charts, maps and the boating community. Whether you use your Garmin products for cruising, fishing, sailing or diving, t
bluejetty:00177415:ios.description:
The free ActiveCaptain app creates a powerful connection between your compatible mobile device and Garmin chartplotter, charts, maps and the boating community. Whether you use your Garmin products for cruising, fishing, sailing or diving, this all-in-one app will help you enjoy your time on the water.
Just pair the app with your compatible chartplotter to wirelessly transfer and access charts and maps, software updates, routes, waypoints and helpful feedback from the ActiveCaptain Community. And, with the purchase of the OnDeck™ hub(1), you can track and monitor your boat from virtually anywhere.
Please note that this app is intended for Garmin chartplotter owners and is not recommended for use as a stand-alone navigational app.
FEATURES AVAILABLE:
- ONECHART™:
> New Garmin Navionics+™ and premium Garmin Navionics Vision+™ cartography, featuring a Navionics® style appearance, advanced Auto Guidance+™ technology(2) and a one-year subscription to daily updates, is available now for North America and Europe, and coming soon to the rest of the world.
Purchase our newest-generation charts or legacy BlueChart® g3 charts from your mobile device, and upload them to registered Garmin chartplotters on your vessel. 
You will get exceptional coverage, clarity and detail with charts that feature integrated Garmin and Navionics data and much more. Plus, the NOAA raster cartography(3) and premium features can be downloaded for free through the ActiveCaptain app. Visit Garmin.com/marinemaps.
- PLAN A TRIP: Plan your trip, or e-scout a new fishing spot before you’re on the water. Then, transfer your data to your chartplotter where you can view your routes and waypoints.
- USER DATA SYNC: Automatically back up and sync your data between your chartplotter and the ActiveCaptain app.
- ACTIVECAPTAIN COMMUNITY: Join a community of boaters to get up-to-date feedback on marinas, boat ramps and other points of interest (POI). Check ratings, read reviews, and view pictures of POIs to make informed decisions on the water. Contribute your own POI, reviews and pictures from your compatible mobile device.
- CONTROL YOUR CHARTPLOTTER: Using the built-in Helm™ feature, the ActiveCaptain app lets you view and control your compatible(4) chartplotter from your smartphone or tablet, even when someone else is at the helm(5).
- EASY SOFTWARE UPDATES: Receive notifications about software updates from the app, and update your chartplotter wirelessly.
- ONDECK HUB: Use the ActiveCaptain app to track, monitor and control any number of switches with the OnDeck system(1) from nearly anywhere. Door open? Bilge running? Peace of mind comes in the form of text alerts and updates. 
- GARMIN QUICKDRAWTM COMMUNITY: Download the latest 1’ HD contour maps shared by your fellow boaters, and sync with your chartplotter. You can also upload your own Quickdraw Contours map data.
- SMART NOTIFICATIONS: Connect the app to your chartplotter, and turn on smart notifications(4) to see calls, text messages and more on the chartplotter display while your phone is somewhere safe and dry.
FOOTNOTES
1)OnDeck hub sold separately and requires an active subscription plan
2)Auto Guidance+ is for planning purposes only and does not replace safe navigation operations
3)NOAA raster cartography cannot be viewed on echoMAP™ CHIRP and ECHOMAP™ Plus combos but can be viewed on mobile devices via the ActiveCaptain mobile app
4)Helm feature is not compatible with ECHOMAP series chartplotters
5)Check device compatibility on the ActiveCaptain app web page; visit https://www.garmin.com/c/marine/marine-apps/
End User License Agreement: https://www.garmin.com/en-US/legal/marine-mobile-eula/

bluejetty:00063255:ios.description:
Join Diggy, the Professor, Linda and Rusty on their journey! Explore the world full of mines, learn from an ancient civilization and solve unforgettable puzzles. Escape each maze and reveal the greatest mysteries of the past in Diggy’s Adventure online game!
No secret may remain hidden in this 2D maze! Find your path in a terra incognita labyrinth while you discover new characters of this story or maybe an ancient civilization. Will you be able to escape the puzzle mine?
Do you like cognitive games that put you to the limit? Try this mining treasure hunt and prove you intelligence! Other brain games are merely crosswords while with this one you will be able to explore a hidden labyrinth filled with lots of riddles until you find the right path! A true miner does not forget his hunt for gold so hit those rocks and explore rich rooms while you enjoy the mining.

bluejetty:00149576:ios.name: WTA Trailblazer: Go Hiking
bluejetty:00149576:ios.summary: Explore 4,000+ hikes with Washington state’s most trusted app. Get the latest trail conditions in our trip reports. Check our maps for fires, air quality and snow levels, and use our search filters to find trails for kids, dogs, or wheelcha
bluejetty:00149576:ios.description:
Explore 4,000+ hikes with Washington state’s most trusted app. Get the latest trail conditions in our trip reports. Check our maps for fires, air quality and snow levels, and use our search filters to find trails for kids, dogs, or wheelchairs. Save hikes you want to do in a list you can access offline.
We offer verified driving directions to trailheads and important info about required passes, permits and closure alerts, as well as personalized recommendations of hikes based on what you like. You can also post trip reports from your own hikes to track where you’ve been and help other hikers know what to expect.
GET OUTSIDE SAFELY
- Trailhead weather forecasts from NOAA help you know what the weather’s like on trail.
- See what on-trail conditions are like using snow, fire, and air quality layers on our maps.
- Red alerts highlight trail or road closures so you know about them before you get to the trailhead.
- Check trip reports to see current road and trail conditions and seasonal features like ripe berries or fall foliage.
FIND A HIKE
- Customize your search with filters for length, elevation gain, passes and what features you want to see on trail (waterfalls, rivers, great views, etc.).
- Use our kid-, dog- and wheelchair-friendly filters to find appropriate trails.
- Find hikes near you using your phone’s location or use WTA’s Hike Finder Map or region filters.
- Find hikes based on pass and permit requirements.
- Difficulty ratings help you decide if a hike is right for you.
MAKE AN ACCOUNT
Creating an account with WTA lets you save hike information for later and access it offline, including the driving directions to the trailhead and detailed trail descriptions. You can also get personalized hike recommendations in your account based on where you like to hike. Plus, when you have an account, you can:
- Like or comment on other users trip reports
- Post your own trip reports and share the pictures you took on trail. The more hikes you save and trip reports you write, the better the recommendations you get.

bluejetty:00115197:ios.summary: In this top-down, light-action adventure game developed by Yostar, play as the Tyrant in a captivating fantasy world. Create memorable bonds with charming girls known as Trekkers, assemble perfect teams for diverse adventures, and conquer t
bluejetty:00115197:ios.description:
In this top-down, light-action adventure game developed by Yostar, play as the Tyrant in a captivating fantasy world. Create memorable bonds with charming girls known as Trekkers, assemble perfect teams for diverse adventures, and conquer the mysterious Monoliths. Packed with exhilarating battles, randomized perks each run, and a variety of in-game features, Stella Sora will keep you coming back for more. Tyrant, your legacy awaits!
・Other World Adventure: Explore With Charming Girls
Awaken from timeless slumber to a world transformed. Knights wield flip phones, adventurers sip sodas from vending machines, and witches ride broomsticks...while capturing headlines with their cameras. In the enchanting continent of Nova, where fantasy meets retro, join charming Trekkers on grand quests, ascend mysterious Monoliths, and uncover forgotten secrets.
・Branching Paths: Let Your Choices Shape The Future
As your journey unfolds, the choices you make will weave a complex tapestry with the fates of Trekkers. As the Tyrant, guide their strategies, choose your persona, and steer the narrative. Will you be a daring savior or a cunning strategist? The power is in your hands.
・Team Dynamics: Create Endlessly Diverse Squads
Adventure awaits in the Monoliths' heights! Assemble a squad of three Trekkers, designate main and support roles, and select random perks as you ascend each floor. Each Trekker boasts two distinct skill sets based on their role, creating nearly limitless combinations for varied battle styles. Adapt and experiment with roles and skills to craft unique strategies and overcome every challenge.
・New Challenges: Explore Varied Game Modes
Beyond story mode lies a realm of new trials. Utilize records from past Monolith runs to tackle diverse gameplay modes—from intense duels with the best Trekkers to bullet hells and limitless battles. Stay engaged with dynamic challenges that push your strategy and reflexes.
・Heartfelt Memories: Forge Lasting Bonds That Keep Growing
Your Nova journey is filled with companionship. Encounter girls with distinct personalities from varied factions—whether a novice bass player, a clumsy but sincere squire, or a genius doctor with a scythe. Deepen relationships by using the in-game feature to exchange messages or invite them on unforgettable adventures.

bluejetty:00165431:ios.name: Blades of Deceron
bluejetty:00165431:ios.summary:
From the creator of Gladihoppers comes Blades of Deceron, an epic medieval fantasy RPG where kingdoms clash, factions rise, and only the strongest survive.
Embark on a journey through the war-torn valley of Brar on the continent of Deceron
bluejetty:00165431:ios.description:
From the creator of Gladihoppers comes Blades of Deceron, an epic medieval fantasy RPG where kingdoms clash, factions rise, and only the strongest survive.
Embark on a journey through the war-torn valley of Brar on the continent of Deceron. Four powerful factions: The Kingdom of Braryrian, The Holy Empire of Azivnia, The Kingdom of Elukhis, and The Clans of Valthir wage war for control, leaving the land ravaged and infested with bandits. Will you lead your forces to victory and bring peace, or will you carve your own path of conquest?
- 2D Fighting Action: Engage in intense, fast-paced battles with as many as 10v10 on-screen combatants. With a vast variety of weapons (swords, maces, axes, polearms, and more!) every fight feels fresh with hundreds of pieces of equipment to discover.
- Campaign Mode: Explore the Brar Valley, conquer cities, towns, castles, and villages, and recruit warriors to fight alongside you. Join an existing faction or create your own and rise to power!
- RPG Elements: Equip gear that reflects your playstyle. Helmets, gauntlets, boots, and more. Customize your character and level up your skills!
- Future Expansions: Look forward to thrilling minigames, from arena tournaments to fishing, along with an engaging quest system and scene editor, ensuring endless replayability.
Blades of Deceron is inspired by other amazing fighting games and action RPG titles, such as Mount & Blade, the Witcher, and Gladihoppers.

bluejetty:00015414:ios.name: Little Ones: Baby Sleep
bluejetty:00015414:ios.summary:
PERSONALIZED BABY SLEEP, MADE SIMPLE
Little Ones is a baby sleep app that gives you a personalized daily schedule, adapts when naps change and helps you know what comes next.
A nap runs short, another runs long, or your baby wakes earlier
bluejetty:00015414:ios.description:
PERSONALIZED BABY SLEEP, MADE SIMPLE
Little Ones is a baby sleep app that gives you a personalized daily schedule, adapts when naps change and helps you know what comes next.
A nap runs short, another runs long, or your baby wakes earlier than usual. Our adaptive Sleep-o-Rhythm updates your baby’s day using their age, stage and actual sleep, without you having to calculate wake windows or force a schedule that no longer works.
Open Little Ones. Know what’s next.
A BABY SLEEP SCHEDULE THAT ADAPTS
Sleep-o-Rhythm gives you a personalized sleep and feeding plan based on your baby’s age and stage.
Log what actually happens and the plan adjusts as your baby’s day unfolds. If a nap is shorter or longer than expected, you can see what to aim for next and keep the rest of the day on track.
No more trying to calculate wake windows or wondering what one unexpected nap means for the rest of the day.
TRACK SLEEP, NAPS AND FEEDS
Keep your baby’s sleep and feeding information together in one convenient place.
• Log naps, night sleep and feeds
• See your baby’s next suggested sleep time
• Follow a personalized daily rhythm
• Identify patterns as your baby grows
• Adapt the day when sleep does not go to plan
• Understand your baby’s changing sleep needs
HELP WHEN SLEEP GETS TRICKY
Baby sleep changes constantly, but you do not have to navigate it alone.
Find practical, age-appropriate guidance for:
• Short naps
• Frequent night waking
• Early rising
• Nap refusal
• Sleep regressions
• Settling struggles
• Bedtime battles
• Nap transitions
• Newborn sleep
• Toddler sleep
We help you understand what may be happening and what you can do next.
REAL SLEEP EXPERTS, IN YOUR POCKET
Sometimes you need more than an article.
Get personalized support from our certified sleep consultants through private in-app chat. Talk through what is happening with your baby and receive practical guidance tailored to your family’s situation.
A VILLAGE IN YOUR POCKET
Parenting was never meant to happen alone.
Inside our Parenting Village, you can connect with other parents, ask questions, share experiences and find support from people navigating the same wonderfully unpredictable stages.
BUILT AROUND YOUR BABY
Little Ones combines sleep biology, child development and your baby’s actual day to provide guidance that evolves as they grow.
You will also find a range of responsive settling and self-settling approaches, allowing you to choose what feels right for your baby and your family. Our focus is not a perfect schedule -it is helping you better understand your baby and feel confident about what comes next.
INDEPENDENTLY ENDORSED
Our sleep guidance is independently endorsed by Dr Kate Johnson, Ph.D. in Sleep Physiology and postdoctoral fellow in the Department of Sleep Medicine at Harvard Medical School and Stanford Research Institute.
“What I particularly love about the Little Ones strategies is that they can be tailored to your family, so that you really see positive change to your baby’s sleep.”
TRUSTED BY MORE THAN 1 MILLION FAMILIES
Little Ones has helped more than one million families around the world navigate baby and toddler sleep.
From newborn sleep and changing nap needs to regressions, night waking, early rising, nap transitions and toddler sleep, Little Ones is there as your baby grows.
No more wondering when the next nap should be, how long your baby should sleep, or what today’s unexpected nap means for the rest of the day.
Open Little Ones. Know what’s next.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.littleones.co/pages/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.littleones.co/pages/privacy-policy
Email: app@littleones.co

bluejetty:00099461:android.description:
An ideal tool for easily opening, viewing and managing documents. Whether for study, work or daily use, it can help you handle files efficiently.
✨ Main functions
- Multi-language switching: Supports multiple languages to meet the usage habits of global users.
- File Management Assistant: Quick search, rename and view details, making it easier to organize documents.
- Document editing tool: It offers annotation, signature, and merge functions while retaining the original file, providing greater peace of mind during use.
- Convenient format conversion: Supports quick conversion of images into PDFS, making archiving and sharing more convenient.
Premium Subscription
PDF Reader & Editor Utility offers optional subscription plans to access advanced features and enhanced services.
Monthly Plan: $19.99 per month.
Annual Plan: 3-day free trial, then $69.99 per year.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Payment will be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel subscriptions at any time via your account settings.
Note: Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription during the trial period.
Permission Statement
This application needs to invoke the following permissions to ensure the normal operation of its core functions:
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: It is used for scanning, displaying and classifying PDF documents in the management device, facilitating search and use.
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: It is used for large file processing to ensure that the document rendering and preview process is not interrupted
We are well aware of the significance of user privacy and data security. All permissions will only be enabled with the user's explicit consent, and all data processing will be completed locally. We will not upload, store or share the content of your files.
We will continue to optimize to bring you a smoother reading and management experience.
Download now and make document processing simpler!
Privacy policy: https://filefastclean.com/1/privacy
The terms of service: https://filefastclean.com/1/terms
Contact us at filefastclean@proton.me
