Since 1914, TNR has been a platform for public-minded thinkers and writers advocating liberal reform in a new industrial age. Today, TNR remains more committed than ever to its social democratic first principles—and most of all, to the project of restoring flagging liberal confidence in the public arena while reclaiming the embattled legacy of civic republican self-rule in America. Our journalism isn’t afraid to debate complex issues and take a stance—from social injustice to climate change. 
TNR App Features
* Read the complete magazine—10 issues a year
* Read our latest web content 
* Access three free articles before subscribing
* With a monthly or annual subscription, enjoy unlimited access to any TNR article in the app or on the TNR website
* Share articles to your favorite social networks—or via email or text—using our Share or Clip tools
* Bookmark articles to read later—or offline
* Listen to The Politics of Everything, our new podcast 
* Subscribe to our newsletters: TNR Daily, The Soapbox, Critical Mass, Apocalypse Soon, Sold Short, American Jitters, and Listen Up.

 • No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the user’s active subscription period.
 Privacy Policy - https://newrepublic.com/pages/privacy
 Terms of Use - http://www.mazsystems.com/outputs-terms/
 • Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00018957:ios.description:
There's a new player in town, the wiggling, jiggling Jelly Queen and she's here to challenge you to a game of Candy Crush Jelly Saga! Whatever your favorite moves, you better hope they're Jellylicious enough to take on the mighty Jelly Queen.
The unstoppably spreadable game! New Candy Crush Jelly Saga is full of delightful game modes, features and boss battles featuring the Jelly Queen! Playing as Jenny, show off your Jellylicious moves and take turns switching Candies against the jiggling Jelly Queen. Every sweet move will spread more Jelly and whoever spreads the most will win the level!
There are splendid new Candies, a marvelous new booster and a dreamy treetop world to explore in the Candy Kingdom too!
IARC rating: 3+
Take on this delightful Saga alone or play with friends to see who can get the highest score!
Candy Crush Jelly Saga is completely free to play but in-game currency, to buy items such as extra moves or lives, will require payment with real money.
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Candy Crush Jelly Saga features:
> Over 3000 Jellylicious Levels 
> Boss Modes 
> Marvelous game modes including: Spread the Jelly & Release the Pufflers 
> Tasty Color Bomb Lollipop booster 
> Mesmerizing new Candies 
> Dreamy new treetop world and a host of quirky characters led by the Jelly Queen and her stooges. 
> Easy and fun to play, yet challenging to fully master
For players that Facebook Connect, there are leaderboards for you and your friends to compare your Jellylicious scores
Easily sync the game between mobile and tablet devices and unlock the full game features when connected to the internet 
Now you can express yourself, jelly-style! Be sassy like the Jelly Queen or cool like Cupcake Carl with our sweet Candy Crush Jelly Stickers!
Facebook @CandyCrushJellySaga
Twitter @CandyCrushJelly
Instagram @CandyCrushSaga
YouTube @CandyCrushOfficial
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Candy Crush Jelly Saga!

IARC rating: 3+

Cleaner Master simplifies digital hygiene with AI-assisted cleaning. Keep your device clutter-free by systematically removing redundant content, optimizing storage allocation, and preserving meaningful data – all through intuitive workflows.
Free Up Storage Space and Enhance Phone Efficiency
Cleaner Master provides essential tools to help you manage device storage
Core Cleaning Features
1. Duplicate Media Cleanup
Photo & Video Scanning: Identifies files with identical file sizes and creation dates
One-Tap Removal: Deletes confirmed duplicates after user review
Storage Saved Counter: Shows recovered space after each cleanup
2. Media Quality Management
Blurry Detection: Flags potentially out-of-focus images for review
Low-Resolution Filter: Finds images below minimum quality thresholds
3. Storage Space Recovery
Large File Finder: Lists files over size thresholds
Category Breakdown: Shows storage usage by photos, videos, apps, etc.
Organization Tools
1. Contact Management

Merge Function: Combines duplicate entries while preserving details

2. Calendar Maintenance

Welcome to Mystery Trail! Step into an intriguing world of secrets and puzzles with Fiona and Jake in Mystery Trail! Our two adventurers need your help to explore the mysterious town of Goldenridge, uncover lost artifacts, and solve puzzles that reveal the truth behind strange events. Become part of their team as they navigate challenging paths, uncover hidden clues, and embark on an unforgettable journey.
Solve various puzzles, keep an eye out for clues, and follow mysterious signs that lead to new discoveries. Each puzzle you solve takes you one step closer to unraveling the secrets of Goldenridge. Whether it’s discovering an old family heirloom or piecing together an ancient map, every turn brings surprises.
Compete with other players in exciting events like Secret Temple, Dance Off, Pirate Pursuit, and Medal Rush. The fun and challenge never end—you’ll always have something exciting to look forward to in Mystery Trail!
Game Features:
● EXCITING PUZZLE GAMEPLAY: Blast through challenging block puzzles and unlock new levels filled with unique mechanics.
● JOIN THE JOURNEY: Experience an engaging storyline with Jake and Fiona as they uncover hidden truths and progress through intriguing meta-adventure content.
● CHALLENGING OBSTACLES: Face various obstacles that will test your strategy and puzzle-solving skills.
● STRATEGIC BOOSTERS: Use powerful boosters to overcome difficult puzzles and keep your momentum going.
Immerse yourself in Mystery Trail, where every puzzle is a step toward uncovering the secrets of Goldenridge. With each milestone, Fiona and Jake move closer to the truth—are you ready to join them?
What are you waiting for? Download Mystery Trail today and join Fiona and Jake on their thrilling quest!
Need some help? Contact us at support@ace.games for assistance.
Mystery Trail is free to download and play. Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money, but they aren’t required for you to enjoy the Mystery Trail! No ads, no interruptions – just pure puzzle fun. Play online or offline anytime!

bluejetty:00026747:ios.description:
The award winning tide app for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Never miss a tide, sunset, or beautiful day on the water. Tide Guide features tide and marine weather conditions from trusted data providers worldwide. It's beautiful, powerful, and provides easy access to thousands of different tide stations around the world.
# Apple Design Award & App Store App of the Year Finalist
# Built for Apple Watch
Gorgeous full screen charts provide detailed tide and weather conditions. Each chart is dynamic and can switch between other conditions and views with just a tap.
# Monthly & Yearly Tide Tables
View detailed forecasts for 10 days, and tide tables for the next 12 months. Various display options allow for powerful layout customizations.
# Home and Lock Screen Widgets
Add beautiful and powerful widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. Tide Guide features an extensive set of widgets, with powerful customization options allow for endless combinations of marine and tide conditions.
# Live Activities
Use Live Activities to follow the current tide or sunset. There are different options for various “island activities.” Track the current tide, wind direction, solar progress, or lunar phase.
# Summary Shortcuts
Use Siri or the Shortcuts app to view different summaries of the tide, surf conditions, upcoming forecasts, and more. Ask Siri “Tide Guide Surf Report” to never miss the next swell.
# Lunar Calendar
Easily track the current lunar phase with a beautiful lunar phase calendar. Explore the altitude and elevation of the moon throughout the day, and view detailed solunar times like nautical dawn, dusk, and more.
# Pro Features
Many features in the app are free to use, and certain availability varies by region.
Widgets, complications, detailed charts, and future table data require an active Pro subscription.

The award winning tide app for Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Never miss a tide, sunset, or beautiful day on the water. Tide Guide features tide and marine weather conditions from trusted data providers worldwide. It's beautiful, powerful, and provides easy access to thousands of different tide stations around the world.

# Apple Design Award & App Store App of the Year Finalist


# Built for Apple Watch
Gorgeous full screen charts provide detailed tide and weather conditions. Each chart is dynamic and can switch between other conditions and views with just a tap.


# Monthly & Yearly Tide Tables
View detailed forecasts for 10 days, and tide tables for the next 12 months. Various display options allow for powerful layout customizations.


# Home and Lock Screen Widgets
Add beautiful and powerful widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. Tide Guide features an extensive set of widgets, with powerful customization options allow for endless combinations of marine and tide conditions.


# Live Activities
Use Live Activities to follow the current tide or sunset. There are different options for various “island activities.” Track the current tide, wind direction, solar progress, or lunar phase.


# Summary Shortcuts
Use Siri or the Shortcuts app to view different summaries of the tide, surf conditions, upcoming forecasts, and more. Ask Siri “Tide Guide Surf Report” to never miss the next swell.


# Lunar Calendar
Easily track the current lunar phase with a beautiful lunar phase calendar. Explore the altitude and elevation of the moon throughout the day, and view detailed solunar times like nautical dawn, dusk, and more.


# Pro Features
Many features in the app are free to use, and certain availability varies by region.
Widgets, complications, detailed charts, and future table data require an active Pro subscription.



Privacy & Terms:
https://tideguide.com/privacy
https://tideguide.com/terms

bluejetty:00139781:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00139781:ios.description:
Direct a professional photoshoot from anywhere: control the camera on your model's iPhone live, while your client watches.
Every shot is captured on the model's iPhone at full quality - JPEG, RAW or Apple ProRAW, up to 48MP on supported iPhones - and goes straight to a gallery the whole room can open.
Used by teams at Chanel and Valentino, photographers such as Juergen Teller and Greg Williams, and media including WSJ, Vogue and i-D.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a room and send the link. Your model joins from their iPhone; clients and art directors join as viewers.
2. You see the model's camera and take over the controls: tap to focus, exposure, ISO, shutter speed, white balance, zoom, lens, flash and a 5-second timer.
3. Press the shutter. The photo is taken by the iPhone's camera, not grabbed from the video call, and uploads to the room's gallery.
FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
- Shoot campaigns, editorials, portraits and headshots without travelling.
- Use every lens on the iPhone: wide, ultra wide and telephoto, front or back.
- Pick the format for the job: JPEG, RAW (DNG) or Apple ProRAW, plus video.
FOR BRANDS, AGENCIES AND ART DIRECTORS
- Join as a viewer from wherever you are and watch the shoot as it happens.
- Open the gallery during the call and heart the frames you want. Everyone in the room sees your picks.
- Brief talent anywhere in the world without flying a crew out.
FOR STUDIOS AND PRODUCTION TEAMS
- Run lookbook, e-commerce and creator shoots with talent at home.
- Files upload while you shoot; follow progress from the Lock Screen.
- Deliver through CLOS Cloud or the Camera Roll, and share the room with a link.
ALSO IN CLOS
- AI CAM: a hands-free selfie assistant that presses the shutter when you are in frame with your eyes open.
- CLOS Discover: swipe through photographers and models to find collaborators for your next remote project.
PLANS
Free to start with 1 GB of CLOS Cloud storage - room for around 50 RAW photos, or many more JPEGs. Subscribe when you need more space.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://closapp.notion.site/PRIVACY-POLICY-CLOS-Inc-1141c2be584e800b81e5faa26f16ee23
Terms of Use: https://closapp.notion.site/END-USER-LICENSE-AGREEMENT-5774f6cdd8dd47cfb10e7f28f54a8ed3
Questions? hi@clos.vc

bluejetty:00142007:ios.name: Hayti: Black News and Podcasts
bluejetty:00142007:ios.summary: Hayti is a Black owned personalized news app highlighting BLK culture from Black publishers into one feed. Hayti is the easiest way to stay up to date on news and information that matters most to you, that you can tailor to your own interes
bluejetty:00142007:ios.description:
Hayti is a Black owned personalized news app highlighting BLK culture from Black publishers into one feed. Hayti is the easiest way to stay up to date on news and information that matters most to you, that you can tailor to your own interests!
Where you can catch all the conversations, interviews, breaking news, the BLM movement and every matter that concerns you as it happens when it happens!
For years, Black journalists have been underrepresented among organizations across America, and society needs and demands more inclusive news and information not readily available in most apps. It's been more than 190 years since the creation of the BLK press, and diverse voices are more relevant than ever.
There are several content aggregators today however, all focus primarily on content related to the broadest consumer community. Very few companies focus on utilizing the nation’s Black newspapers, magazines and other media companies delivering invaluable coverage across America today.
Hayti has changed that dynamic with a comprehensive digital app featuring content from Black publishers - all designed to meet the needs of millions of diverse app users who turn to their mobile phones hourly for information.
U.S. and World News
• Your trusted source for breaking news, analysis, exclusive interviews, headlines, and videos from BLK publishers around the world.
• Receive daily local headlines, sports, politics, events, and more taking place in the Black community.
• Hayti is a smart news platform that aggregates rich, relevant stories from over 200 Black publishers and news outlets across the U.S.
Hayti provides an extensive collection of genre specific articles, videos, and podcasts covering social justice issues, entertainment, health, vlogs, podcasts, and more... Hayti is a smart news app that learns as you read, personalizes your experience automatically, and suggests the topics and articles for each user highlighting the latest updates on BLK culture and BLK media.
Get the latest news and information taking place in the BLK community.
Hayti is the first mobile app in America to feature over 200+ Black publishers. Hayti features thousands of articles from Black owned newspapers, magazines, and digital publishers across the nation from popular African-American magazines like Essence, BET, Ebony, The Root, TheGrio, and more.
Read the most popular stories of the day
Hayti is focused on aggregating content so mobile users can like, share and save new content each day. Hayti helps you remain up to date on African American movers and shakers in the Blk community. Hayti delivers relevant and compelling news, business, sports, entertainment, videos and more… to provide advertisers and businesses with efficient means and value to connect with diverse mobile audiences.

bluejetty:00161450:ios.summary: If you're looking for a top-quality podcast app, Podcast Republic is a great option for you! With over 2 million podcasts and 500 million episodes available worldwide every day, it's a trustworthy app with a plethora of features that make m
bluejetty:00161450:ios.description:
If you're looking for a top-quality podcast app, Podcast Republic is a great option for you! With over 2 million podcasts and 500 million episodes available worldwide every day, it's a trustworthy app with a plethora of features that make managing your podcasts, online radio streaming, audio books, and RSS news & blog feeds a breeze.
Podcast Republic is completely free! You can enjoy all of its cool features without any cost. You can stream your favorite podcast series through the internet or download them to listen offline whenever you want. We know you are addicted to podcasts. We know you like to have podcast in your pocket. No matter what type of podcasts you enjoy, whether it's daily news, live radio, audio books, music, science, true crime, or something else, you'll find something great with our podcast catcher. A cast box in your pocket. A podcast player for podcast listeners, podcast creators, podcast makers and podcast addicts.
The app's discovery feature is really useful, supporting all major podcast networks, public radio networks, and news agencies, as well as enabling you to import from RSS & ATOM feeds directly. You can also import and export subscriptions using the OPML file format.
If you prefer to listen to live radio, Podcast Republic has you covered with live radio streaming from all over the world. There's even a build-in RSS reader, which lets you read news in a mobile-friendly format and organize your feeds by tagging.
Great Web App
Our web app https://podcastrepublic.net allows you to easily view your subscriptions.
Play Your Local Media Files
Apart from being a daily podcast cacher and player app, you can play the media files stored on your device in this app. Enjoy audiobooks, music, and other media files from one single app!

bluejetty:00161227:ios.name: Canada Citizenship Test 2026
bluejetty:00161227:ios.summary:
Pass the Canadian citizenship test on your first try.
Everything you need to study for the Canadian citizenship test 2026 is in one app: flashcards, chapter quizzes, full mock exams with a real 45-minute timer, narrated audio lessons, and
bluejetty:00161227:ios.description:
Pass the Canadian citizenship test on your first try.
Everything you need to study for the Canadian citizenship test 2026 is in one app: flashcards, chapter quizzes, full mock exams with a real 45-minute timer, narrated audio lessons, and visual study guides — all built from the official Discover Canada study guide. No internet needed. Study anywhere, anytime.
REAL EXAM SIMULATION
Take the test the way IRCC gives it: 20 questions, 45 minutes, 15 correct to pass. Flag questions, skip and come back, change your answers, then submit — nothing is scored until you're done, exactly like the real citizenship test. Every mock test ends with a full review so you know precisely what to fix.
475 FLASHCARDS FROM DISCOVER CANADA
Swipe through the complete question bank covering every chapter of Discover Canada. Mark cards as mastered, bookmark the tough ones, and drill only your bookmarks until they stick.
21 STUDY TOPICS
Learn Canada chapter by chapter — Aboriginal People, Canadian Symbols, Confederation, Government, Elections, Rights & Responsibilities, The Justice System, Canada's Regions, Economy, Important Dates, Founding Peoples, Arts & Sports, Diversity, Language, Honours, the Constitution and more.
LISTEN, DON'T JUST READ
Hands-free narrated audio for the entire study guide. Play it on your commute, at the gym, or while you cook — chapter selection, 0.5x–2x speed, background playback and lock-screen controls. Great for anyone preparing for the canada citizenship test who never finds time to sit down and read.
57 VISUAL STUDY GUIDES
Full-screen infographics that turn the hardest facts — provinces and capitals, branches of government, the road to Confederation, Canadian symbols — into pictures you'll actually remember on test day.
TRACK YOUR READINESS
A readiness score tells you when you're actually ready to book your test. Add your test date for a live countdown, keep a daily challenge streak going, unlock achievements, and watch weak topics turn green.
PRACTICE QUIZZES WITH INSTANT FEEDBACK
311 practice questions with immediate feedback and clear explanations, organised by chapter.
WHO IT'S FOR
New Canadians aged 18–54 preparing for their Canadian citizenship 2026 interview and exam, permanent residents applying for canadian citizenship, and anyone who wants to know Canada better. 
Not affiliated with the Government of Canada or IRCC.

Privacy Policy: https://praveenyuva.host/privacy

MSP Classic - Strut down the red carpet like it's 2014!
Welcome to our retro game filled with MovieStars, ready to take you on a nostalgic trip down the memory lane. Join (or re-join) the MSP community and re-live your childhood memories in the most iconic social dress-up game of all times!
Create your own MovieStar and discover all the coolest MSP fashions - maybe you can even snatch an iconic Rare or two.
Have you ever wondered what happened to your old MSP besties? Why not download the app and find out who is still killing it on the MSP journey to stardom!
All the oldies but goodies are still there!
- Create your MovieStar avatar and show off your awesome fits
- Find your old FRIENDS and make new ones
- CHAT in retro cool chatrooms
- Decorate your own HOME
- Take care of your PETS & BOONIES
- Create Looks, Fashion, ArtBooks & Movies using iconic animations and crazy stickers

- Play fun GAMES with other players and climb to the top of the MovieStar high scores
What are you waiting for? Download the app now and rise to stardom like it’s 2014!
Do you love MSP, but are not feeling the retro vibe? Check out MovieStarPlanet 2 - a new and improved MovieStarPlanet universe where you are always among friends! Download now from the App Store or learn more on www.moviestarplanet2.com

Beginnings Mobile Banking, where Anything is Possible!
Take charge of your finances, anytime, anywhere. With Beginnings Mobile Banking app, your money is just a click away. Whether you’re applying for your next loan or just checking your balance on the go, we're here to make banking simple, secure, and stress-free.
Designed with real life in mind.
We believe banking should work for you. That's why we built an app that's easy to use, packed with features, and backed by real people who care. It's everything you need in the palm of your hand! 
What you can do with the Beginnings Mobile Banking app:
- View your accounts at a glance
- Transfer money between your Beginnings accounts
- Transfer to and from external accounts securely
- Pay your Beginnings loans with ease
- Pay and manage your monthly bills in one place
- Send money to family and friends quickly
- Deposit checks with just a photo
- Activate or freeze your Beginnings Debit Card anytime
- Set up travel alerts so your card works wherever you go
- Manage subscriptions and keep table on recurring charges 
- Sign up for e-statements to cut down on paper clutter
- Apply for a loan right from your phone
- And much more! 
Why Choose Beginnings?
Because we're more than a credit union. We're a partner in your journey, where anything is possible. Whether you’re starting out, starting over, or simply ready to do more with your money, we're here to help you move forward with confidence. 
Download Beginnings Mobile Banking today. Let's make possibilities happen together!

- O primeiro aplicativo do Brasil a permitir a cobrança de energia na recarga de veículos elétricos.
- Sua carteira mais leve, esqueça cartões para desbloquear o eletroposto, faça tudo pelo aplicativo de maneira fácil e rápida.
- Tenha controle total da sua recarga em tempo real, de forma remota e simples.
Simplifique sua rotina e aproveite ao máximo o que a tecnologia da nova mobilidade tem a oferecer.

bluejetty:00039179:ios.name: Stretching, Flex & Splits
bluejetty:00039179:ios.summary: Welcome to your all-in-one Stretching & Flexibility App! This is your personal trainer for stretching exercises right at home. Whether you're looking for stretching for beginners or advanced stretching, our app is designed to help you achie
bluejetty:00039179:ios.description:
Welcome to your all-in-one Stretching & Flexibility App! This is your personal trainer for stretching exercises right at home. Whether you're looking for stretching for beginners or advanced stretching, our app is designed to help you achieve maximum flexibility and improve your overall well-being.
Key Features:
– Professional Trainer Guidance: All exercises are performed by professional trainers to ensure proper form and maximum effectiveness
– Full-body stretching exercises for all muscle groups to boost mobility and flexibility
– Targeted pain relief stretches for specific areas like your back, hips, and shoulders
– Gymnastic flexibility poses to help you test your flexibility and track your progress
– Smart stretching tips tailored for both beginners and advanced users
– Improved splits training with comprehensive 30, 60 or 90-day programs to help you achieve your splits goal (Splits in 30 days - Stretching exercises)
Unlock Your Full Potential:
Begin your journey to enhanced flexibility training with our diverse range of general stretching exercises. They're perfect for improving mobility and easing muscle tension. Every home workout session is beneficial, no matter your current flexibility level.
Dreaming of achieving the splits? Our unique program offers dedicated splits training with options for a 30-day splits challenge, 60-day splits challenge, or even a 90-day splits challenge. Just follow our step-by-step guidance and conquer your splits goal. This is the proven splits workout that truly works!
Experiencing discomfort? Explore our stretching for pain relief section. These targeted stretching exercises are specifically chosen to help alleviate tension and reduce pain in various parts of your body. Find relief from lower back pain or ease neck pain with our effective routines. Experience immediate pain relief with every session.
Our app provides comprehensive support for both beginner stretching and advanced stretching users. You'll find detailed tips and stretching exercise modifications to ensure your stretching routine is both safe and effective.
Track your progress and test your flexibility with our unique flexibility test features, including various gymnastic poses. These poses not only challenge your flexibility, but also help you monitor your improvements in your stretch journey.
All our stretching exercises are perfect for home workouts, making them accessible anytime, anywhere. Improve your body flexibility, gain ultimate flexibility, and make daily stretching a vital part of your routine. 
Start your path to greater flexibility today with our comprehensive stretching app!

Playing with your food has never been more rewarding! In this delectable spin on casual target shooting game, you’ll work your way through appetizing levels that will leave you hungry for more. Aim, timing, and precision are the key to making Bitcoin Food Fight your time killing BFF. 
Bitcoin Food Fight will satisfy your hunger for crypto and your desire to fritter away time while testing your hand-eye coordination. Work your way through an unlimited number of levels of increasing speed and difficulty. Try and beat your high score and collect delectable bite-size cookies that will help you unlock mystery utensils. 
Bitcoin Food Fight is easy to play. Your mission is to launch a specified number of your utensils at the lavish spinning oversized foods without hitting the food item in the same spot! Each level progresses in difficulty by spinning faster, slower, and/or in opposite directions. The number of utensils you must land per level increases, making it more difficult to hit a clean spot. Unlock hidden utensils by collecting the cookies available in each level. 
Download Bitcoin Food Fight today to have your cake and eat it too! You can earn Bling Points in-app if you log into your Bling account.

bluejetty:00186606:ios.name: Greek For All - Vocab
bluejetty:00186606:ios.summary: Learn Biblical Greek vocabulary in a quick, fun and easy way. Study by frequency, by type of word, or by the textbook. Test yourself anytime. Track your progress and pass any vocab test with ease. The app has 1023 words which cover 90% of t
bluejetty:00186606:ios.description:
Learn Biblical Greek vocabulary in a quick, fun and easy way. Study by frequency, by type of word, or by the textbook. Test yourself anytime. Track your progress and pass any vocab test with ease. The app has 1023 words which cover 90% of the New Testament Greek text. 
Summary of Features:
- Beautiful intuitive design.
- 1023 most common words in the Greek New Testament (10+ occurrences)
- 950 top of the art illustrations for most of the words.
- Unique learning algorithm brings up the words you still learn more often.
- Study Greek words by frequency or part of speech.
- Control the length of your tests: test all words in a segment or pick 10, 25 or 50 questions.
- Tracking mode shows your progress based on the test results.
- Vocabulary lists from 9 most popular textbooks - Pronunciation: Erasmian & Modern Greek 
The Greek New Testament contains about 5,400 unique words which combined occur 138,020 times in the texts. The Greek For All – Vocab offers 1,023 of the most common words which cover 90% of all occurrences. In fact, the top 300 (all 50+ words) will appear 110,400 times in the New Testament which is about 80%. 
Even though the word segments may vary between 30-100 words, our unique learning algorithm circulates only 5-10 words in a loop so you could see them more often and learn quicker. As you learn a word, it removes it from the loop and adds another one, thus you can learn at your own speed. 
950 hand drawn images beautifully illustrate the meaning of the words making the learning experience fun and easy.
Download the App today, pass any Greek vocab quiz and start reading the Greek New Testament.
Visit us on the web:
www.greekforall.com
 Check our resources:
Biblical Greek Video Course http://greekforall.com/greek-quest
Greek Charts http://greekforall.com/paradigms
Greek Poster http://greekforall.com/poster
Greek For All Textbook http://greekforall.com/textbook 
Greek For All Answerkey http://greekforall.com/answerkey

bluejetty:00178574:ios.name: SmartThings
bluejetty:00178574:ios.summary:
Quickly and easily connect and control your smart home devices through SmartThings.
SmartThings is compatible with 100s of smart home brands. So, you can control all of your smart home gadgets in one place, including your Samsung Smart TV a
bluejetty:00178574:ios.description:
Quickly and easily connect and control your smart home devices through SmartThings.
SmartThings is compatible with 100s of smart home brands. So, you can control all of your smart home gadgets in one place, including your Samsung Smart TV and smart home appliances.
With SmartThings, you can connect, monitor and control multiple smart home devices quicker and easier. Connect your Samsung smart TVs, smart appliances, smart speakers and brands like Ring, Nest and Philips Hue - all from one app.
Then control your smart devices using voice assistants including Google Assistant
[Key Features]
- Control and check in on your home from wherever you are
- Connect your smart devices across many different brands to work together by setting ‘scenes’
- Build routines that are set on time, weather, and device status, so your home runs smoothly in the background
- Allow shared control by giving access to other users
- Receive status updates about your devices with automated notifications
- Talk to your devices using Google Assistant
- Track, monitor and save money on energy with SmartThings Energy. See how much your home and compatible Samsung devices cost to run, and try various energy saving features, such as AI saving mode, or schedule devices to run during off peak hours.
- Receive recipe recommendations by scanning meal kits, wine, and meat. Plan, shop and prep meals with the help of SmartThings Cooking 
※ Some features may not be available in all countries.
[App requirements]
Some mobile devices may not be supported.
- iOS 17.0 or later / iPhone XR or later / iPad 6 or later
※ App permissions
The following permissions are required for the app service. For optional permissions, the default functionality of the service is turned on, but not allowed. 
[Optional access permissions]
• Apple Health : Used to sync with Apple Health data to give you better Family Care insights
• Apple Music : Used to read music album information
• Bluetooth : Used to scan for nearby devices using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
• Camera: Used to scan QR codes so you can easily add members and devices to SmartThings
• Contacts : Used to get phone numbers of your contacts to send text message notifications
• Location : Used to locate your devices, create routines based on your location, and scan for nearby devices using Wi-Fi
• Local Network : Used to find Wi-Fi connected devices
• Microphone: Used to add certain devices to SmartThings using high-frequency sounds
• Notification : Used to provide notifications about SmartThings devices and features
• NFC : Used to check information about devices that you intend to connect
• Photos : Used to play photos and videos on SmartThings devices
• Voice recognition : Used to convert voice to text

bluejetty:00074609:ios.name: GPS Tracker: Offline Maps, GPX
bluejetty:00074609:ios.summary:
Create, record, import, and export GPX, KML, KMZ tracks and waypoints. The app supports offline maps, background track recording, contains no ads, and is suitable for everything from everyday trips to long journeys and expeditions.
Control
bluejetty:00074609:ios.description:
Create, record, import, and export GPX, KML, KMZ tracks and waypoints. The app supports offline maps, background track recording, contains no ads, and is suitable for everything from everyday trips to long journeys and expeditions.
Control track recording, save waypoints, and check your direction of travel right from your Apple Watch.
Main features:
- background track recording
- support for Apple Watch: start and stop track recording, monitor distance, time, speed, pace, and elevation, save waypoints, and navigate to a selected point using the map or direction indicator
- support for Macs with Apple Silicon
- a fast and modern Mapbox-powered map engine
- quick and convenient offline map downloads
- support for the UTM coordinate system
- route planning
- an improved track recording engine with GPS noise filtering and smoothing
- compare tracks by speed, elevation, and time at any distance, including gains and delays relative to a selected reference track
- a step counter with access to the last three months of data: steps and distance
- coordinate and elevation lookup for any point
- address search
- coordinate search
- compass
- barometer
- track processing and optimization
- download and keep offline maps for your travel area with no time limits
- import and export of GPX, KML, KMZ tracks and waypoints using any method available on your device
- speed and elevation color gradients for imported tracks when that data is available
- speed and elevation color gradients for recorded tracks
- recording of speed and elevation data in tracks
- topographic contour lines in Outdoor mode
- detailed track information: average and maximum speed, duration, route length, and number of waypoints
- support for different units of measurement: kilometers, miles, meters, and feet
- view one or multiple tracks in any app mode, including while recording another track
- create, edit, and delete waypoints in any app mode and at any location
- track recording quality settings, distance filtering, and battery-saving mode
- a pointer to the selected destination waypoint with distance shown on screen
- additional on-screen information: map scale, coordinates, elevation, speed, and step count
- display of current track distance and travel time
- multiple map styles: satellite, streets, hybrid, and dark
- dark theme support
- easy start and stop of track recording
- multiple map orientation modes: compass heading, direction of travel, centered, and north-up
- map tilt with a two-finger pinch gesture
- quick access to saved tracks, waypoints, and downloaded maps
- zoomable and scrollable speed and elevation charts
- a link to the user guide in Settings
- waypoint photos: take photos, store them, open the waypoint on the map from the photo, and share your shots
- photo geotagging: coordinates and shooting data are saved in the text caption and in EXIF/GPS metadata
- Terms of service: https://appsupport.store/terms/
- Privacy policy: https://appsupport.store/privacy/

bluejetty:00081412:android.description:
Looking for artillery games? Enjoy thrilling war shooter games? In Artillery Control – Army Game, you take on the role of a skilled artillery commander. Each artillery battle brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate commander.
The gameplay in Artillery Control – Army Game is inspired by popular shooter games, military games and world war tactics. Every match in this war game will test your skills and turned-based strategic thinking. With immersive military game action, you'll need to strategize your attacks and defense, and carefully plan each move to dominate the battlefield. Engage in war battles against players from around the globe!
MAIN HIGHLIGHTS
• Master Your Aim
In this artillery game, you’ll need to analyze your previous shots and adjust your aim. Use a vertical line with degree markers to perfect your artillery shots. It’s an artillery shooter experience like no other!
• Dynamic Gameplay
With each turn, you’ll face off in a war fight, calculating the best trajectory to destroy your war enemy. Who will make the first successful strike in this immersive artillery shooting game?
• Win and Earn Rewards
Earn coins, bonus stars, and special cards with each victory. Win 5 matches and unlock a massive reward box filled with soldiers, tanks, medics and other bonuses and upgrades.
• Upgrade Your Army
Unlock exciting new military units and game features by upgrading your infantry, artillery, tanks, and more. This isn’t just a heavy artillery game - it’s your chance to lead your war army to victory!
• Constant Progression
Unlock new levels and upgrade your army to become an unstoppable force. Artillery games are all about strategy, and every victory brings you closer to becoming the top artillery master!
Download Artillery Control – Army Game and experience the thrill of war game strategy. Whether you're a fan of war military games, artillery games, or just want to dive into massive warfare, this is the game for you. Ready for artillery games that test your limits?

bluejetty:00065292:ios.summary:

Use Sunshine Coast Mobile Banki
bluejetty:00065292:ios.description:
Sunshine Coast Mobile Banking allows you to do your banking securely at anytime and anywhere – in the palm of your hand! Access and view your account balances, pay your bills, and transfer money conveniently.
Use Sunshine Coast Mobile Banking for fast, easy, on-the-go banking. There are no new passwords to remember – all account login information is the same as your online banking. The app is compatible with iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad.
With Sunshine Coast Mobile Banking you can:
• Log in with your Username and Password
• Set-up Fingerprint ID or Facial Recognition for secure and quick access
• View your account activity, balances, and recent transactions
• Pay bills now or set them up for a future payment date
• View and edit upcoming scheduled bills and transfers
• Send money instantly with Interac e-Transfer®
• Transfer money between your accounts, including different memberships
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques by using your smartphone or tablet
• Display your balances at-a-glance without having to log in with Quick View
It’s simple to use and free*
Security
Your security is our top priority, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full online banking.
Permissions
In order to use Sunshine Coast Mobile Banking, you'll need to grant our app permission to access certain functions on your mobile phone, including:
• Full network access – Allows our app to connect to the Internet.
• Take pictures and videos – Deposit cheques using Deposit Anywhere™ right from your mobile phone by allowing our app access to your phone camera.
• Access to your phone contacts – Get the utmost in convenience by allowing our app to access your list of contacts, that way you can send an Interac e-Transfer® to someone on your contact list without manually setting them up as a recipient in mobile banking.
Access
Access is available to all members who currently use our online banking service. If you’re not a Sunshine Coast Financial member, no problem – simply contact us and set up a new membership. You’ll be set up with access right away.
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Sunshine Coast Financial Account Access Agreement for personal accounts.
*You may incur service charges for various online services depending on the type of account you have. In addition, your mobile carrier may charge you for using your mobile device to access the services provided by our mobile app.

bluejetty:00152944:ios.name: Pirate Shelf Adventure
bluejetty:00152944:ios.summary:
Welcome aboard Pirate Shelf Adventure!
A treasure-sorting, crate-clearing puzzle voyage unlike any other!
Take the captain's helm and tap treasures inside cargo crates, moving them into the lower matching zone. Match 3 of the same to clear
bluejetty:00152944:ios.description:
Welcome aboard Pirate Shelf Adventure!
A treasure-sorting, crate-clearing puzzle voyage unlike any other!
Take the captain's helm and tap treasures inside cargo crates, moving them into the lower matching zone. Match 3 of the same to clear! Empty crates break and let the loot above fall — creating satisfying chain reactions and combo moments.
Strategic Match-3, Reimagined
Break free from flat puzzle boards! Pirate Shelf Adventure introduces a layered crate mechanic that challenges your planning and order of moves. One tap can change everything!
Over 100 Pirate-Themed Treasures
From gold coins and compasses to pirate flags and ancient maps — each item is beautifully designed to capture the mystery and charm of the high seas.
Sorting has never felt so rewarding!
Smart Power-Ups to Escape Traps
Golden Timepiece – Rewind time to undo your last move
Broom Sweep – Move treasures from the matching area back to the standby zone
Shuffle Totem – Randomly shuffle your standby zone for a fresh layout
Master these tools to break deadlocks and trigger clever combos!
Immersive Pirate Vibes
Enjoy crashing waves, creaking wood, and jingling gold! Paired with rich visuals, the game delivers an atmospheric pirate experience that draws you in completely.
Why Play Pirate Shelf Adventure?
Unique 3D crate-based matching system
100+ collectible pirate treasures
Easy to learn, packed with tactical depth
Visually satisfying and stress-relieving
Download now and dive into a world of treasure-sorting fun. Your pirate legacy awaits, Captain!

bluejetty:00070259:ios.description:
Embark on a high-octane journey and dominate the asphalt in Racing Go, the pinnacle of racing games that transforms your device into a gateway to unparalleled speed and excitement. Dive into a world where the roar of engines and the screech of tires on the track define your destiny.
Prepare to unleash the full potential of your driving prowess in "Racing Go - Car Games," a masterpiece among car simulator games that offers an immersive racing experience. With its blend of breathtaking graphics, precise driving simulator mechanics, and heart-stopping racing game action, this game sets a new standard for car driving enthusiasts. Whether you're weaving through traffic in a high-speed chase or battling for pole position, "Racing Go" delivers an adrenaline rush like no other.
Key Features 
◾ Intense Racing Action: Experience the thrill of racing with full-throttle acceleration and nail-biting overtakes.
◾ Sky-High Stunts: Launch into the air with spectacular jumps and stunts that defy gravity.
◾ Precision Handling: Master the art of driving with a simulator that demands skill and finesse.
◾ Championship Dreams: Rise through the ranks and claim your place as a racing legend.
◾ Diverse Car Collection: Drive everything from classic muscle cars to modern supercars.
◾ Competitive Multiplayer: Challenge racers worldwide in multiplayer car games.
◾ Exotic Locations: Race on a variety of tracks, from bustling city streets to scenic coastal roads.
◾ Varied Game Modes: From time trials to elimination races, find your favorite mode.
◾ Strategic Depth: Outsmart your opponents with cunning racing strategies.
◾ Real-Time Thrills: Feel the intensity of racing in real time against live opponents.
◾ Free-to-Play: Jump into the action without spending a penny.
◾ Offline Adventure: Enjoy a compelling story mode, even without an internet connection.
Ready, Set, Racing Go! Master the art of racing with immersive driving simulations & electrifying multiplayer. Enhanced for Tablets: Optimized for an immersive experience on larger screens.
Deep Dive into Features 
Intense Racing Action: "Racing Go" elevates car games to new heights with exhilarating races that demand quick reflexes and a thirst for speed. Feel the rush of racing game excitement as you push your car to its limits.
Sky-High Stunts: Not just any driving simulator, "Racing Go" lets you soar through the air with breathtaking stunts that will leave your heart racing. Perfect your landings to gain an edge over the competition.
Precision Handling: The essence of racing is captured with sophisticated handling dynamics that challenge you to navigate tight corners and dodge rivals with skillful driving.
Competitive Multiplayer: Dive into multiplayer car games where the competition is fierce and every race is a battle for supremacy. Show the world your racing prowess.
Varied Game Modes: With a plethora of modes, "Racing Go" ensures the racing never gets stale. Whether you're climbing the leaderboard in career mode or battling it out in real-time races, there's always a new challenge awaiting.
Game Tips 
Master the art of drifting to save time on corners.
Use slipstreams to catch up to opponents.
Keep an eye on your car's performance and upgrade strategically.
By playing "Racing Go - Car Games," you agree to our terms of service, accessible at Terms of Service. For support, visit Support.
Rev your engines and let the asphalt know your name. "Racing Go - Car Games" is not just a game; it's a journey to the pinnacle of racing glory. 
By downloading the game, you agree to our terms of service, which can be found at https://www.wolvesinteractive.com/legal/term-of-use. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us via https://www.wolvesinteractive.com/support

bluejetty:00170818:ios.description:
Transform your mindset with Spark, the daily gratitude journal designed to help you build positive habits, practise mindfulness, and improve self-care. Spark makes gratitude, affirmations, and personal growth part of your everyday routine with a simple and calming experience designed for lasting positivity.
Whether you want to develop a gratitude habit, boost motivation, improve mindfulness, or create a healthier mindset, Spark helps you stay consistent through guided journalling, daily affirmations, and motivational progress tracking.
HOW SPARK HELPS YOU
Spark combines gratitude journalling, positive affirmations, mindfulness, and habit building into one easy-to-use self-care app.
Create meaningful daily routines with:
* Guided gratitude journalling
* Daily positive affirmations
* Mindfulness and self-reflection tools
* Habit tracking and motivational streaks
* Progress tracking and rewards
* Calm and uplifting daily reminders
Designed to fit seamlessly into your life, Spark encourages positivity, reflection, confidence, and emotional well-being through small daily actions that create long-term change.

Gratitude Journal

* Use gratitude prompts for inspiration and self-reflection
* Track your personal growth and positivity journey
Daily Affirmations

* Explore multiple affirmation categories for different moods and goals
* Strengthen positive thinking and mindfulness every day
Mindfulness & Self-Care
* Create a calming daily mindfulness routine
* Improve emotional well-being through reflection and positivity
* Build healthy self-care habits that support mental wellness
Habit & Progress Tracking
* Earn sparks and track your consistency
* Stay motivated with progress tracking and streaks
* Celebrate positive daily habits and personal milestones
Cloud Backup & Sync
* Securely backup your gratitude journal and affirmations
* Access your entries across devices anytime
WHY USERS LOVE SPARK
* Simple and calming design
* Easy daily journalling experience
* Encourages positivity and mindfulness
* Helps build healthy habits and routines
* Designed for long-term personal growth and motivation
Spark is ideal for anyone interested in gratitude journalling, mindfulness, self-care, affirmations, positive thinking, wellness, and daily motivation.

bluejetty:00144312:ios.description:
تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة دليلك الشامل من الحمل إلى الولادة 
تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة لا غنى عنها لكل امرأة في مرحلة الحمل، تعرفي على موعد الولادة بكل دقة مع معلومات قيمة ودعمًا مستمرًا طوال هذه رحلة الحمل الفريدة. يقدم تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة مزايا تفاعلية وتعليمية تجعل من رحلة الحمل تجربة أكثر سلاسة وإثراء.
الميزات الرئيسية:
تحديد موعد الولادة بدقة عالية
متابعة مفصلة لمراحل الحمل
معلومات عن مواعيد الحمل مقدمة بأسلوب سهل ومبسط
تنبيهات مجدولة للمواعيد الهامة
دعم التقويم الهجري والميلادي: يوفر تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة الدعم لكلا التقويمين الهجري والميلادي بكل سهولة ويسر
تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة هو أكثر من مجرد تطبيق .. إنه رفيقك في كل خطوة على طريق الأمومة. مع تصميمه السهل الاستخدام ومحتواه الغني والمفيد، نضمن لك تجربة متابعة للحمل تتسم بالراحة والإفادة. 
حملي التطبيق الآن وابدئي رحلتك معنا نحو تجربة أمومة ملئية بالمعرفة والثقة.
في رحلة الحمل، تبحث كل امرأة عن مصادر موثوقة وأدوات مفيدة لمتابعة هذه المرحلة الفريدة بكل تفاصيلها، من هنا يأتي دور حاسبة متابعة الحمل يوم بيوم وحاسبة متابعة الحمل اسبوع باسبوع، وكذلك حاسبة متابعة الحمل شهر بشهر، لتوفير دعم غير مسبوق لكل حامل. يُعد دليل المرأة الحامل ودليل الحمل مراجع أساسية تغطي كل ما يتعلق بالحمل، من صور للجنين وصور حمل، مما يجعل الأمور أكثر وضوحًا وإثارة. مع حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة، التي تشمل حاسبة الحمل بالاشهر وحاسبة الحمل بالاسابيع والايام، بالإضافة إلى حاسبة الحمل الصيني وحاسبة الحمل بالهجري، تصبح متابعة الحمل أكثر دقة وسهولة.
سواء كنت تبحثين عن حاسبة الحمل بولد أو ترغبين في حساب الحمل الصحيح باستخدام حساب الحمل بالاشهر الكتروني أو حساب اسابيع الحمل بسهوله، فإن برنامج حساب الحمل بالاشهر وبرنامج حساب الحمل بالاسابيع بالعربي يقدمان لكِ كل ما تحتاجينه لمتابعة هذه الرحلة المذهلة. تطبيق حاسبة الحمل يجعل من متابعة الحمل اسبوع باسبوع، متابعة الحمل يوم بيوم، ومتابعة الحمل بالصور تجربة غنية ومليئة بالمعلومات، مما يساعدك على الاستعداد للحظة نونو جاي وبيبي جاي بكل حب وثق
المعلومات المتوفرة في التطبيق للإرشاد فقط ولا ينبغي اعتباره بديلاً عن الاستشارة الطبية المتخصصة، او التشخيص، أو العلاج. استشر طبيبك المختص للحصول على استشارة طبية مناسبة قبل اتخاذ أي قرارات تتعلق بحملك او بصحتك.

تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة دليلك الشامل من الحمل إلى الولادة 

تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة لا غنى عنها لكل امرأة في مرحلة الحمل، تعرفي على موعد الولادة بكل دقة مع معلومات قيمة ودعمًا مستمرًا طوال هذه رحلة الحمل الفريدة. يقدم تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة مزايا تفاعلية وتعليمية تجعل من رحلة الحمل تجربة أكثر سلاسة وإثراء.

الميزات الرئيسية:

تحديد موعد الولادة بدقة عالية

متابعة مفصلة لمراحل الحمل

معلومات عن مواعيد الحمل مقدمة بأسلوب سهل ومبسط

تنبيهات مجدولة للمواعيد الهامة

دعم التقويم الهجري والميلادي: يوفر تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة الدعم لكلا التقويمين الهجري والميلادي بكل سهولة ويسر

تطبيق حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة هو أكثر من مجرد تطبيق .. إنه رفيقك في كل خطوة على طريق الأمومة. مع تصميمه السهل الاستخدام ومحتواه الغني والمفيد، نضمن لك تجربة متابعة للحمل تتسم بالراحة والإفادة. 

حملي التطبيق الآن وابدئي رحلتك معنا نحو تجربة أمومة ملئية بالمعرفة والثقة.

في رحلة الحمل، تبحث كل امرأة عن مصادر موثوقة وأدوات مفيدة لمتابعة هذه المرحلة الفريدة بكل تفاصيلها، من هنا يأتي دور حاسبة متابعة الحمل يوم بيوم وحاسبة متابعة الحمل اسبوع باسبوع، وكذلك حاسبة متابعة الحمل شهر بشهر، لتوفير دعم غير مسبوق لكل حامل. يُعد دليل المرأة الحامل ودليل الحمل مراجع أساسية تغطي كل ما يتعلق بالحمل، من صور للجنين وصور حمل، مما يجعل الأمور أكثر وضوحًا وإثارة. مع حاسبة الحمل الدقيقة، التي تشمل حاسبة الحمل بالاشهر وحاسبة الحمل بالاسابيع والايام، بالإضافة إلى حاسبة الحمل الصيني وحاسبة الحمل بالهجري، تصبح متابعة الحمل أكثر دقة وسهولة.

سواء كنت تبحثين عن حاسبة الحمل بولد أو ترغبين في حساب الحمل الصحيح باستخدام حساب الحمل بالاشهر الكتروني أو حساب اسابيع الحمل بسهوله، فإن برنامج حساب الحمل بالاشهر وبرنامج حساب الحمل بالاسابيع بالعربي يقدمان لكِ كل ما تحتاجينه لمتابعة هذه الرحلة المذهلة. تطبيق حاسبة الحمل يجعل من متابعة الحمل اسبوع باسبوع، متابعة الحمل يوم بيوم، ومتابعة الحمل بالصور تجربة غنية ومليئة بالمعلومات، مما يساعدك على الاستعداد للحظة نونو جاي وبيبي جاي بكل حب وثق

المعلومات المتوفرة في التطبيق  للإرشاد فقط ولا ينبغي اعتباره بديلاً عن الاستشارة الطبية المتخصصة، او التشخيص، أو العلاج. استشر طبيبك المختص للحصول على استشارة طبية مناسبة قبل اتخاذ أي قرارات تتعلق بحملك او بصحتك.

bluejetty:00131375:ios.description:
Poe brings together the best AI, all in one place. It is designed for seamless conversational experiences, enhanced productivity, and creative content generation.
Key Features: 
- Fast and reliable access to the latest AI models
- Cross-device compatibility
- State-of-the-art multimedia generation
- Combine and compare models in a single chat
- Advanced tools to create customized chatbots
Best-in-Class AI Models, All in One Place
Poe incorporates powerful AI models like OpenAI's o3 and GPT-4.5, Anthropic's Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Google's Gemini 2.0, and multimedia generators from Runway, ElevenLabs, and many more. Experience the cutting edge of AI technology, all in one app.
Chat with multiple bots at once
Compare responses from leading AI models and seamlessly combine any bots for any use case - all within a single chat thread.
AI-Powered Search Engine
Get highly relevant results powered by advanced natural language processing and web search technology to find what you need faster.
Create Stunning Images and Videos Instantly
Transform your ideas into eye-catching images or videos with state-of-the-art generators like FLUX1.1, Ideogram 2.0, Stable Diffusion 3.5, Veo 2, Runway, Hailuo, Dream Machine, and more. 
Talk to Custom Bots & AI Personalities
With access to an ever-growing ecosystem of over 1 million custom bots, you can learn a new language or any topic, chat directly with uploaded files like PDFs and images, search the web for the latest world news, or even have natural conversations with recreations of your favorite characters.
Build & Share Your Own AI Bots
Create your own custom chatbots to generate study plans, curate Spotify playlists, run Python code, and do anything else you can imagine in less than a minute. You can also add custom knowledge bases to deliver more unique experience for users. Have your AI chatbots instantly shared with millions of Poe users!
Poe delivers a seamless AI experience via a user-friendly interface. Download Poe now and step into the future of AI. 
Poe includes both free and subscription bots. Payments for subscriptions will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the 'Manage Subscription' page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. The subscription will renew at the same cost.
By using Poe, you confirm that you have read, acknowledged, and agreed to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
Privacy Policy: https://poe.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://poe.com/tos

bluejetty:00086810:ios.description:
SRAM AXS app connects to your smart devices, enabling personalization of your bike - and ride. That includes configuring components the way you want, keeping a close eye on battery levels and exploring cross-category integrations. (Dropper post with a drop bar groupset? No problem!)
AXS app allows you to control and learn from your bike, bringing new levels of interaction with AXS enabled components. Wake the bike and let it tell you if it is ready to ride based on the battery and pressure levels. The more you know, the more you learn, the more you love.
Technical Features:
+ Enables enhanced shifting modes
+ Personalize multiple bike profiles
+ Enables RD trim adjustment (MicroAdjust)
+ Monitors AXS component battery levels
+ Informs bike’s ready to ride status
+ Updates AXS component firmware
+ Post ride notifications from AXS Web when paired with a compatible bike computer
AXS Component Compatibility: Compatible with any SRAM AXS components, RockShox AXS components, all Power Meters and Wiz devices.

Introducing a language learning app for kids! Help your little ones learn Hindi, Gujarati, Telugu, and Tamil with ease. KidsLipi app features 30+ activities, 300+ words, interactive progress tracking, engaging games, kid-friendly illustrations, and crystal clear audio for each language. It's the perfect app for Hindi, Gujarati, Telugu, and Tamil language learning – and it's absolutely free to download!
FOR TEACHERS 
Teachers can use KidsLipi to assign prebuilt listening and speaking activities through shareable links, LMS-friendly options, or structured homework assignments. Students can practice at home or in class, at their own pace, and receive real-time pronunciation feedback while teachers review progress. Prebuilt activities are available in English (ESL), Spanish, German, and Hindi, where supported.
FOR SCHOOLS
Schools and language programs can use KidsLipi to create custom listening and speaking activities based on their own curriculum, in addition to prebuilt learning activities.
KidsLipi is designed to help beginner to intermediate students build listening, pronunciation, and speaking confidence. For more details, search for “KidsLipi” online.
FOR TEACHERS & PARENTS
Parents and teachers can access assigned school activities by following two simple steps: 1) Register and/or login to the KidsLipi app, and 2) enter the provided activation code. Make sure to refer to the user guide received from your school for detailed subscription activation steps.
WORDS, NUMBERS, COLORS, SHAPES
If you're looking for language learning apps for kids in Hindi or Gujarati, look no further – this is the app for you! With included Hindi Varnamala, Gujarati Kakko, Telugu Varnamala, and much more, your little ones will have a blast learning alphabets and exploring colors, shapes, and more in Hindi, Gujarati, Telugu, and Tamil languages.
EXQUISITE UI & LEARNING METHODS
Featuring an extensive collection of Gujarati, Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil alphabets and words, our app covers all the basics of these languages. For ease of use, non-native speakers can also read the words in English. Designed to be a simple, kid-friendly language learning app, it offers a seamless and enjoyable learning experience. Plus, there are no ads to distract your child's focus.

Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00026516:ios.description:
“Pocket Gamer - Mobile game of the year”
The Battle of Polytopia is an award winning and unique turn based strategy game about controlling the map, fighting enemy tribes, discovering new lands and mastering new technologies. 
You take on the role as the ruler of a tribe and attempt to build a civilization in a turn based competition with the other tribes. It can be played offline line. Perfect for traveling.
 AWARDS:
"IMGA award for excellence in gameplay"
“Gold Winner - Lovie Awards”
MENTIONS:
"If you ever wanted the feeling of a classic Civilization game on your iPhone, The Battle of Polytopia is a worthy contender" - PCMag.com
“This brightly-colored turn based strategy game is difficult to put down” - Mac World
With millions of players, this game has quickly become one of the most popular civilization style games for mobile and has been acclaimed for its sleek user interface and great depth in game play.
FEATURES:
* Free turn based civilization strategy game.
* Single & multiplayer strategy.
* Multiplayer matchmaking (Find players all over the world)
* 4x (eXplore, eXpand, eXploit, and eXterminate)
* Exploration, strategy, farming, building, warfare and technology research.
* Three game modes – Perfection, Domination and Creative
* Diplomacy - Make Peace treaties & Build Embassys
* Invsible Cloaks and Daggers for Stealth attacks.
* Mirror Matches (Meet opponents with the same tribe)
* Configurable map types – Dryland, Lake, Continents, Archipelago and Water World
* Wide range of different tribes with unique nature, culture and game experience. 
* Auto generated maps make each game a new experience.
* Allow offline game play.
* Gameplay in portrait and landscape mode.
* Strategy multiplayer & Pass & Play.
* Leader board with top scores for the best civilization builders.
* Really Cute low poly graphics.

bluejetty:00074077:ios.description:
“Respire” helps you reduce daily stress with just a few mindful breathing sessions.
Simply follow the shape’s movement and let yourself be guided.
Practicing these breathing exercises brings you to a state called “heart coherence”, which has numerous proven health benefits.
Studies show that practicing this technique three times a day provides maximum benefits. With “Respire”, you can set reminders for these sessions at any time of the day or week—perfect for self-care!
KEY FEATURES OF “RESPIRE”
• Recommended and approved by doctors.
• Based on mindfulness principles.
• Slows heart rate and breathing.
• Provides relaxation and calm from the very first session.
• Reduces anxiety and stress.
WITH THE FREE VERSION OF “RESPIRE,” YOU GET:
• Unlimited access to guided breathing sessions.
• Customizable vibrations for practicing with closed eyes.
• A wide selection of sounds.
• An intuitive reminder system.
• Light and dark themes.
• Widgets for quick access to personalized sessions.
• Apple Health integration.
WITH “RESPIRE PLUS” (a single lifetime purchase):
• Access to breathing sessions longer than 5 minutes, including infinite mode.
• A full range of breathing techniques (box breathing, 4-7-8, etc.).
• Continue sessions even with the screen locked.
• A “Smooth Ending”—perfect for falling asleep.
• A timer to manage your practice time.
• New nature sounds, mixable with melodies.
• A more advanced control center.
Whether free or premium, “Respire” makes mindfulness easy and accessible.
This app has been carefully designed so that everyone—including children—can find a moment of well-being in their daily lives.
And because we deeply respect your privacy, “Respire” does not require an account or even an email.
We wish you a relaxing experience!
Privacy policy: https://thequietlife.fr/en/respire/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00065649:ios.description:
Natural Food Guide focuses on fresh and healthy foods. It is the perfect companion for everyone who loves to cook. You can quickly create your own recipes and estimate their nutritive value, or keep a detailed food diary. Whether you are an athlete who wants to push their body to its limits, or you want to lose weight or prevent health issues – nutrition is the key to a healthy lifestyle!
The app is stuffed with information and provides answers to countless questions related to nutrition: What is the omega-6 to omega-3 ratio of linseed oil? What is the glycemic index of basmati rice? Which foods contain a lot of calcium and magnesium at the same time? What are the best sources of vegetarian protein?
■ The Best App For Your Needs
• Configure the app to fit your specific needs.
• Track your diet with the food diary and export detailed analyses as PDF.
• Use the recipe feature as a calorie and nutrition calculator to check your favorite meals!
• Set your own requirements, e.g. high in vitamin C and low in cholesterol.
• Sort the nutrition tables in ascending or descending order by nutrient content.
• Add your own notes and manually adjust ratings where necessary.
• Change the portion size and observe the effect on the daily nutrient requirements in a live preview.
• Create a list of your personal favorites.
■ Dietary Profiles
Thanks to several customized profiles you can easily follow different dietary strategies:
• Low-salt diet for high blood pressure (the profile also helps you follow the DASH diet)
• Healthy fats
• Low glycemic load
• Low carb diet
• Natural foods
• Low added sugar
• Vegetarian and vegan diet
• Low nickel diet for nickel allergy sufferers
■ General Nutrition Facts
• Calories (as kcal or kJ), salt, protein, carbohydrates, sugar, added sugar, starch, fiber, alcohol, water content
• Detailed information on fats: total fat, saturated fat, monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fat, eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), α-linolenic acid (ALA), linolic acid, omega-6/omega-3 ratio
• Cholesterol
• Glycemic index and glycemic load
• Total glucose (for the diet with diabetes)
■ Minerals And Micronutrients
• Minerals: calcium, magnesium, phosphorus, potassium, sodium
• Micronutrients: iron, copper, manganese, selenium, zinc, iodine, nickel
• Find all the important macro and micronutrients in your food
■ Vitamin Content
• Vitamins A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B9 (folic acid), B12, C, D, E and K
• Use the recipe function as a vitamin calculator to plan your supply
► Free version
• Values for calories, carbohydrates, protein and fat
• Daily requirements based on age, weight and activity level
• Access to our food database with more than 1,300 entries
• Dietary profile for "Healthy eating"
• Creation of five entries in the food diary
• Creation of five recipes
• Search function with barcode scanner
• Shopping list
• Detailed articles in the info area
• Personal notes, ratings and favorites
• Adjustable portion sizes
• Direct link to Wikipedia articles
• Supports Dark Mode
• No internet connection required
► PRO version (one time purchase, no subscription)
• Access to all nutrition facts, vitamins, minerals and trace elements
• Access to all dietary profiles and individual requirements
• Filter and sorting function
• Unlimited number of entries in the food diary
• Recipe nutrition calculator
■ About Us
At Baliza, we have been developing nutritional apps that provide tailored nutritional recommendations to people with special dietary needs since 2011. Our award-winning apps are helpful guides that combine carefully researched information from scientific sources with all the capabilities offered by modern smartphones. You get all of our apps as a fair one-time purchase without a subscription.

bluejetty:00124360:ios.description:
Boost your dating confidence with Badoo— the dating app that makes it easy to express your true self.
It’s an encouraging, safe space that’s designed to help you make more meaningful connections.
How? By keeping it simple, helping you take action with confidence, and giving you the features and support you need to find whatever you’re searching for. Whether that’s dates, a long-term relationship, new friends, or chats.
Plus, with our latest tech that aims to block fake, scam, and spam accounts, you can say hello to a fun and authentic dating experience. 
Download Badoo to take your dating confidence to another level."
Back yourself
On Badoo, it’s all about celebrating you and staying true to your needs. With our various features, it’s easy to put yourself out there with confidence.
Trust your experience
Badoo is a platform that prioritises authenticity. Profile photos can be verified and there are strict user guidelines in place.
How Badoo works
Focusing on who you are and what you want, here are some features making it easier for you to meet your kind of people: 
-Advanced Filters: Finesse your search, and save your time
-Profile Questions: Easily champion your personality
- People Nearby: Meet daters around you
- Encounters: Straight forward swiping, right to connect and left for skip
- Video Chat: Connect with your matches through face to face video calling
- Verified profiles: We have a three-step verification process which, once completed, you can choose to only interact with other verified profiles and find friends
- Blur intimate photos: Using AI, our Private Detector feature detects explicit photos and will let you decide if you want to view or block the image
- Deception Detector: Our new tech that aims to block fake, scam, and spam accounts, so you can have a fun and authentic dating experience"
Go Premium
Maximise your dating experience. When you upgrade to Badoo Premium, you’ll unlock plenty of features that will make it even easier to find meaningful connections:
- See who's already liked you
- Find exactly what you’re looking for with unlimited Advanced Filters
- Get your messages read first
- Send unlimited likes
 - Control who sees your profile with Invisible Mode
- Undo accidental left swipes 
- And much more...
The price varies by country and may change without notice, but you can always see the exact price in the app. We will charge your card and your subscription will be automatically renewed unless you deactivate the automatic recharge a minimum of 24 hours before the end of your current subscription period. Badoo Premium is flexible and adapts to your needs - you can cancel your subscription at any time.
For more information, read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://www.badoo.com/privacy
https://badoo.com/terms
Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Badoo, along with Bumble and Fruitz

bluejetty:00120211:ios.description:
The Institute of Catholic Culture is an adult catechetical organization, faithful to the Magisterium of the Catholic Church, and dedicated to the Church’s call for a new evangelization. The Institute seeks to fulfill its mission by offering educational programs structured upon the classical liberal arts and by offering opportunities in which authentic Catholic culture is experienced and lived. This application is designed to provide mobile access to over 1000 hours of programming in the Institute's extensive library and to allow for participation throughout the week in our live events.
LIVE EVENTS
View and register for upcoming live events and courses, join live webinar sessions, post discussion questions, and browse media published from previous sessions.
OUR EXTENSIVE LIBRARY
Browse over 1000 hours of audio and video programming from our library of lectures, Gospel reflections, and self-paced courses. Browse the library by category, instructor, use filter and keyword searches, save your favorite programs, and download audio for offline listening. Your place is automatically saved in any video or audio media and synced across your devices. You can watch a video on your phone and pick up from where you left off on your computer.
LECTURE RESOURCES
Expand your study by using supplementary educational resources provided for lectures including readings, online references, maps, and discussion questions.
All are welcome to join the Institute of Catholic Culture and seek the Truth revealed in our Lord and God, Jesus Christ.

bluejetty:00000592:ios.description:
CNAs, LPNs, and RNs across the U.S. use ESHYFT to find and work shifts at long term care facilities.
Are you a CNA, LPN, or RN looking for a flexible work schedule? Maintain work-life balance by signing up for ESHYFT! ESHYFT is an easy way to pick up per diem nursing shifts and connect to local facilities that need you.
Whether you're a CNA, LPN, RN, STNA, CMA, QMA, GNA, or CMT, using ESHYFT is easy!
Create your account - Download the ESHYFT app and click ‘Sign in or create an account’ to create your account. 
Find shifts - Find open per diem shifts in your area from long term care facilities.
Get paid - Get weekly pay or request instant payment to receive your earnings deposited into your account in minutes.
Why use ESHYFT?
NURSES LOVE ESHYFT - ESHYFT is the top rated app for per diem shifts 
FLEXIBILITY - Use our robust filters and sorting functions to find shifts that work with your schedule.
EARN MORE - Work as much or as little as you want, earn additional income when you need it.
CONTROL - Set your own schedule and pick only the shifts you want!
24/7 SUPPORT - Talk to someone whenever you have a question, our team is here to help!
Benefits you'll love!
Get Paid Faster - We have instant pay to give you easy and fast access to your earnings
Shifts from hundreds of facilities - We work hard to bring more and more facilities to the platform, so you have more choice and flexibility on where to work.
Advanced sorting and filtering - Adjusting sorting and filtering settings in the ESHYFT app is an easy way to narrow the results of shifts in an area and find the best shifts for your schedule.
Instant book shifts - Unlike a regular shift, an Instant book is a shift that you can get booked for instantly! You do not need to wait for a facility manager to confirm you, you will be instantly booked for it.
Direct communication with facilities - Chat with long term care facilities in real-time about any questions or concerns you may have about working at their facility.
Cancellation & Send Home Pay - We value your time. If a facility cancels you last minute or sends you home, you receive 4 hours of guaranteed pay.

bluejetty:00081833:ios.description:
Play the CLASSIC Euchre card game on your IOS device! Made by Mobilityware – the leading card parlor game developer – this easy to learn card game is perfect for fun and relaxation. March through rounds, don’t get euchred, and get in the barn and win!
How to win is simple: reach 10 points before your opponents!
But victory is both challenging and rewarding against opponents with adaptive skill levels. Precision, strategy and quick thinking are needed to master the game. Euchre challenges you to outwit your opponents and reach victory through strategic play and teamwork. We’ve also included clear tutorials to help you learn the game of Euchre at your own pace. Relax and train your brain as you compete in the game of Euchre!

Play the fun and relaxing version of Euchre
- Hop into the classic Euchre gameplay you know and love
- Learn the game of Euchre in a low pressure, easy to learn environment!
- Drop in drop out gameplay means Euchre is ready to play whenever you are!
- Use expressive emojis to let your opponent know you are winning big!
- Play offline – bots are available to play whenever and wherever
- Need help? Use the unlimited hints and undos!
New feature: Leagues!
- Take on several groups of players as you work your way through the ranks!
- Learn advanced gameplay techniques as opponent skill increases alongside yours
- Perfect your game and earn rewards!
Introducing Special Opponents!
- Face off against a colorful new competitor every month and earn unique boosters, hats, emotes, and avatars.
- Embrace the rivalry and become the champion you were meant to be.
The classic Euchre game, for beginners and Pros alike
- Over 300 titles to earn and collect!
- Track your high scores across several games
- Push for a new personal best with each hand of classic cards you play!
- Improve your play with deep statistics. Watch as you improve your strategy through each game!
Play Euchre just like you remember
- Special badges for marches, euchreing your opponent, and getting in the barn
- Choose either portrait or landscape to play
- Never lose a game with save states, even when the app closes!
Please see our privacy policy at http://mobilityware.com/privacy-policy.php
