bluejetty:00155238:ios.name: AllShare Cast ™
bluejetty:00155238:ios.summary: Transform your TV into a smart, interactive screen with our easy-to-use screen mirroring and casting app. Designed to make sharing your favorite media effortless, our app allows you to cast photos, videos, music, and even web content direct
bluejetty:00155238:ios.description:
Transform your TV into a smart, interactive screen with our easy-to-use screen mirroring and casting app. Designed to make sharing your favorite media effortless, our app allows you to cast photos, videos, music, and even web content directly from your phone to your TV. Whether you’re looking to enjoy personal memories on a bigger screen, present slideshows, or enjoy streaming content without restrictions, this app turns your TV into the ultimate multimedia center.
Key Features:
Instant Screen Mirroring:
Mirror your phone’s screen to your TV in real-time. With ultra-low latency, you can enjoy gaming, video calls, presentations, and more on a larger screen without interruptions. Screen mirroring is perfect for family gatherings, work meetings, or online learning—whatever you want to display, show it clearly and in high resolution.
Photo & Video Casting:
Bring your memories to life by casting your phone’s photos and videos directly to your TV. Relive family vacations, birthdays, and special events with vibrant clarity. With just a tap, share those moments with everyone in the room, no cables required.
Stream Online Content:
Take your favorite online videos and websites directly from your phone to the big screen. Browse through YouTube, Vimeo, and other video streaming platforms on your phone, and play content on your TV for an immersive experience. No need for separate apps or confusing setups—just select the content, cast, and enjoy.
Audio & Music Playback:
Fill the room with your favorite playlists by casting music from your phone to the TV. Connect to high-quality speakers for an immersive sound experience. Whether it’s for a workout, a family gathering, or relaxing alone, bring your music to life on larger speakers and experience every beat.
Easy Remote Control:
Use your phone as a remote to control your TV’s settings, such as adjusting volume, navigating apps, and more. This feature eliminates the need for additional remotes and keeps everything accessible from your phone, making it simpler to find what you want and enjoy your content uninterrupted.
Seamless Connectivity with Multiple Devices:
Our app supports various devices and TV brands, including Samsung, Roku, LG, Sony, Chromecast, and more. Connect with ease and switch between devices as you need. With universal compatibility, our app ensures you can use it with any major TV brand without hassles.
Web Content Projection:
Enjoy the convenience of browsing the internet from your phone and displaying it on the TV. Read news articles, view recipes while cooking, watch tutorials, or explore websites with family and friends. The bigger screen means everyone can see and enjoy the content at the same time.
How It Works:
Connect to the Same Wi-Fi Network:
Ensure both your phone and TV are connected to the same Wi-Fi network to enable fast and secure connectivity.
Select Your Media:
Choose photos, videos, music, or online content from your phone to cast.
Cast with a Single Tap:
Tap the cast icon, select your TV, and enjoy your content on the big screen instantly.
Ideal For:
Family Gatherings:
Share photos and videos with everyone in the room, bringing family memories to life on the big screen.
Gaming Enthusiasts:
Get a bigger view for mobile gaming, with minimal lag and better visuals, so you can immerse yourself in the gameplay.
Business & Education:
Use the screen mirroring function for presentations, educational content, or virtual meetings, making it easy to collaborate with others and share visual aids.
Movie Nights & Streaming Enthusiasts:
Turn any night into movie night by streaming your favorite films, series, and videos from your phone to the TV, creating a cinematic experience right at home.
Terms of Use: https://byvn.net/Kw6q
Privacy Policy: https://byvn.net/64yQ

bluejetty:00183999:ios.description:
Free ATM network. Limits apply*. No surprise fees. No worries. Try GoBank’s award-winning mobile app now!
GoBank is a checking account made for people who are fed up with big banks and their big fees, and designed to be accessed on a mobile phone. It’s fast (works like your other favorite apps), fair (no surprise fees) and feature-rich (keep reading for a sneak peek).
WHY GOBANK?
NO SURPRISE FEES
Seriously. GoBank has no surprise fees. Check out GoBank.com/NoWorries to see what we mean.
GET YOUR PAY UP TO 2 DAYS FASTER WITH ASAP DIRECT DEPOSIT™
Direct Deposit early availability depends on timing of payor’s payment instructions and fraud prevention restrictions may apply. As such, the availability or timing of early direct deposit may vary from pay period to pay period. Make sure the name and social security number on file with your employer or benefits provider matches what’s on your GoBank account exactly. We will not be able to deposit your payment if we are unable to match recipients.
SIGN UP FOR DIRECT DEPOSIT
If you’re not eligible for the above, you can still sign up for direct deposit to get your pay faster than a paper check!
FREE ATMS*.
* See app for free ATM locations. 4 free withdrawals per calendar month, $3.00 per withdrawal thereafter. $3 for out-of-network withdrawals and $.50 for balance inquiries, plus any fee the ATM owner may charge. Limits apply.
PAY BILLS
Pay rent, or any bill with the GoBank app or website. Need to send a check to your landlord (or anyone else)? No problem. We’ll mail the check for free.
SEND MONEY FAST
Quickly send money to friends, family and even the dog groomer who have GoBank accounts. We notify them via email or text message.
DEPOSIT CASH
Just take your GoBank debit card and cash to any participating retail location. Swipe your card or hand it to the cashier, and the cash will be deposited to your account automatically. Fees may apply.
MOBILE DEPOSITS
Our nearest bank branch is in your pocket. Use your phone to scan a check and deposit it into your account. You may be asked to upload your ID.
FREE ADVICE: FORTUNE TELLER™
Use the Fortune Teller to double-check your budget before you spend. Just tell us how much it costs, and we’ll give you a quick yay or nay based on the budget you’ve created.
FYI: We'll need to successfully verify your ID before you can use all of GoBank's award-winning features.
Questions about your GoBank account?
Call us at the number on the back of your card (24/7 support).
Or log in to gobank.com & email us through the Contact Us page.
Stay in touch with us!
Follow us on Twitter @GoBank and on Instagram @GoBankOfficial. While you’re at it, like us on Facebook.com/GoBank. We’d love to meet you and answer any questions you may have.

Whether you're looking for better prices on medications or you need a convenient way to manage your medications, arrange for prescription delivery, or schedule pickups, NimbleRx is the all-in-one solution for your prescription management needs.

1. Prescription Management Made Easy: Say goodbye to the hassle of keeping track of multiple prescriptions and their refill dates. NimbleRx provides a user-friendly interface that allows you to effortlessly manage your medications all in one place. Never miss a dose again!
2. Prescription Delivery and Pickup: No more waiting in long pharmacy lines or worrying about running out of medications. NimbleRx offers a convenient prescription delivery service, ensuring that your medications are delivered right to your doorstep. Alternatively, you can schedule pickups at your preferred pharmacy for added flexibility.
3. Reminders and Alerts: Stay on top of your medication schedule with customizable reminders and alerts. NimbleRx will notify you when it's time to take your medications or when refills are due, making it easy to maintain your health and adhere to your prescribed treatment plan.
4. Secure and Confidential: Your privacy is our top priority. NimbleRx employs advanced security measures to protect your personal information and medication history. Rest assured that your data is encrypted and stored securely.
5. User-Friendly Interface: NimbleRx's intuitive design ensures a seamless user experience. Navigate through your prescriptions, track refills, and set up delivery or pickup options effortlessly. The app is designed to be accessible and easy to use for ages 12+.
6. The Best Prices: Search for the best prices for new or existing medications.
Download NimbleRx today and experience the future of prescription management. Simplify your life and take control of your health with the power of technology. Say goodbye to medication mishaps and hello to peace of mind!
Visit nimblerx.com to learn more.

Wake Up On Time. Every Time.
Erly is the #1 accountability app for waking up early and staying consistent.
Join many others who have broken free from snoozing and built unstoppable morning streaks.
Whether you’ve struggled with alarms, snoozing, or motivation, Erly's accountability + gamification system makes it impossible to fall back asleep. Get up, record your wake up time, and prove to yourself you’re ready to own the day.
---
WAKE UP WITH PURPOSE
Alarms alone don’t work. Erly adds accountability and structure so you can finally stop snoozing and start thriving.
SMART ALARMS
Alarms that won’t turn off until you complete a mission. No snoozes. No excuses.
BUILD UNBREAKABLE STREAKS
Each morning is a clear win or loss with no excuses and no late submissions. Watch your streak grow as you stack successful mornings.
MAKE IT REAL
To keep your streak alive, record your wake-up before your target wake-up time. No shortcuts. No cheating. Just real action.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Track your current streak, best streak, and daily wins at a glance. Your wake-up history keeps you honest and motivated.
LOCK IN YOUR GOALS
Once you’re within 4 hours of your wake-up time, your goal locks in. No moving the goalpost after you’ve overslept.
---
POWERFUL FEATURES
- Daily accountability check-in
- Streak tracker & history strip
- Locked deadlines to prevent excuses
- Gamified progress system to keep motivation high
- Simple, clean interface that keeps you on track
---

DISCLAIMER: This app is a tool for accountability and habit formation. It does not provide medical advice.

Skip-Bo™: Solitaire Card Game is now officially on mobile! Brought to you by the creators of UNO! and Phase 10, this classic board card game offers a fun and competitive experience designed for every card game lover.
This new take on the classic solitaire card games will get you hooked and you won't be able to stop playing!
Similar to Rummy and Yahtzee, Skip-Bo™ requires players to think strategically to solve problems. With its simple rules and engaging gameplay, it has become a tycoon in the world of card and board games, enjoyed by players of all ages and skill levels.
▶ ▶ Classic for a reason!◀◀
Skip-Bo™: Solitaire Card Game is a fan-favorite and loved by millions around the world. Now you can play the official Skip-Bo solitaire card game just the way you remember! It’s the perfect digital board game experience, offering everything from intense 2 player battles to group matches. Play offline anywhere at all, or challenge real opponents in our online mode! Skip-Bo™: Solitaire Card Game has fun in spades.
▶ ▶ Play and explore!◀◀
There are hundreds of levels just waiting for you to beat! Cruise through a richly illustrated world as you clear levels and progress through the maps. Harvest bundles of coins along the way! In this farm adventure mode, challenge friends in 2 player matches or compete online. It's the ultimate board game and solitaire showtime!
▶ ▶ Customize your adventure! ◀◀
Whether you’re new to Skip-Bo™, a loyal fan, a solitaire player, or just need a refresher, we have levels for everyone! New levels are added regularly and will challenge your skills in this strategic and fun board card game. Clear the pyramid of Stock cards to win!
▶ ▶ Download and play for free today!◀◀
Like Mattel's other iconic brands Barbie, UNO and Phase 10, Skip-bo has been a source of joy for many players over the years. Download now to relive the fun online with friends and families anytime, anywhere!

bluejetty:00035280:ios.description:
Get ready for an epic adventure in Pal Go! This fantasy tower defense game offers a unique blend of strategy, crash mechanics, merges, and competitive PvP battles. Easy to play, hard to master, Pal Go challenges you to protect your tower and emerge victorious against all odds.
As a brave monster hunter, your mission is to defend the Acorn Kingdoms from the dark wizard Mazdor the Black and his evil army. Assemble your pals, merge your units, rank them up, and lead them into epic battles against the forces of darkness. Unlock your monsters’ unique abilities to unleash devastating attacks and ensure victory. Every position on the battlefield can be the difference between crashing to defeat or rising in triumph, so deploy your best units wisely to overcome the Dark Army.
Merge your troops to create powerful combinations and bring even more epic moments to your battles! Don’t let your defenses crash—merge strategically to build unstoppable forces.
Dominate the battlefield in PvP mode! Battle other players in fast-paced skirmishes where strategic thinking and quick reflexes are your greatest weapons. Break through their defenses, climb the leaderboard, and earn legendary rewards. In Pal Go, your wits and skills will determine who wins the ultimate tower defense showdown!
Are you ready to answer the call? Embark on your heroic journey now!
Key Features:
- FUN & EPIC BATTLES: Immerse yourself in thrilling battles with a new roguelite skill experience, offering endless combinations.
- FORGE ALLIANCES: Team up with pals to conquer your adversaries.
MERGE & RANK UP: Strengthen your troops by merging them to take on formidable foes.
- CHOOSE YOUR STRATEGY: Customize your approach by selecting different hero roles and skills for maximum success in defense.
- PVP COMPETITION: Challenge other players in PvP battles and rise through the ranks.
- VARIOUS STAGES: Experience the challenge of each new tower defense stage with varying difficulties.
- ONGOING UPDATES: Discover new heroes, towers, and participate in time-limited events to keep the excitement going.
==============================

bluejetty:00087965:ios.description:
Begin your adventure with sword and magic in a fantasy open world. Gain experience, master new abilities, upgrade your weapons and equipment, modify your gear, and forge your own path through a world filled with danger, mystery, and endless battles.
Way of Retribution is constantly growing. Regular updates bring new regions, enemies, quests, equipment, progression systems, and improvements to the game.
Combat System
Every encounter can become a challenge. Fight monsters, elite enemies, bosses, invaders from other worlds, and other players in a seamless open world.
Experience dynamic battles with target-based combat, companions, PvE encounters, co-op activities, arenas, and PvP.
Deep Character Progression
Create your hero with a full appearance editor and develop a build that fits your playstyle.
Choose from a wide variety of weapons, armor, skills, attributes, and magical powers. Become a warrior, spellcaster, healer, duelist, defender, or create your own hybrid class through equipment and abilities.
Game Features
- Open fantasy world
- Character customization
- Weapon and armor enhancement
- Skills and elemental progression
- PvE and PvP battles
- Dungeons, arenas, and elite enemies
- Trading and clan activities
- Regular content updates
Official Communities
Follow the latest news and updates:
Discord: https://discord.gg/juTh9kg
Backstory
There was once light and darkness. Where one faded and the other grew stronger, worlds were born. From these forces came powerful beings, worshipped as gods.
But one day, a creature with a dark soul overthrew mighty gods and shattered the balance of the world. Boundaries weakened, ancient powers awakened, and creatures from different realms crossed into lands that were not their own.
A world of harmony became a battlefield without borders.
To resist the spreading chaos, warriors rose, kingdoms were built, relics were claimed, and beacons of rebirth appeared across the world. Yet even resurrection came at a price. Memories faded, purpose was lost, and many who returned again and again were consumed by madness.
From the union of light and darkness, humanity was created to end the endless war. But people inherited both hope and corruption. They built kingdoms, mastered relics, challenged gods, and became part of the same cycle

bluejetty:00083801:ios.description:
U.S. license plates only
Looking for a used car? Want to learn more about a vehicle? Working in towing, detailing, auto repair, bodywork, dealerships, insurance, fleet management, or any other auto related industry? This epic app is perfect for you!
Enter a license plate or VIN and quickly get information on vehicle specs, auction records, sales records, VIN history, accident and salvage records, market values, recalls, owners, equipment and features, damages, and many other details.
Key Features:
VIN DECODER - Instantly decode any vin using our our advanced decoder engine to reveal make, model, year, engine type, trim, drivetrain, recalls, and other vehicle details.
LICENSE PLATE LOOKUP - No VIN? No problem. Enter a license plate and retrieve vin in seconds.
VIN SCANNER - Epic VIN scanner to avoid typing 17 digits by hand and quickly lookup vehicles.
LICENSE PLATE SCANNER - Use your phone's camera instead of typing to make the process even faster.
VEHICLE HISTORY REPORT - Run a quick vin check to get insights on previous owners, sales history, title issues, recalls, accident records, damage records, services, title brands, and any other related information - like a vehicle wiki in your pocket. NMVTIS approved providers vehicle history reports from EpicVIN and VINdata can be purchased directly in the app.
MARKET VALUE - Check real-time vehicle market value and detailed specs including MPG, towing capacity, and safety ratings.
DAMAGE MARKING TOOL - Visually mark dents, scratches, or collision damage directly on vehicle diagrams, anything from front bumper to rear bumper.
PHOTO UPLOADS - Take and upload photos of the vehicle for documentation or inspection.
RECALLS - Instantly see any manufacturer recall notices or defects tied to the vin.
SALES RECORDS - Track ownership transfers and dealer resales to verify vehicle history.
ADVANCED SEARCH - Easily find and filter past vehicle lookups to revisit reports or track jobs.
Perfect For:
• Buyers researching before a purchase
• Towing services and roadside assistance
• Auto detailing, paint correction, and reconditioning
• Repair shops and technicians
• Car dealerships and used vehicle sales
• Insurance adjusters and claim inspectors
• Fleet managers and vehicle operators
Have a feature idea? hello@platelookup.app

bluejetty:00119053:ios.summary: Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the n
bluejetty:00119053:ios.description:
Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths and the relationship of each truth to the other: These five truths are Krishna, or God, the individual soul, the material world, action in this world, and time. The Gita lucidly explains the nature of consciousness, the self, and the universe. It is the essence of India's spiritual wisdom.
Bhagavad Gita, is a part of the 5th Veda (written by Vedavyasa - ancient Indian saint) and Indian Epic - Mahabharata. It was narrated for the first time in the battle of Kurukshetra, by Lord Krishna to Arjun.
The Bhagavad Gita, also referred to as Gita, is a 700–verse Dharmic scripture that is part of the ancient Sanskrit epic Mahabharata. This scripture contains a conversation between Pandava prince Arjuna and his guide Krishna on a variety of philosophical issues.
Faced with a fratricidal war, a despondent Arjuna turns to his charioteer Krishna for counsel on the battlefield. Krishna, through the course of the Bhagavad Gita, imparts to Arjuna wisdom, the path to devotion, and the doctrine of selfless action. The Bhagavad Gita upholds the essence and the philosophical tradition of the Upanishads. However, unlike the rigorous monism of the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita also integrates dualism and theism.
Numerous commentaries have been written on the Bhagavad Gita with widely differing views on the essentials, beginning with Adi Sankara's commentary on the Bhagavad Gita in the eighth century CE. Commentators see the setting of the Bhagavad Gita in a battlefield as an allegory for the ethical and moral struggles of the human life. The Bhagavad Gita's call for selfless action inspired many leaders of the Indian independence movement including Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, who referred to the Bhagavad Gita as his "spiritual dictionary".

• Fast and responsive user interface

• App fully functional without internet

Second, this guy also has a Th.M. from Dallas Theological Seminary so he makes the Greek and Hebrew easy to use and
bluejetty:00062844:ios.description:
This is a free Bible app with distinctives. 
First, the guy that wrote it was AOL's Chief Architect so it is easy to use. 
Second, this guy also has a Th.M. from Dallas Theological Seminary so he makes the Greek and Hebrew easy to use and the differences between Bible translations understandable. 
Most apps present Bible translations like a smorgasbord of choices without giving any way to choose between them. This app places the Greek and Hebrew alongside a spectrum of translations--from the most literal to the most paraphrased. It also color codes them so you know what each one is good at: blues are word-for-word translations and are accurate to the specific words, greens are phrase-for-phrase translations and are accurate to the phrase, and earth tones are thought-for-thought translations and are good at thoughts. 
Finally, it doesn't need the Internet or WiFi. You can go out under a tree somewhere and have full and fast access to all the Bibles.
You might think of this app as the "AOL" (the simple one) of Bible apps.

Discover the #1 football prediction game to play with friends, already enjoyed by over 3.7 million players!

Put your football knowledge to the test in special tournaments and try to win awesome rewards:
- Official match tickets
- Football shirts of your favorite teams
- Official balls and exclusive merchandise
WHY DOWNLOAD MON PETIT PRONO?
- A 100% free, simple, and addictive football prediction game.
- All your favorite competitions: Ligue 1 McDonald's, Ligue 2 BKT, Champions, and major international tournaments.
- Live updated results and standings after every match.
- The perfect app to spice up every football night and banter with your mates.
Get your predictions ready, set up your leagues, and become the prediction king!
Download MPP now and start predicting!

bluejetty:00162645:ios.description:
М.Видео больше, чем техника. Это маркетплейс, где есть диваны, сантехника, одежда, аксессуары и другие популярные товары для дома и семьи. В приложении интернет-магазина есть всё: от последних моделей телефонов до бытовой техники и электроники и мебели для дома. Удобные способы оплаты, оформление заказа онлайн 24/7, самовывоз покупок из магазина или доставка – и всё это с выгодой благодаря бонусам и гибкой рассрочке в нашем онлайн-маркете.
Почему выбирают М.Видео — маркетплейс техники и электроники?
- онлайн-маркет с огромным ассортиментом: электроника и бытовая техника (например, телевизор, холодильник, телефон), разнообразные товары для дома, мебель и сантехника, спорттовары и товары для детей;
- более 300 магазинов по России и сеть ПВЗ для самовывоза;
- онлайн-маркет для удобного заказа и покупки через телефон;
- сканер QR-кодов, чтобы узнать характеристики товара и получить информацию об акциях маркета электроники;
- быстрая доставка электроники и бытовой техники на дом;
- выгодные акции и бонусы;
- рассрочка на покупки и трейд-ин;
- персональные предложения от маркетплейса.
ПОКУПАЙ С ВЫГОДОЙ
В приложении маркетплейса М.Видео тебя ждут эксклюзивные предложения, акции на электронику, бытовую технику, товары для дома, красоты и здоровья, которые доступны в доставке и интернет-магазине Эльдорадо на тех же выгодных условиях. Заказывай в смартфоне товары для строительства и ремонта: инструменты, мебель, сантехнику, садовую технику, текстиль.
ПОДПИСКА М.Комбо
Подписка открывает доступ к привилегиям маркетплейса: персональная сервисная служба, дополнительные бонусы (1 000 в месяц), бесплатная доставка и утилизация, скидки на услуги ремонта и установки (даже купленной не в нашем маркетплейсе электроники). Также ты получишь эксклюзивные скидки и доступ к акциям. Бытовая техника, электроника и товары для дома – с дополнительной выгодой в подписке.
ГИБКАЯ РАССРОЧКА И КРЕДИТЫ
Маркетплейс М.Видео предлагает рассрочку без переплат и оформление кредита прямо в приложении онлайн-маркета. Выбирай условия рассрочки и оплачивай покупки долями — просто и удобно. Рассрочка действует на любые покупки в маркетплейсе: бытовая техника, электроника, детские товары, товары для дома и спортивные товары.
ОБМЕНЯЙ ТЕХНИКУ НА СКИДКУ
С программой трейд-ин в М.Видео легко обменять старую технику и электронику на новую! Сдай старый телефон и получи скидку на товары в магазине или деньги на карту. Обнови бытовую технику и электронику — маркетплейс позаботится о выгодных предложениях.
ДОСТАВКА И УСТАНОВКА В ОДИН ДЕНЬ
Забери покупку в удобном магазине сети или выбери доставку на дом. Наш интернет-магазин позаботится о том, чтобы доставка и установка были выполнены за один день! Мы — онлайн-маркет, где быстрая доставка — главное преимущество.
САМОВЫВОЗ И УДОБНЫЕ ТОЧКИ ВЫДАЧИ
Маркетплейс позволяет выбрать самовывоз из более чем 300 магазинов по всей России или наших ПВЗ (рядом с привычными Озон и WB). Так же доступно получение заказа в ПВЗ Яндекс Маркет, СДЭК, М.Видео и в магазинах «Пятёрочка», «Перекрёсток».
ШИРОКИЙ ВЫБОР
В приложении маркетплейса собран огромный каталог товаров от популярных брендов — Bork, Samsung, Xiaomi, Apple, Xbox, Tefal, Kitfort, Huawei, Askona. А также эксклюзивные товары для покупок с доставкой, доступные только через интернет-магазин. Здесь ты найдёшь всё, что нужно: телефон, телевизор, холодильник, еду и другие товары для дома. Просто оформи заказ через наш интернет-магазин техники, и бытовая техника и электроника твои!
ПОЛНЫЙ КОНТРОЛЬ ПОКУПОК
Приложение М.Видео — это не просто онлайн-маркет, но помощник на каждом этапе покупки: от выбора товара до получения. Покупки можно оформить с доставкой или самовывозом через интернет-магазин, а также воспользоваться бонусами и скидками, чтобы сделать покупки выгоднее.
М.Видео — надёжный онлайн-маркетплейс электроники и бытовой техники для тех, кто ценит широкий выбор, удобство и выгоду. Устанавливай приложение, покупай в онлайн-маркете М.Видео и получай максимум от каждой покупки.

bluejetty:00123979:ios.name: Jelly Drops!
bluejetty:00123979:ios.summary: Swipe, match, and pop tasty jelly drops to puzzle your way through hundreds of fun levels in this new match 3 puzzle adventure! Challenge your brain with fun and creative puzzles, create powerful boosters, and relax with cute squishy jellie
bluejetty:00123979:ios.description:
Swipe, match, and pop tasty jelly drops to puzzle your way through hundreds of fun levels in this new match 3 puzzle adventure! Challenge your brain with fun and creative puzzles, create powerful boosters, and relax with cute squishy jellies!
To reach the high score, you'll have to get a good feel for the game board, plan your moves carefully, and use boosters strategically to get out of sticky situations. Smash and pop jelly drops, find gummy bears and crunch chocolate obstacles across hundreds of levels full of tasty game play.
How To Play Jelly Drops!
• Swap and match 3 or more candy jellies of the same type to pop them!
• Make unique combinations to get awesome bombs and create fantastic explosions!
• Leverage powerful boosters to help clear obstacles!
Jelly Drops is different from other free puzzle games - your fun is the most important ingredient! No always online, no timers, no bells and whistles; just lots and lots of frantic puzzle fun!
What makes Jelly Drops special?
Free items every day!
Other free match 3 games make you pay for booster items, but with the daily spin in Jelly Drops you have the chance to get them for free every single day!
Unlimited lives!
Where's the fun in waiting for new lives just to play more? That's what we thought! So in this game, there's no lives, no timers, no hearts - play as much as you want whenever you want!
Straight-up puzzle fun!
The puzzles are the best part of any match 3 game! So instead of adding lots of boxes you need to click through and world maps to scroll, Jelly Drops keeps it simple and gives you what you came for: hundreds of fun and challenging Match 3 & blast puzzles!
No data needed!
Tired of worrying about your internet connection every time you want to play a game? Don't! Jelly Drops will work even with no internet and no wifi. It's so simple: just start the app and start the fun!
Addictive Match 3 game play!
Relax and enjoy the simple yet addictive Match 3 & blast puzzles, crunch tasty candy and smash squishy jellies. With dynamic obstacles, creative level layouts and varied challenges, you'll always be wondering what puzzle challenge might be waiting for you in the next level.
Completely free!
Best of all, Jelly Drops is completely free! Some optional in-game items do require payment, but it's possible to get all of them for free from the daily spin or as presents for playing!
Download now and start matching cute jellies today!

bluejetty:00039672:ios.name: Trucker Ben - Truck Simulator
bluejetty:00039672:ios.summary:
Welcome to the world of cargo transport. 2D cargo transportation simulator.
Get ready to dive into the exciting world of cargo transport in a new game developed by the creator of Bad Trucker and Best Trucker.
A variety of trucks and trail
bluejetty:00039672:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of cargo transport. 2D cargo transportation simulator.
Get ready to dive into the exciting world of cargo transport in a new game developed by the creator of Bad Trucker and Best Trucker.
A variety of trucks and trailers: Choose from a wide range of trucks, each with unique characteristics and capabilities. In addition, there is a wide range of trailers designed to transport various types of goods.
Diverse loads and locations: Transport a wide range of goods, including cars, construction materials and even dangerous substances. Each type of cargo requires a corresponding trailer or truck. Explore different locations, from paved roads to off-road. Each location offers unique road conditions and challenges that will test your driving skills.
Truck Upgrades and Repairs: As you progress through the game, you will be able to upgrade your truck to improve its performance. Upgrade the engine, gearbox, transmission, fuel tank and tires so that your truck can handle any task.
Do not forget to monitor the condition of your truck and repair and refuel it in a timely manner. Damage can cause the truck to break down, so it is important to keep it in good condition.
Tips for beginners:
1. Keep an eye on the fuel level and refuel the truck in a timely manner.
2. Upgrade the truck between trips to avoid losing cargo.
3. If your truck is not an offroad vehicle, avoid bad roads.
4. Do not lose the load, so that you do not have to repeat the tasks.
5. If you get stuck, call a tow truck.
6. Please note that the loading height of the cargo is limited.
Prove that you are the best trucker by completing challenging missions, transporting valuable cargo and overcoming any obstacles in your path.
Join us in the exciting world of trucking and become the best trucker!
Patience and hard work will help you get the legendary trophy - Best Trucker!
Advantages of the game:
1. Realistic driving physics that takes into account cargo weight and road conditions.
2. A wide selection of cargo and locations for a variety of game modes.
3. The ability to upgrade and repair trucks to increase productivity.
4. Suitable for children who are fond of trucks and cars.
5. The newest game of 2024 with good graphics and physics.
6. A free game available to everyone.

bluejetty:00124284:ios.name: Tabla: India's drum instrument
bluejetty:00124284:ios.summary: The Tabla app provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing the tabla instrument on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Excellent for anyone who is passionate about the instrument and musi
bluejetty:00124284:ios.description:
The Tabla app provides all the tools necessary to master the art of playing the tabla instrument on your smartphone or tablet. Now you can easily play any music, anywhere! Excellent for anyone who is passionate about the instrument and music!
What is a Tabla? The tabla is a Hindu percussion instrument widely used in Indian devotional and meditative music. It consists of a pair of drums, the smaller, higher-pitched DAYA and the larger, deeper-sounding BAYA.
Why haven't you started learning to play the tabla drums yet? Tabla offers various video lessons to assist you, along with a variety of loops to play along with.
Don't have access to a real tabla instrument or an electronic tabla? No problem! The Tabla app offers a realistic tabla set and a diverse range of other percussion instruments with high-quality sounds, allowing you to play any music you desire! You don't need a tabla drum to learn to play!
The Tabla is an excellent choice for practicing or playing quietly, without causing disruptions or requiring much space. Enjoy the freedom to play tabla wherever you like! Show your friends how good you are at playing tabla! Share videos of your performances with friends and on social media!
The Tabla app allows children and adults to learn drumming while having fun, enhancing their cognitive and motor skills. This drum game will stimulate your musical talent, making it easy to learn drum beats as if using a real tabla kit.
So what are you waiting for to become a tabla player?
Explore Tabla features:
- Over 100 lessons to learn how to play the tabla
- Various percussion musical instruments
- Wide variety of drums, cymbals, and other percussion instruments
- Loops for playing along
- Studio-quality audio
- Export your recordings to MP3 format
- Share your recordings and custom drum sets on social media
- New tabla lessons and loops introduced weekly
- Compatible with all screen resolutions
- Phones and Tablets (HD images)
- MIDI support
- Free app
The app contains the following subscription:
- Premium Version (Remove ads; Unlock all loops; and Unlock Metronome)
- Monthly payment ($3,90).
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- The subsequent monthly subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the next renewal (considering the day of the effective monthly subscription).
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy Policy:
http://www.kolbapps.com/privacy_policy_and_terms.pdf
Terms of Use (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Designed for drummers, percussionists, professional musicians, enthusiasts, and beginners!
From the creators of the Real Drum app!
Download the Tabla app and turn your fingers into drumsticks right now!

bluejetty:00146439:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00146439:ios.description:
Discover Jannaty, the Islamic app that guides you to the eternal rewards of paradise through sunna actions!
Arrange your place in paradise by performing authentic Islamic actions based on hadiths. Earn rewards such as palaces, gardens, and much more!
How is this possible?
In an authentic hadith, the Prophet Muhammad Alayhi salat informs us that whoever recites Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, ...) ten times will be rewarded with a palace in paradise.
We have gathered these hadiths for you and created an app to accompany you on your journey to Allah, His paradise, and the good deeds He loves.
How does it work?
We have listed about 20 actions:
 - Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas ten times
 - Participate in building a mosque
 - Pray 12 units of supererogatory prayer (rakaats) (sunna)
 - Fill an empty space in a prayer row
 - Visit a sick person
 - Visit a fellow Muslim
 - Go to the mosque
 - Return from the mosque
 - Say Subhanallah
 - Say Alhamdulillah
 - Say Allahu Akbar
 - Say La ilaha illallah
 - Say Subhanallahi Al-Adheem wa bi Hamdih
 - Say La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
 - Study a verse of the Quran
 - Prostrate
 - Pronounce the prayer for the Prophet (salat 'ala nabi)
 - Pray a funeral prayer (salat janazah)
 - Accompany the deceased until burial
 - Say Subhanallahi wa bi Hamdih, Subhanallahi Al-Adheem
Each of these actions grants you one or more rewards in paradise.
We have listed about 10 rewards related to paradise:
 - Palaces
 - Bayt (house)
 - Mainzil (house)
 - Trees
 - Palm trees
 - Plants
 - Gardens
 - Levels (degrees)
 - Treasures
 - Qirat (mountain of good deeds)
 - Heavy words (on the scale of good deeds)
Add these actions in Jannaty and instantly see the results of your efforts!
Invest your time in easy actions loved by Allah, for which He generously rewards you in paradise.
Add friends and relatives, monitor their statistics, and try to surpass them. Jannaty is also a great opportunity to compete in doing good!
An easy and pleasant way to practice your religion! Paradise is within reach and awaits you.
Your feedback matters! 
We are constantly listening to our community to improve Jannaty. Feel free to contact us with any suggestions or to report any bugs.
Peace be upon you,
The Jannaty Team
Note: No image claims to represent paradise.

bluejetty:00037048:ios.description:
Bubble Scenery Adventure a highly popular bubble shooter game, designed exclusively for all players who love puzzle and arcade games. Match colors, shoot, and pop bubbles to clear balls and reveal stunning HD images.
Bubble Scenery Adventure combines classic bubble shooter gameplay with a modern twist, making it an irresistible addition to your game collection. With thousands of distinct levels and more constantly being added, you'll never run out of fun challenges.
Game Play:
* Aim and shoot balloons, matching at least three bubbles of the same color to pop them.
* Eliminating matching bubbles to advance to new levels filled with more challenges.
* Shoot balls with the fewest moves possible to score higher points.
* Strive to earn three stars on each level and gain extra points through continuous bubble popping.
Game Features:
* Classic and Addictive: Experience the timeless fun of bubble shooter games—match colors, shoot, and clear all bubbles to win.
* Endless Challenges: Navigate through thousands of unique levels with more added regularly to keep the fun going.
* Vibrant and Fun: Dive into a colorful and engaging puzzle game that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere.
* Boosters and Refresh: Utilize powerful boosters and refresh features to clear all bubbles on the screen quickly.
* Bubble Scenery Adventure: Explore captivating levels designed for all, awaiting your skill and strategy.
* Free to Play: Start your bubble shooting adventure today at no cost!
* Engaging Experience: User-friendly interface for smooth and enjoyable gameplay.
To win, blast and clear all the balloons and balls. In Bubble Scenery Adventure, each level presents new challenges that will test your puzzle-solving skills and keep your mind sharp.
Variety of balloons, balls, boosters and daily bonuses await! Are you ready to take on the challenge? Download Bubble Scenery Adventure today and embark on an exciting bubble-shooting journey!

bluejetty:00182479:ios.description:
Messenger is a free messaging app that helps you connect with anyone, anywhere. Stay in touch with your friends and family, explore your interests with people like you, build your community, and share your vibe beyond words, all in one app.
CHAT AND CALL ANYONE, ANYWHERE 
Find and connect with your friends and family on Facebook and Messenger, no phone number needed.
GET INSTANT ANSWERS FROM YOUR AI ASSISTANT*
Meta AI is your assistant that can answer any questions, give you advice, help with homework, and more.
SEND YOUR PHOTOS IN HIGH DEFINITION
Send and receive clearer, crisper picture of your favorite moments with Messenger.
CREATE SHARED ALBUMS
From a recent summer vacation to your grandma’s 80th birthday, create albums of photos and videos to share, organize and reminisce over important moments in your group chats.
EASILY ADD NEW CONNECTIONS WITH QR CODES
Connect with people you meet in real life by scanning their Messenger QR code or sharing yours via a link.
SHARE LARGE FILES DIRECTLY IN CHAT
Whether it’s a Word, PDF, or Excel doc, you can send large files up to 100MB right inside of Messenger.
EDIT AND UNSEND MESSAGES 
Hit send too soon? You can edit the message up to 15 minutes after sending
DISAPPEARING MESSAGES
Some things aren’t meant to last forever. Choose how long your end-to-end encrypted chats stick around after they’ve been read.
COME TOGETHER WITH YOUR COMMUNITIES
Meaningfully connect with people like you from your school, neighborhood, and interest groups.
GET IN YOUR FAVORITE CREATORS’ INNER CIRCLE
Stay in the know with creators by joining their broadcast channels for authentic and casual content.
UNLEASH YOUR IMAGINATION W/ META AI*
Tap into your go-to creative partner to create, edit, animate images and more.
CAPTURE EVERYDAY MOMENTS ON STORIES
Highlight moments of your day using photos and videos that disappear after 24 hours in Stories.
DROP A NOTE WITH YOUR THOUGHTS
Stay connected with your friends by sharing quick updates that disappear after 24 hours.
BRING YOUR VIBE TO YOUR CHATS
Sometimes words just don’t cut it. Tap into more ways to express yourself with animated stickers, GIFs, reactions and more.
SET THE MOOD OF YOUR CHAT WITH THEMES
Customize your chat with a large and constantly evolving list of themes featuring popular artists, holidays, and more. 
*Meta AI is available in select languages and countries only, with more coming soon.

bluejetty:00090983:ios.summary:
With Audio Sauce you can easily add audio effect “flavor” to your videos and save them or share them to social media quickly, while the inspiration is still fresh.
Audio Sauce is designed with a simple, artist-friendly interface that encou
bluejetty:00090983:ios.description:
With Audio Sauce you can easily add audio effect “flavor” to your videos and save them or share them to social media quickly, while the inspiration is still fresh.
Audio Sauce is designed with a simple, artist-friendly interface that encourages the user to feel like they are at play – but there is plenty of functionality underneath the hood. With its suite of essential effects you can create results that run the gamut from tasteful polish to wildly experimental.
- Load any video from your device’s media library or record a new video.
Then:
- Boost the volume of your video with an output limiter
- Add delay by tapping for tempo then choosing the rhythmic pattern you want, including regular, triplet and dotted half, quarter and eighth note divisions
- Add reverb by choosing from one of four styles ranging in size from medium room to cathedral
- Add “dirt” by choosing one of two modes, “mild” or “hot”, for anything from subtle tape saturation to fully obliterated distortion
- Use the EQ module’s bandpass filter to roll off unwanted high or low frequencies or boost/subtract with an EQ shelf
- Play with the pitch shifter and blend in any interval (including octaves, fourths and major and minor seconds, thirds, fifths, sixths and sevenths)
When you’re happy with how your video sounds, save it to your device or share it directly to social media. The ability to save and share your video can be unlocked with a one-time purchase.

bluejetty:00092361:ios.description:
Booking your haircuts just got easier with automatic check-ins and family booking! At Floyd’s 99 Barbershop, we value Expertise, Experience and Convenience. Use our new app to quickly Rock Your Reservations by creating an account, picking your location, and selecting a service & time. If desired, you can also choose to book with your favorite stylist or barber. Oh, and did we mention VIP access to exclusive promotions and gift cards, along with touchless pay options?
The Floyd’s 99 Barbershop app offers an account registration for a more amplified booking and app experience – but don’t fret, creating an account is simple. This also allows the app to keep track of your personal preferences and reservation history, helping your experience in the shops be better than ever before.
Getting your haircut with us has never been this easy. Download the app today and see for yourself! What are you waiting for?
Features:
• Easily Book Your Reservations (quickly book your next service with the tap of your finger)
• Auto Check-In (get automatically checked in for your reservation as soon as you walk into the shop)
• Family Booking (book your family’s haircuts or services together, using only one account)
• Touchless Payment (add your card info to your account for a faster checkout experience – this also helps us ensure safety)
• View Reservation History (see both past and upcoming services)
• VIP Access to Promotions (access to app-exclusive offers & promotions, and the ability to apply and/or manager promotions on your account for your services)
• Gift Card Access (check to see how much money you have, or don’t have, left on your gift card)
• Two-Way Shop Communication (use the app to send your shop a text message about your reservation, or directly give them a call)
At Floyd’s 99 Barbershop, we also accept walk-ins and call-ahead reservations. Come as you are.
Expert Cuts, Amplified Experience

bluejetty:00179028:ios.name: Hunt Royale: Action RPG Battle
bluejetty:00179028:ios.summary: Hunt Royale invites brave hunters to join the neverending battle against fearsome monsters and other warriors. Dust off your trusty sword, get into your old armor, and join others in shaping legends and songs of glory that will echo through
bluejetty:00179028:ios.description:
Hunt Royale invites brave hunters to join the neverending battle against fearsome monsters and other warriors. Dust off your trusty sword, get into your old armor, and join others in shaping legends and songs of glory that will echo through generations!
Step into the shoes of one of the PLETHORA OF DIFFERENT CHARACTERS. Each one offers a wide array of SKILLS TO MASTER. Only by using them in battle will you be able to FEND OFF YOUR COMPETITION and become the one that rules the battlefield.
Features:
- 80+ characters to unlock and level up!
- Many different game modes, PvE and PvP
- Dungeons with unique enemies to fight
- Powerful skills to use and master
- Unpredictable special events and daily challenges
- Amusing voxel-based graphics
So get our eyes on the prize and prepare to JOIN THE FIGHT. The game seamlessly marries STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY with real time COMBAT ACTION to create an exciting, vibrant environment full of CHALLENGE, EXCITEMENT AND ADVENTURE. 
Every upcoming and seasoned warrior has something to find here. With each obstacle faced, either in PvE or PvP modes, your experience and skill set will grow, allowing you to become a true legend. Each of the 70 CHARACTERS offers UNIQUE MECHANICS to discover, giving you endless opportunities for discovery and growth.
ENTER THE DUNGEON to hone your skills. Feel the CALL OF THE MAZE, which offers something new every time you enter. Use your hard-earned loot and XP to grow ever stronger on the field of battle. FIND TREASURES to feast our eyes on. TRY OUT NEW BUILDS and use them to win battles and earn more trophies!
Test your mettle ON THE ARENA, the ultimate hunting grounds where survival is key. STAY EVER VIGILANT as other players compete against you for the highest score. The best loot and the most sound strategy will be nothing if you can’t execute it. So GET ON THERE AND FIGHT!
Those are the bread and butter of a warrior's life, but there’s more! Gather up your friends to share stories of victor and perseverance in the CO-OP MODE. When your exploits bring you together and forge unbreakable bonds, FORM A CLAN whose name will be spoken with reverence across the land. 
Or maybe the life of a BOUNTY HUNTER is something more suited to your tastes? It’s the way to discover different challenges and earn LEGENDARY LOOT along the way. 
When your purse is full and your gear is up to par, you will be ready to strike fear into the eyes of other hunters in EPIC DUELS. Show once and for that you belong in the hall of the champions. 
After hours of hard-fought battles, share your stories of valor with others in the tavern. This is a SOCIAL SPACE free of danger, where glorious warriors meet and fates intertwine. SHOW OFF YOUR LOOT. Bask in your accomplishments. 
When you feel rested and energized, TRY OUT NEW APPROACHES. Tired of melee combat? Try range! Want to feel the power on your fingertips? Learn magic! Be good, be evil, be anything in between. CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER with unlockable skills to express yourself.
And when you think you’ve seen and done everything, regular UNPREDICTABLE EVENTS will be ready for you to jump into. Never stop learning, never stop fighting, never stop earning. Hunt Royale awaits!
Terms of Use: https://boombit.com/tos/

Turn Yourself Into a Star — Try Celebrity Hairstyles Instantly with AI!
Have you ever dreamed of seeing yourself with the exact hairstyle of your favorite celebrity? Whether it's the glamorous curls of Beyoncé, the edgy pixie cut of Scarlett Johansson, or Kim Kardashian's sleek straight look — now you can, in just a few seconds!

bluejetty:00132238:ios.name: The Wall: See & Buy
bluejetty:00132238:ios.summary: Say you want to find a new room mate, or maybe you want to sell your old mac book, or give away your couch and buy a new one. Record a short video of your flat, your laptop or your couch and post it on "The Wall", alongside a title, a price
bluejetty:00132238:ios.description:
Say you want to find a new room mate, or maybe you want to sell your old mac book, or give away your couch and buy a new one. Record a short video of your flat, your laptop or your couch and post it on "The Wall", alongside a title, a price tag, and a way for people to contact you. People will find your videos on "The Wall", or you can share your videos directly on other channels. It is super convenient and fast, free of charge, and best of all, your privacy is fully protected: you can choose to publish your listings in a private manner, where only trusted community members like yourself can access to your personal information.
Are you looking for a new couch, a new headphone, or a flat to rent? Perhaps your classmates or coworkers have something in store for you! Check out "The Wall" to see what the community around you has to offer. See what you want to buy with immersive short videos on "The Wall", and rest assured that the carefully selected community of "The Wall" is free of any scams or frauds. Best of all, you can help the planet by reusing second-hand stuff that belonged to trusted members of community instead of leaving a large carbon footprint for getting something that might be new but is at best marginally better.

bluejetty:00083203:ios.summary:

Your people are scattered. Some live in your city, some are an ocean away. Some you saw this month, others it’s been a year. You find out a close friend was in town a few days after they left. You have a free
bluejetty:00083203:ios.description:
Mozi: A place for your people
Your people are scattered. Some live in your city, some are an ocean away. Some you saw this month, others it’s been a year. You find out a close friend was in town a few days after they left. You have a free evening but don’t know who’s around to do something fun with. You’d love to take a break from social media, but it’s a thread tying you loosely to people you love.
Losing touch with people you care about isn’t a failure. It’s a hallmark of adulthood. Mozi is the app our friendships deserve: a way to stay close even when we’re busy and spread out.
How Mozi works
Add your trips, shows, and the events you’re going to, it takes a few seconds. Mozi turns them into one picture of where you’ll be and when, so your people know where to find you. Share any plan with anyone, even friends who aren’t on Mozi yet.
See what city your people are in now and where they’re headed next. When your paths are about to cross, Mozi tells you, before you miss each other, not after.
Private by default
Mozi is social, without the media. No brands, no public feeds, no follower counts, no ads. Connections are two-way (friend model, not follower model), and your location is only ever shared at city level, with people you choose.
The more of your people on Mozi, the better it gets. But you only need three or four friends you can’t wait to see when your lives overlap next. Add more as you go. Mozi also holds the little things that keep friendships warm: birthdays, kids’ and pets’ names, notes on what they mentioned last time, and shared photos from the times you were together.
We're a a small, remote team building Mozi from Seattle, San Francisco, New York City, Medellin, Vienna, Madrid and Dubai. Find us at community@mozi.app or @getmozi on Instagram and Twitter. We'd love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00026552:ios.name: Isekai:Slow Life
bluejetty:00026552:ios.summary:
What the-? Been transported to ISEKAI and turned into an adorable walking mushroom?!
In this wonderful new world, you will begin by managing and developing a small town while meeting and engaging with various types of beautiful and bizarr
bluejetty:00026552:ios.description:
What the-? Been transported to ISEKAI and turned into an adorable walking mushroom?!
In this wonderful new world, you will begin by managing and developing a small town while meeting and engaging with various types of beautiful and bizarre characters. Discover unknown lands with them as you wander at your leisure and enjoy the quiet life.
-[Make a family in another world and enjoy a relaxing life] 
Explore fateful encounters with many different races: A gentle vampire nurse, an artistic octopus teacher, a cute siren “drinking companion”...... While away the sweet, relaxing days of ISEKAI life.
-[Assemble Your Familiar Squad and Take on Epic Trials ]
Transcenders can now explore fantastical locations with extraordinary monsters, and develop them into legendary familiars to break through power boundaries! Increase their stars to metamorphose, and awaken splendid transformations! Bind them to your Fellows and gain power bonuses! Familiar contract strategy + Multi-level metamorphosis + Endless tower challenge: A completely new adventure experience. Build your strongest Familiar team! Start your conquest of Familiars today!
-[Explore the continent of ISEKAI and form bonds with various companions] 
Bond with companions from all trades and walks of life: A cat-eared maid girl, a goblin merchant, a monster hunter... Each companion has their own unique skills and is ready to aid you in exploring the secrets of ISEKAI and building your village.
-[Open stores and build a village] 
All kinds of trades and businesses can flourish in your village: A workshop, a potion store, a tavern, a school... Use your keen business skills to develop the economy of your village, step by step. Grab the opportunities that come your way, take care of the business owners who depend on you, and build the honor and reputation of your very own village. 
-[Join the Adventurer’s Guild to experience cooperation and challenge] 
Join a guild or create your own to wander the world of ISEKAI with other fellow adventurers. You could become fast friends, or opponents in heated combat. 
-[On the road to godhood, every road is meaningful] 
As your exploration of ISEKAI unfolds, your form and reputation will change and evolve, and before you know it, you won’t just be an ordinary mushroom anymore... The road ahead has many paths, each awaiting your discovery. 
Come join us on the road to ISEKAI and begin a new life full of challenges and fun!
For more information about the game, follow us on:
-Facebook:>https://www.facebook.com/isekaislowlife
-Discord: https://discord.com/invite/YnKp2UXahQ
If you have any advice or feedback for our game, please send an email to: slowlifesupport@mars.games

bluejetty:00075981:ios.name: VRoid Studio
bluejetty:00075981:ios.summary:
3D Modeling, for Everyone! VRoid Studio is an application to create 3D models of humanoid avatars (characters).Create original characters on this intuitive and highly adaptable application. Easy to use for everyone!
■Easy for Beginners too
bluejetty:00075981:ios.description:
3D Modeling, for Everyone! VRoid Studio is an application to create 3D models of humanoid avatars (characters).Create original characters on this intuitive and highly adaptable application. Easy to use for everyone!
■Easy for Beginners too
You can start creating right after download; with many ready-to-use preset items, you won’t need to create anything from scratch. You just need to pick items you like and adjust their parameters!
■Customize Your Model’s Body However You Like
Face features, body shape, outfits — everything is customizable in infinite ways. Even first-time users can fully enjoy the application by picking preset items and playing around with the parameters’ sliders.
■Express Yourself
this application also gives you total freedom to express your originality, customizing minor features down to the finest detail.
■Design Textures with the Pen Tool
The texture editor supports stylus pens such as Apple pencils and is pressure-sensitive. You can also divide your design into more layers! Draw directly on the 3D model, or on the UV texture to see your creation display in real-time on the 3D preview.
■As easy as drawing on paper
Create new chunks of hair with a single stroke, and later edit them to your liking through the parameters. Hair is customizable in infinite ways, and you can set hair bounce individually for each hair chunk.
■Your models are yours to use freely
You can set your own terms of use for the data of every model, texture, item, etc you create on VRoid Studio, specifying if you give permission for commercial use, credits, etc.
■Create, Connect, Expand
You can upload models you created to VRoid Hub, letting the community view them and send their appreciation. Characters uploaded to VRoid Hub can also be called up in various integrated games and platforms!
- When using the data for models created by pixiv or third parties, please be sure to follow the terms of use and licensing conditions.
- Supported environments and devices may change in future updates.
- This information is current as of Aug 31, 2023.
- Operation is not guaranteed on all devices.

Whether you're grinding through Tabata sprints, HIIT circuit
bluejetty:00023663:ios.description:
The workout timer trusted by athletes, coaches and gym-goers since 2013. Repeat is built for one thing: keeping you moving through every round, set and interval of your training.
Whether you're grinding through Tabata sprints, HIIT circuits, EMOM workouts, AMRAP rounds, boxing intervals, CrossFit WODs or simple rest-work cycles - Repeat handles the timing so you can focus on the effort.
–– Built for every workout style:
• Tabata — 20s work / 10s rest, 8 rounds. Set it once, go.
• HIIT — custom work and rest intervals with unlimited repeats
• EMOM — every minute on the minute, as many rounds as you need
• Circuit training — chain multiple exercises with timed stations
• Boxing / MMA — round timers with rest between rounds
• CrossFit — AMRAPs, intervals and timed WODs
• Yoga & stretching — hold timers with gentle alerts
• Running — walk/run intervals for couch-to-5K and beyond
–– Dead simple to use:
Set your work time, rest time, number of rounds and press Start. Name your timers to keep them organized. That's it.
–– Keeps going when you put your phone down:
Runs in the background with audio and notification alerts. Lock your screen, switch apps, put your phone in your pocket — Repeat will tell you when to move and when to rest.
–– Audible countdown:
Hear "3, 2, 1" before each phase transition so you're always ready for what's next. Configurable from 3 to 10 seconds.
–– Fullscreen landscape mode:
Prop your phone on the gym floor and see a giant countdown from across the room. Phase colors change so you know work from rest at a glance.
Everything you need:
–––––––––––––––––––––––
• Work, rest, prepare and cool down phases
• Sets with rest between sets
• Up to 999 repeats and 999 sets with Pro
• 50+ alert sounds including voice commands
• Save multiple timers and switch between them
• Precise to the second
• Background alerts — no need to keep the app open
• Clean, minimal interface with no clutter
Repeat is used daily by personal trainers, CrossFit coaches, martial arts instructors, yoga teachers and hundreds of thousands of people who just want a timer that works and gets out of the way.

- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.

- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00159857:ios.description:
Thanks ! Now the app has got 3,600,000 downloads
:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
You can check most fertile day at a glance.
In addition to prediction of your period advices on physical condition and recording weight and BBT are available. Its’ a nicely convenient app to support women mentally and physically.
:::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
‥…-------◇Main Features‥…-------◇
1. Predicts the timing of your period
　・Track your period to predict ovulation day and start date of your next period.
　・Explanation of female cycle.
2. Calendar
　・Track your period with memos.
　・Able to choose a variety of calendar.
　・Shows previous periods and likely start date of your next period.
3. Maternity
　・Explanations about physical condition for every weeks of pregnancy
　・Advices on dairy life style in accordance with the change of mother and baby
　・Recording prenatal checkup and notification of prenatal checkup schedule are available
　・Recording of baby’s growth with an ultrasonography album is available
4. Basal Temp Record
　・Record your basal temperature every day.
　・Shows basal temperature in a line graph.　　
5. Recording weight
Simple enough to continue! 
Dairy weight management supports you being on diet.
　・Input your weight everyday　
～　Input your weight just after you check your weight with the scale.
　・Easy to check the change of weight as it is shown in a line graph 
～ You can check your physical condition at a glance!
　・With comparison of graphs in Non-maternity and maternity, you can easily check the change of weight by being pregnant. (※with maternity mode)
6. Recoding body fat percentage
　・Input your body fat percentage every day or you can track the change of your body fact percentage with the graph.
　・If you set targeting body fat percentage, it may become a compass for you to be on diet.
7. Backup Service
　・Saves registered data on the app to the SD card.
　・Able to change a phone without worries as your data is restored.
8. Password lock
　・Allows you to set a password when first opened.
9. Linking to SNS
　・Schedule and memo input can be sent via twitter.
　・You can introduce the app to your friend via Twitter/Facebook/LINE
■Before using monthly charged service
[Service name] Monthly charged basic plan
[Contents]
① It is possible to save 60 or 120 day graph images
② It is possible to specify the start date of the graph
③ Delete in-app advertisement
[Monthly fee] 360 yen / month
[Subscription term] One month after purchase (till forbid) 
※Monthly fee may be changed due to all App price change by App Store and 
other reasons.
 [Automatic renewal]
You are requested to forbid monthly subscription at least 24hours before the ending date of the subscription term (hereinafter “Date”), otherwise your subscription will be prolonged automatically.
For automatic renewal billing will be completed within 24 hours from “Date”.
[Billing]
Once you agree to purchase confirmation, billing to your iTunes account will be completed.
[How to confirm or cancel monthly charged membership]
To cancel automatic renewal, you are requested to complete necessary procedure within 24hours before “Date”.
Please access to the page below for your membership status confirmation
and its cancellation.
App Store App＞Recommendation page(end of the page)＞Apple ID＞Display Apple ID＞Purchase＞Control
You can cancel/configure automatic renewal and confirm “Date”.
[Cancel for this month]
Please note that you cannot cancel service for this month.
[Note]
Billing may be controlled by user and if user move to account settings after purchase, automatic renewal may be set Off.
[Privacy policy]
http://diary.kirei-r.jp/web/policy/privacy.html
[Terms of use]
http://diary.kirei-r.jp/web/policy/use.html
Thank you for using our app.

bluejetty:00182596:ios.summary:
Solitaire is also known as Klondike Solitaire and Patience. Solitaire by Loop uses the original rules, the game is FREE and available for all iOS devices!
Enjoy the world’s best and most popular free Solitaire card game anytime, anywhere!
bluejetty:00182596:ios.description:
Solitaire is also known as Klondike Solitaire and Patience. Solitaire by Loop uses the original rules, the game is FREE and available for all iOS devices!
Enjoy the world’s best and most popular free Solitaire card game anytime, anywhere! Train your brain, challenge yourself, and become a Solitaire master. Try this original, classic, and free Patience Solitaire card game now!
We kept alive the traditions of the classical Solitaire that you love so much, giving you the option to spice it up if you want to! It includes the following features:
+ Draw 1 card
+ Draw 3 cards
+ Winning deals only
+ Classical scoring
+ Unlimited undo
+ Unlimited hints to give you advice on possible moves
+ Auto-complete animation for solved games
Beautiful graphics and sounds to give you the most comfortable experience:
+ Sound, music, and timer can be turned on and off
+ 30 back and face card & 15 background designs available
Simple and handy interface:
+ Single tap or drag and drop to move a card
+ Left or Right handed mode
Our Solitaire game features an exciting Daily Challenge! Play a unique game of Solitaire each day and aim for the highest score possible. Completing the challenge earns you coins, which you can use to customize your game.
Personal stats to keep track of your performance:
+ Your statistics for every game type (1 or 3 cards winnable and 1 or 3 cards random)
+ How many Solitaire games you played, you won, lost, your average time, etc..
You will definitely enjoy playing this classical Solitaire.

bluejetty:00100194:ios.summary:

Whether you are meeting friends, keepi
bluejetty:00100194:ios.description:
Stay connected with the people who matter most. Friend Tracker helps you share your live location, create safe zones, mark favorite places, and discover nearby spots all from one simple and secure map.
Whether you are meeting friends, keeping your family safe, or saving places for future reference, Friend Tracker makes location sharing effortless, accurate, and private.
With a focus on simplicity, privacy, and precision, Friend Tracker combines smart location technology with a clean design to help you stay close to the people and places that truly matter.
Real-time location sharing
- See your friends live locations on a clear, interactive map with fast GPS updates
- Control exactly who can see your location and for how long
- View your group or family members in real time to plan meetups or check in easily
- Stay connected during trips, school commutes, or when loved ones are traveling abroad
- Works seamlessly even when switching between Wi-Fi and mobile networks
Safe zones and alerts
- Create custom alert zones around important places such as home, office, or school
- Receive instant notifications when a friend or family member enters or leaves a zone
- Adjust sensitivity and radius to match your needs
- Ideal for parents tracking their kids’ safety, friends watching out for each other, or teams working in the field
- Stay informed without constantly checking the map
My places
- Add and name pins to remember specific spots like parking lots, meeting points, or your favorite restaurants
- Group and organize saved places for easier navigation later
- Use it as a personal map diary to record where you’ve been and what’s important
- Quickly access saved spots with a single tap from your map view
Nearby places
- Discover useful points of interest around you such as hospitals, schools, ATMs, restaurants, and gas stations
- See detailed information and get instant directions with your preferred navigation app
- Perfect for travel, emergencies, or exploring a new city
- Save the places you find for future reference or share them with friends instantly
Privacy and control
- You decide when and with whom to share your location
- Pause sharing or remove friends at any time
- All location data is protected and used only for features you enable
- No constant tracking in the background when you turn sharing off
- Friend Tracker is built with transparency and user control at its core
Why users love Friend Tracker
- Clean, intuitive, and modern interface that anyone can use easily
- Fast and accurate GPS updates for reliable real-time tracking
- Smart alerts that keep you informed without draining your battery
- Flexible sharing options: temporary, continuous, or zone-based
- Built for both individual users and families
- Optimized for performance and low battery impact
Use Friend Tracker to
- Meet up with friends faster and easier
- Keep loved ones safe when apart
- Stay connected with your travel group or coworkers
- Save favorite places and organize them into categories
- Get notified when someone arrives home or leaves school
- Explore nearby points of interest wherever you are
- Ensure peace of mind when traveling or working remotely
Friend Tracker is designed for people who care about both connection and privacy. It gives you complete control over how you share your world while keeping your data safe.
Stay close, stay safe, and stay connected wherever you are.
Download Friend Tracker today and experience a smarter, simpler way to share your location.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/ios-hero-privacy-policy

- Study Calendar: Specifically designed for students, this feature helps manage academic schedules and deadlines, acting as an effective school planner.

bluejetty:00031679:ios.description:
Network Analyzer is an advanced network tool designed as WiFi analyzer, WiFi scanner, network scanner, WiFi speed tester, internet speed tester and port scanner to troubleshoot and improve network security, connectivity issues and performances. It also offers a wide range of features to assist in diagnosing the problems within your office and home WiFi/local network, router, Internet connection and even on remote servers. All the Key features include:
Network Information:
- Current connection with default gateway, HTTP Proxy, Public IP, DNS server(s), ISP name
- Provides WiFi information & analysis with network details (SSID, BSSID, vendor, IP address, IPv6 address, subnet mask, broadcast, WiFi security type)
- Shows cell/mobile network information (network type, IP Address, IPv6 address, subnet mask)
- VPN and HOTSPOT Network Information
- Internet Information (AS Number, AS Name, Public Address, Hostname, Time Zone, Location with MAP)
- Monitors WiFi, cellular, vpn & hotspot data usage
- Network Interface of your device
- Real time internet speed meter
- Network routing tables
- ARP table with IP and MAC addresses of devices on your network (iOS 27 and later)
Device Discovery (LAN / IP Scanner):
- WiFi analyzer and Scanner to detect all online devices connected to the network
- Provides IP addresses of all detected devices
- Identifies mDNS (Bonjour), netBIOS, LLMNR, UPnP and DNS names where available
- Conducts ping tests on discovered devices
- Device details (Manage device, Local service discovery and Network details)
- WiFi Network details (Access points, Network setup)
- Discover online devices in home and office WiFi network
- MAC addresses and vendors of discovered devices (iOS 27 and later)
- Network Security checks: WiFi security and encryption strength, security downgrade, DNS hijacking, and changes to DNS servers, router address, access points and proxy
- Detects man-in-the-middle attacks such as ARP spoofing (iOS 27 and later)
Network Tools:
Our advanced network tools are used to verify internet performance, improve network security, troubleshoot and monitor network and more - 
- Internet speed test / WiFi speed test
- DNS Speed Test
- BLE devices / Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) Scanner
- Ping
- Wake on LAN (WOL)
- Traceroute (Including Visual Trace)
- Find open ports
- Router vulnerability
- Privacy Analyzer
- SSL Certificate Checker
- Whois
- IP Address Lookup
- DNS Lookup (A, AAAA, CAA, MX,NS, TXT more)
- MAC Address Lookup (Including MAC address, OUI and Vendor name)
Local Service Discovery:
- Bonjour services browser
- UPnP services and device browser
More Features:
- Light & Dark Appearance
- Full IPv6 Support
- Optimized for iPhone & iPad
Network Analyzer: WiFi Scanner is an essential net tools and network analyzer for anyone looking forward to managing and troubleshooting their network efficiently.
Privacy Policy: https://networkanalyzer.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://networkanalyzer.io/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00074174:ios.description:
Hey you! Yeah you! Shouldn't you be looking for Photon instead? Our newest app has been rebuilt from the ground app to support the next 10 years (or 20, who knows?) of mobile photography. Check it out at http://photon.cam
“The Clarity filter is iPhone photography’s secret sauce—it adds pro-camera crispness to almost any shot.”
— Kevin Sintumuang, The Wall Street Journal
“If the iPhone’s standard camera is like a digital point-and-shoot, the Camera+ app is like a high-quality SLR lens.”
— TIME: 50 Best iPhone Apps 2011
“improves on almost every aspect of the built-in camera app”
— Charlie Sorrel, Wired
Winner: Best Visual Design, Best Photography App
— Best App Ever Awards
It’s all about one thing... great photos!
Whether you’re a seasoned photographer or someone who’s barely touched a camera, Camera+ will make you love taking photos.
Touch Exposure & Focus
Set exposure separately from focus. You can now easily control how light or dark your shots come out.
Shooting Modes
Use the Stabilizer to steady your iPhone and get the sharpest photos you can. There are countless uses for the Timer including taking the highest-quailty self-portraits. Capture all the action by using Burst to take rapid streams of shots.
Digital Zoom
Up to 6× zoom with advanced digital processing provides you with quality that simply blows away the competition.
Front Flash
How many times have you wanted to take a pic of yourself in a dark room but couldn’t. Well, now you can!
Horizon Level
Use the Horizon Level to eliminate taking crooked shots.
Clarity
Clarity is one of the biggest breakthroughs to happen to image processing in a long time. Clarity analyzes your photos and makes several intelligent adjustments that magically bring out details and breathe life into dull photos. With Clarity, you’ll stop throwing out bad photos… you’ll be amazed to see what it can do to photos that you’d typically consider unusable, like shots that came out too dark.
Scene Modes
Most modern digital cameras all have scene modes to help you get the best photos for your particular situation. With Camera+, you get to choose from several scene modes including Food, Sunset, Night, Portrait, Beach, and many more.
Effects
Professional photographer, Lisa Bettany created a slew of stunningly beautiful effects. Make your photos shimmer with “HDR”… get down and dirty with “Grunge”… fill your pics with emotion and despair with “So Emo”. And this is just the tip of the iceberg… there are dozens of 1-touch effects for you to experiment with.
Lightbox
All the pics you take in Camera+ go in the innovative Lightbox where you can quickly and easily skim through them and get rid of bad shots. You save only the photos you’re satisfied with so that your camera roll stays neat and clean.
Sharing
Whether you want to show your results to your friends and family or the whole world, Camera+ has got you covered. Proudly share your photos on Facebook, Twitter, and Flickr. Or go the more personal route and email or message them from right within the app.
iCloud Lightbox sync
Automatically sync your Camera+ photos between all of your devices. Shoot all day on your iPhone… and then edit at night on your iPad. 
Crops
If you didn’t line-up your shot perfectly when you took it, you can easily fix that with Camera+. And when you want to get a bit creative, we setup a bunch of popular crop sizes for you. With a single tap, you can make your pics square, 4×6, 8×10, and more.
Borders
With Camera+ you get several great border designs, from simple black and white borders to more gritty designs, you’ll be able to add wonderful finishing touches.
Captions
Have some fun with your photos by putting captions on them. It’s a great way to really personalize your favorite shots.
