bluejetty:00159897:ios.description:
TrueVine: Faith-First Christian Dating & Community
Welcome to TrueVine, your trusted dating app and social community for faith-first, Christ-centered singles seeking intentional relationships. Whether you hope to build sincere bonds, find a partner who shares your Christian faith, or connect with like-minded believers in a safe environment, TrueVine is made for you.
Created by devoted Christian scholars, educators and industry professionals, TrueVine is far more than a dating platform, it is a warm community rooted in shared Christian values. We support identity and academic credential verification for all users. Verified profiles come with exclusive badges, creating a trustworthy and authentic space for every member.
Why Choose TrueVine?
- Open to Christian singles across all denominations, including Protestant and Catholic believers
- A community of faith-focused professionals and educated individuals
- Clear verification badges for trusted, authentic profiles
- Chat freely and grow genuine, long-lasting connections
- Find lasting love built on shared faith, beliefs and life purpose
No matter you are looking for a Christ-centered romance, Christian fellowship or a faith-aligned marriage, TrueVine walks with you on the journey toward God-honoring love. Download TrueVine now, and let faith bring you sincere, heartfelt connections.
Key Features
Faith Match Live
Connect with fellow faith-first singles in real time. Get to know others’ personalities, values and faith in minutes, and find matches who truly align with your beliefs.
Intelligent Matching
Our smart algorithm takes your preferences, hobbies, Christian values and daily lifestyle into account, pairing you with highly compatible people. Finding a Christ-centered relationship has never been easier.
True Snap
Share precious moments of your life, and browse photos, spiritual reflections and faith stories from the community. Express yourself and bond with others over shared values and life experiences.
Prayer Room
Enter a peaceful sacred space to pray, reflect, or share prayer requests with brothers and sisters in faith. Encourage one another and grow together spiritually.
Your Privacy Matters
We treat your personal data with the utmost respect. All information is stored on secure servers and will never be shared with unauthorized third parties. We suggest you protect your personal details during chats, and your precise location will always stay private. We wish you wonderful and intentional connections here on TrueVine!
With blessings,
The TrueVine Team
Subscription Information
The app is free to download and use. Upgrade to Preferred Membership to unlock advanced tools, including refined faith connection filters and priority matching.
Subscriptions will auto-renew automatically. Please cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle to avoid renewal charges.
Website: https://www.truevine.app/
Privacy Policy: https://www.truevine.app/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.truevine.app/terms.html
Support: support@truevine.app

Welcome to Waterdeep, the City of Splendors! A city run by a secret society of masked Lords who rule with shady back-door dealings and unmatched political power. In Lords of Waterdeep players will play as one of these masked Lords and will need to recruit adventurers to go out and complete quests for them. The more quests they complete, the more control and influence they have over the city. 
Players can expand the city by purchasing buildings that will open up new opportunities within the city walls. Intrigue cards can be used to help the player and may also either help or hinder their fellow Lords in their quest to become the supreme ruler of Waterdeep!
Lords of Waterdeep is a turn-based strategy game played in 8 rounds and can be played against AI or with up to 5 human players. Players take turns assigning their agents to do their bidding, whether it is to recruit new adventurers to their tavern or purchase a new building for the city. Points and resources are gained by completing quests, playing Intrigue cards, constructing new buildings or having other players utilize the buildings you have constructed. At the end of the 8 rounds bonus points are awarded and the player with the most points at the end wins the game.

bluejetty:00064493:ios.description:
The fsbrosemount mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact First State Bank of Rosemount customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the fsbrosemount mobile App, you must be enrolled as an First State Bank of Rosemount Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

- Save the GIF to Photos or share it with other apps.

1. Select a video from Photos.
2. Trim the clip and choose your GIF settings.
3. Create and preview your GIF.
4. Save it to Photos or share it.

GIF conversion happens on your device. GIFit does not upload your selected videos or created GIFs.

Japji Sahib is a Sikh prayer, that appears at the beginning of the holy scripture of the Sikhs, the living Guru, Guru Granth Sahib. It was composed by Guru Nanak Dev, the founder of Sikhism. It is headed by Mool Mantra and followed by 38 paudis (stanzas) and completed with a final Salok at the end of this composition.
Key Features of the app Japji Sahib:
1) One can listen to path using soft keys(Play, Pause or Stop).
2) Meaning of the path on every page.
3) One can change the text size (i.e. increase or decrease) within app.
4) One can select path language from Gurmukhi(Punjabi), Hindi and English.
5) One can share this app with friends and family.

The design of the app is very simple.

The app has been built with you in mind and allows you to make payments for goods, services or products from your mobile money wallet, Visa / Mastercard (Foreign or Local) or GTBank account anywhere you are in the world!

• Vodafone Broadband
• MTN data bundles
• DSTV

• DSTV Box Office
• Surfline
• University of Ghana School Fees 
• Mobile money transfers (Bank-to-wallet; wallet-to-Bank & wallet-to-wallet)
• Local Interbank transfers 
• Databank investments
• FirstBanc investments
• Ghana Water Company Limited (GWCL)
• Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG)
• …many more

Earn college scholarships for your high school achievements!

bluejetty:00062629:ios.description:
Earn college scholarships for your high school achievements!
With a free RaiseMe profile, you can earn no-essay scholarships for getting good grades in the classroom, taking the SAT and ACT, taking AP courses, playing sports, volunteering, and more.
Over two million students have earned scholarships with RaiseMe!
As seen in CNN Money, BuzzFeed, The New York Times, PBS NewsHour, TechCrunch, Fox Business, CNBC, and Just Kidding News!*
FEATURES:
• Follow your favorite colleges and discover new colleges that could be a great fit for you
• Add high school achievements, like good grades and extracurricular activities, to your Portfolio and instantly earn scholarships from colleges for each achievement
• See what you can do in high school to earn more from colleges
• Refer your friends to start earning college scholarships on RaiseMe
Already, 300+ colleges partner with RaiseMe to offer scholarships. Studying and doing your homework pays off, with colleges offering up to $1,500 for every A and $1,000 for every B. Earn up to $750 for each of your activities, like math club, speech and debate, or sports - even if you don’t plan to continue them in college. If you’re supporting your family, you can earn scholarships for that, too.
WHAT STUDENTS ARE SAYING: 
"I found RaiseMe helpful because I really didn't have any direction towards schools and the cost was a huge concern going into it. RaiseMe opened my eyes to schools that are willing to give back to their students and that was very important to me."
– Wynn P., Earned $54,000 from Susquehanna University
“RaiseMe was cleanly designed, easy to understand, and very rewarding right from the start. What I loved most about it was the fact that you could start earning micro-scholarships right away by simply entering in your grades and achievements.”
– Jacob N., Earned a Full Tuition Scholarship from University of Toronto 
“Raise me helped get me into a financial comfort zone that [allowed me to] focus on my studies and not worry constantly about how I’d be paying for school.”
– Sean V., Earned $10,000 from Florida International University 
Over 2,000,000 students have already used RaiseMe to find the right college and start earning scholarships in high school. Download our mobile app, create a RaiseMe profile, search for colleges, add in your grades and activities, and watch the scholarship dollars rack up - no essays or applications required.

bluejetty:00131817:ios.description:
Next Batter Up: Walk-Up Music
AI Voice Intros for Teams
Create custom walk-up and walkout song intros for every player on your baseball or softball team. Whether you're managing a Little League lineup, a travel team, or just running the show at a backyard game, Next Batter Up makes it fast and easy to hype up your players with music and voice intros, just like the pros.
Perfect for parents, coaches, and team DJs looking for powerful tools without the hassle.
Key Features:
Walk-up and walkout songs for baseball and softball teams
Use songs from Apple Music or import your own audio files directly from your device
Organize multiple teams with saved lineups
Add players and trim music with precision using scrubbing tools or manual time entry
Record custom voice intros or use AI-powered Text-to-Speech with 5 natural-sounding voices
Mix announcements with music using fade-out options
Upload your own intros and pair them with songs
Share intros and lineups with other coaches, parents, or team organizers
Save multiple lineup configurations and bench inactive players
Record and organize game-day announcements and reminders
Create playlists for warmups, post-game celebrations, or themed events
Who It's For:
Little League and T-ball teams
Travel ball, school teams, and adult leagues
Youth sports organizers, announcers, and DJs
Parents who want to create memorable moments at the plate
Coaches who want to stay organized and sound professional
Apple Music songs require an active Apple Music subscription and the Apple Music app. Songs must be downloaded to your device for use in the app. Alternatively, you can import your own audio files without a subscription.
Third-party music services such as Spotify, Amazon Music, and YouTube Music are not supported due to licensing restrictions.

bluejetty:00120466:ios.summary:

• Scales and Chords are learned fast by viewing them as a reference or challenging yourself in interactive games.

bluejetty:00120466:ios.description:
• Piano simulator app with interactive exercises to quickly learn scales, chords, songs and how to improvise in any key.
• Scales and Chords are learned fast by viewing them as a reference or challenging yourself in interactive games.
• Follow finger positioning to ensure excellent technique.
• Follow chord progression suggestions to create your own wonderful songs.
• Enjoy improvising with the features of backing tracks, metronome record and save.
• Highly configurable piano - multitouch, glissando, highlighting, note names (standard or solfege, resizable keyboard suitable for all devices and tablets.)
• Keep track of your progress as you impressively advance up the levels in the games.
• MIDI compatible
• With over 1000s of scales and chords in all keys this app is ideal for beginners, intemediates and advanced pianists.
***** Learn scales and chords *****
View quickly the notes in a key when you select a scale, mode or chord from the extensive list. 
Reinforced learning as you can play along with the scale or play then repeat..
Thoroughly learn the scale by playing ascending or descending on the piano.
Fully personalised as you can adjust the speed of the scale.
***** Scales and chords games ***** 
Test your scales knowledge fast with these interactive games. 
Play well to win stars and advance up the levels.
Advance quickly by creating your own level by specifying which scales and chords to focus on.
***** Improvise ***** 
Improvise with rhythm as you select backing track (mp3, wav) from your own music collection, or use the metronome.
Know exactly which notes to play by choosing a key and following the highlighted recommended notes.
Know exactly which chords to play within the key by following the recommendations.
Record and Save your favorite melody and play back your tune at a later date.
Send off your work, and see it featured in the best user songs game in a future version. 
***** Best Solos ***** 
Impressive your friends with your repertoire by learning some famous solos.
***** Recognition ***** 
The app will instantly recognise the chord from the notes you play.
***** Licks ***** 
Learning the essential licks from all genres in all keys is very useful for improvising.

bluejetty:00092979:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Portland area with the 94.9 HOM app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from 94.9 HOM Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the 94.9 HOM app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the 94.9 HOM app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00178616:ios.summary:

Armed Air Forces contains many details that have not been in a mobile ga
bluejetty:00178616:ios.description:
Armed Air Forces offers all-embracing combat flight simulation experience on mobile devices. Finally you can play PC quality combat game anywhere and anytime you wish.
Armed Air Forces contains many details that have not been in a mobile game before! 
Explore huge scenery with detailed cities and infrastructure in modern jet fighter aircraft or ww2 legendary fighter. 
Start a quick Dogfight to test your air combat skill or generate some ground targets to make a quick bombing mission. Or just take-off and enjoy free flight.
Become a military pilot and take an advantage of the unique opportunity to control modern fighter like F-16C, A-10C, F-35 Lightning II, F-22 Raptor, Mirage 2000C, AV-8B Harrier II, Mig-29K, Super Tucano or legendary BF-109 Messerchmitt, Eurofighter Typhoon, Ac-130 Gunship, Su-57 Felon, Jas Gripen, F-18C, F-14, F-15, B-2 with nuclear bomb and more... 
FEATURES:
• Simple mission generator for quick fight (enemy aircrafts, vehicles, buildings)
• Dogfight mode
• Record your flight mode (you can record your flight and use it later as AI plane for formation flights)
• Every aircraft features detailed 3D cockpit with working instruments, HUD or mfd displays. 
• Every aircraft carries real armament.
• Every aircraft has it's own physics, aerofoil and limits.
• Choose time of the day.
• VTOL flight modes for F-35 Lightning II and AV-8B Harrier II
• High-end graphics targeted for newest devices (also optimized for older devices)
• HOT or COLD start (from taxi)
• Carrier operations
• nuclear bomb
• continued development bringing updates with new content
----------------------------------------------
Please check Armed Air Forces facebook page for latest news and requests: facebook.com/armedairforce
----------------------------------------------
Feel free to contact me about your feedback, requests, issues, anything..
Don't forget to try also helicopter game AIR CAVALRY - COMBAT HELICOPTER SIMULATOR

bluejetty:00151540:ios.description:
Ready to up level your knitting skills, finish more projects successfully, and lean into your creativity in a bigger way? Welcome to the Knit Collage app.
The Knit Collage app is an online course and community hub for anyone who would like to learn new knitting and crochet skills within a community of people who share the same love of creative yarns, patterns and making things.
It’s part personalized coaching, part learning through live events with expert teachers - all within an inclusive, welcoming community. We make your journey easier. You'll learn new techniques that may have scared you, approach your making with confidence, and finish more projects as painlessly as possible.
It's a lot of fun and wildly creative too!
Whether you knit or crochet for added creativity and a stronger connection to self, for the beautiful finished projects or to feel a deeper sense of calm, it’s all wonderful and worthwhile.
Knit Collage is about helping you find and foster a making practice so that you experience these and so many more powerful benefits!
Inside our app, members can access our free events and our paid online courses and Creative Knitters membership.

"Is it over? Am I dead?” Eva asked herself when she came back to her senses. 
The surroundings seemed to be unfamiliar as she looked around. Eva was lying between the trees, on one hand, ocean waves hitting her legs from the other, and it was then she realized that she was on a deserted island somewhere between an endless ocean. 
Memories came running back and she recalled that she was on a boat with her boyfriend Tom and crew for a yacht trip when they got attacked by sea pirates. Eva got up and searched for more clues and yelled “TOM!!!!” to find him. 
After Eva’s failed attempt to locate her boyfriend, she realized that she was lost and on her own on this open-world island and needed to survive. She only knew one thing that the island was located somewhere on the lines of the Caribbean because that’s where they were headed. Help Eva to figure out island life in this Caribbean island survival game.
Are you ready to help a lost girl stranded on a vast mysterious island? Download this game now & start playing.

- Awesome background music to build interest in the game

listings.name: Last Survivor: Island is Home
listings.description:
"Is it over? Am I dead?” Eva asked herself when she came back to her senses. 
The surroundings seemed to be unfamiliar as she looked around. Eva was lying between the trees, on one hand, ocean waves hitting her legs from the other, and it was then she realized that she was on a deserted island somewhere between an endless ocean. 
Memories came running back and she recalled that she was on a boat with her boyfriend Tom and crew for a yacht trip when they got attacked by sea pirates. Eva got up and searched for more clues and yelled “TOM!!!!” to find him. 
After Eva’s failed attempt to locate her boyfriend, she realized that she was lost and on her own on this open-world island and needed to survive. She only knew one thing that the island was located somewhere on the lines of the Caribbean because that’s where they were headed. Help Eva to figure out island life in this Caribbean island survival game.

Are you ready to help a lost girl stranded on a vast mysterious island? Download this game now & start playing.

Last Survivor: Island is Home Features:

-High-quality graphics with smooth gameplay
-Open island shots with a realistic background environment
-Easy to use on-screen touch controls to get a quick hold of the game
-Island scenery angle rotation with swiping finger to have a look around
- Awesome background music to build interest in the game
-Free videos to watch to double the rewards

bluejetty:00126540:ios.description:
CodeMaster - Mobile Coding IDE
CodeMaster is a professional code browsing and development tool for iOS platforms, specifically designed for developers. It integrates multiple practical tools, supports multiple programming languages, and provides complete mobile code browsing, editing, management, and auxiliary development capabilities. Built-in local AI LLM delivers smart Q&A and code assistance even offline, turning your phone into a portable computing hub.
Features:
- File Management and Browser: Supports WiFi and WebDAV file transfer between devices, quick access to code files on mobile, supports cross-screen programming, and allows access to files on mobile via URL for code editing; intuitive directory management interface, supports preview of multiple file formats, and simultaneously supports viewing, editing, decompression, and compression of various documents.
- Code Editor: Integrates the VS Code core Monaco editor, delivering a desktop-level editing experience. Supports multi-language syntax highlighting, intelligent code completion and suggestions, and allows customization of multiple editor themes to suit usage habits.
- GitHub Integration: Search for open-source projects and specific code snippets, browse trending projects on the platform; supports browsing personal profiles and repositories, and enables direct editing of project code on mobile devices, seamlessly connecting to open-source development.
- Code Tools: Store and manage frequently used code snippets for quick insertion, built-in code comparison tool to contrast version differences, provide multi-language code execution environment and hundreds of code template libraries for various languages, enhancing development efficiency.
- Database Design: Built-in database design tool supporting MySQL and other types of database design; graphical display of data content, equipped with SQL editor, can directly write and execute MySQL statements, convenient database management.
- Remote Connection: Built-in SSH client to connect to remote servers, supports secure SFTP file transfer, allows direct management of remote server files from mobile devices, enabling remote operations anytime, anywhere.
►Unlimited Access Membership Subscription
- With this subscription, you can access all features in the application without restrictions.
- Subscription charges depend specifically on the selected subscription plan.
- When you confirm the purchase, your iTunes account will be charged.
- You can turn off auto-renewal 24 hours before the current subscription ends, otherwise it will auto-renew.
- The subscription fee will be deducted from your account 24 hours before the current subscription ends, depending on the package you choose.

Terms of Use: http://www.dazhuogroup.com/codemaster/terms_of_use_en.php

and use our customer support email for feedback

bluejetty:00100006:ios.description:
به بازی هیجان انگیز آقای سیبیل خوش اومدید! این بازی فکری فوق العاده جذاب، سرگرم کننده و اعتیادآور هست. در این بازی جدید زبان شیرین فارسی و کم حجم شما مرحله به مرحله با چالش های متفاوت و سخت تری روبرو میشوید و ذهن خود را محک میزنید. این بازی در ژانر بازی با کلمات و سبک جدول کلمات میباشد و حالا برای اولین بارمنتشر میشود! باشد که برگزیده ترین بازی فکری کلمه ای فارسی امسال شود.
در هر مرحله از این بازی فکری شما با تعدادی از حروف به هم ریخته روبرو هستید، حروف رو به هم متصل میکنید و از آنها کلماتی میسازید که در جدول متقاطع قرار میگیرند. در واقع با این بازی کلمه ای، شما ساعتها سرگرم ساختن کلمات و واژه های زبان فارسی میشوید. برای همین، این بازی برای افزایش دامنه لغات، تقویت حافظه و هوش، و افزایش سطح دانش بزرگسالان و جوانان که در جستجوی بازی های چالشی هستند، طراحی شده است. این بازی برای بزرگسالان (جوانان سابق) طراحی شده ست. در واقع این بازی در دورهمی ها خیلی مزه میدهد که همه رده های سنی با هم بازی کرده و خاطره سازی کنند.
علاوه بر گیم پلی جذاب این بازی، هر مرحله شامل تصاویر متنوع چشم نواز و آرامش بخش هست. موسیقی منحصر به فرد، انیمیشنهای متفاوت و شخصیتهای بامزه با دقت و وسواس خاصی طراحی شده ند تا شما از اوقات فراغت خود در این بازی نهایت لذت رو ببرید و سرگرمی مفیدی داشته باشید.
برای موفقیت در حدس کلمات نیاز به دایرﺓالمعارف یا دانشنامه ندارید اما راه هایی هست که میتوانید برای پیدا کردن واژه ها در بازی فکری کلمه ای آقای سیبیل ازشون استفاده کنید:
- شرکت در بازی کلمه روزانه چالش برانگیز: هر روز یک مرحله مخصوص اون روز آنلاک میشود. این بازی ها راه موفقیت و رسیدن به مراحل بیشتر را برای شما هموار میکنند.
- چرخاندن گردونه ی شانس: شامل جوایز خیلی با حال هست ولی کسی نمیتواند پیشبینی کند که کدام را برنده میشود.
- شرکت در رده بندی آنلاین: هر مرحله که پیشروی داشته باشید، یک پله به قله های صعود رده بندی نزدیکتر میشوید و در کنار باهوش ترین های بازی و کسانی قرار میگیرید که دایره ی لغات گسترده ای دارند. هر چی بیشتر کلمه حدس بزنید، صندوقتان پر لغت تر و رنکتان پر مدالتر. بله، مدال هم میگیرید!
- جوایز رندوم باکس: سه تا جعبه دارید که به شما کمک میکنند بتوانید از راهنماهای بیشتری استفاده کنید.
- استفاده از راهنماهای رنگارنگ در طول بازی: هر کدام یه ویژگی خاص خود را دارند که اینجا براتون اسپویل نمیکنیم!
- دعوت دوستان: میتوانید دوستانتان را هم به این بازی دعوت کنید، بازی یا مراحل را با دوستانتان به اشتراک بگذارید، از کمک دوستان و خانواده استفاده کنید و امتیاز بیشتری کسب کنید.
به قول بزرگترها “شنیدن کی بود مانند دیدن”. پس همین حالا بازی کم حجم آقای سیبیل را به رایگان دانلود کرده و از بازی لذت ببرید!

Searching for your new favorite sandwich? Our entire menu is just a few taps away, ready to browse. Need nutritional information? It’s easy to find on the go.

bluejetty:00045884:ios.description:
At The Farmers Bank, we like helping *everyone* grow. And with The Farmers Bank Mobile App, managing your finances has never been easier or more convenient. Bank securely with a community bank you can trust.
Features:
Card Controls: Misplaced your card? Temporarily lock it or report it lost/stolen instantly via the app for added peace of mind. Add a card to Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Samsung Pay. Update your travel schedule to allow worldwide access when you need it, and lock down your location when you don’t.
Mobile Check Deposit: Skip the branch visit and deposit checks on the go! Use your phone's camera to capture check images and securely deposit them into your account.
Personalized Alerts: Stay informed about your account activity with customizable alerts. Receive notifications for low balances, large transactions, and more.
Touch ID/Face ID: Enable biometric authentication for a faster and more secure login experience.
Easy Access: Whether you're traveling, at work, or relaxing at home, our user-friendly app ensures quick access to your accounts, putting your financial life at your convenience.
Secure Login: Your security is our top priority. Rest easy knowing that our mobile banking app utilizes the latest encryption technology, protecting your sensitive information from unauthorized access. 
Account Management: Keep track of your account balances, transaction history, and pending transactions, so you're always aware of your financial status. Review and save statements and notices from your device.
Bill Pay: No more missed payments or late fees! Schedule and manage your bill payments directly from the app, and enjoy peace of mind with timely reminders.
Transfer Funds: Move your money between accounts effortlessly. Transfer funds between your checking, savings, and other accounts within our bank.
ATM Locator: Find the nearest ATM within our extensive network. Access cash without paying extra fees at out-of-network ATMs.
Support: Our dedicated support team is just a call away. Experience top-notch customer service and resolve any queries promptly.

bluejetty:00175777:ios.description:
Multiplayer is finally coming!
This is the sequel to our first Unturned style zombie game for mobile, but this time it's multiplayer.
You'll be able to survive with your friends, build bases (or raid them) and battle other players (or befriend them).
The Outlands 2 is our low poly zombie survival game for mobile, heavily inspired by the outstanding hit game "Unturned", as well as other zombie & survival titles such as Dead Island, DayZ and even Rust.
The game currently includes:
- Multiplayer & Singleplayer modes
-Items and looting(weapons, food, medical)
-Guns
-Diseases system
-Different kinds of zombies
-A small map with locations to explore(Prison, Military bunkers and more!)
-Character customization
-Server creation
-Chat system
The game takes place in a post-apocalyptic world infected by zombies. Finding resources is essential to survival, as well as using them to craft useful items, or even a shelter. With this new multiplayer you might have to battle other players for those resources or join forces and cooperate.
We're still adding lots of updates. Our journey is uploaded to Youtube.
The Outlands 2 will feature:
-Item looting and scavanging
-Weapons and attachments(from ARs to RPGs)
-Health, hunger, thirst and the challenge to survive
-Various types of zombies
-Interesting NPCs(Bandits, etc)
-Vehicles(Cars, Helicopters & more)
-Unturned & DayZ style Inventory and Crafting systems
-Base building and raiding
-Public and private servers that anyone can create
-Voice and written chat
-Clans for players
-Skins
-Character customization
+More features (Feel free to leave your suggestions on our Discord or our Youtube channel)
Follow our journey here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCNiaZf4RwRpBlLj9fjpg6mg

bluejetty:00040018:ios.description:
iCheck Scan là ứng dụng quét mã vạch (Barcode) và mã QR Code giúp người dùng nhanh chóng tra cứu thông tin sản phẩm.
Các tính năng nổi bật:
• Quét mã vạch & QR Code: Chỉ cần 1 lần quét, người dùng có thể xem thông tin về sản phẩm.
• Chống hàng giả: Ứng dụng giúp phát hiện hàng thật – hàng giả thông qua QR Code chống giả do iCheck phát hành.
• So sánh giá: Tổng hợp và so sánh giá từ nhiều nguồn, giúp người dùng tìm được địa điểm trên thị trường.
• Đánh giá sản phẩm: Người dùng có thể xem và đóng góp nhận xét về sản phẩm, giúp cộng đồng người tiêu dùng có thêm thông tin để đưa ra quyết định mua sắm.
• Cảnh báo hàng giả: Cung cấp thông tin cảnh báo về các sản phẩm đã có thông báo hàng giả hoặc thu hồi theo quyết định của cơ quan chức năng, giúp người dùng tránh mua phải hàng kém chất lượng.
• Lưu sản phẩm: Cho phép người dùng lưu lại các sản phẩm đã quét để dễ dàng theo dõi.
• Tích điểm & đổi quà: Nhận điểm cho mỗi lần sử dụng iCheck Scan và đổi lấy nhiều phần quà hấp dẫn.
• Cập nhật liên tục: iCheck Scan thường xuyên cập nhật thông tin về sản phẩm, giá cả và các chương trình khuyến mãi từ các nhà bán lẻ.
Với iCheck Scan, người dùng có thể dễ dàng xem, tra cứu thông tin sản phẩm.
Tải ngay iCheck Scan để đảm bảo an toàn cho mỗi lần mua sắm của bạn!
Website: https://icheck.vn/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/icheckscan/

bluejetty:00156057:ios.description:

Torrent Cycle is a boutique indoor cycling experience where refined atmosphere meets powerful movement. From the moment you enter the studio, every detail is intentionally designed—low lighting, immersive sound, and rhythm-driven coaching that transforms each class into something deeper than a workout.

Ride to the beat. Build strength. Lose yourself in the flow. Our instructors lead with precision and purpose—knowing when to push you forward and when to draw you inward.
For those seeking more, Torrent+ is our signature fusion of cycling and strength training. This elevated format blends high-intensity intervals on the bike with focused off-bike strength work, delivering a balanced, full-body experience designed to build power, endurance, and control. It’s not just cross-training—it’s a complete evolution of the ride.

Seamless class booking and real-time schedule access
Rhythm-based cycling and Torrent+ strength classes
Expert instructors and intentionally curated programming
A connected, elevated fitness community
Effortless account management and class tracking
This is where fitness becomes ritual.
Where movement becomes expression.
Where strength is built—physically and mentally.
You don’t just show up.
You arrive with intention.
Clip in. Tune out the noise.
Ride at a higher level.

bluejetty:00077069:ios.description:
EPIC SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN
World War Polygon is a first-person shooter from WW2. When the world falls into the hell called war, it needs heroes who will stand against evil. World War Polygon allows you to be such a hero! The single-player campaign is full of epic moments, story cutscenes and heroic deeds. Become a brave soldier that will go from D-Day in Normandy, through the Battle of Bulge in Ardennes and finally to Berlin. Experience also the Eastern Front in the skin of a Soviet soldier that will have to endure the Battle of Stalingrad and fight in Eastern Europe.
Traditional single-player first-person shooter missions are accompanied by special tasks, like shooting planes with AA guns, defending your position with mortar fire, destroying tanks or bunkers with a bazooka and sniping enemies at long distances.
MULTIPLAYER AND DAILY MISSION MODES
The single-player campaign is simply epic, but World War Polygon can give you even more fun with its great optional modes - PvP multiplayer (4v4 Team Deathmatch, Allies vs. Axis) and Daily missions (you vs. hordes of zombies).
Have tons of fun shooting enemy soldiers, exterminating zombies or fighting against other players in Allies vs. Axis PvP modes.
FEATURES
• Single-player World War 2 FPS
• Easy and intuitive but completely customizable controls
• Story of heroes of WW2
• Heroic, epic, tragic or just funny story cutscenes
• Boss fights - encounter dangerous unique enemies and fight them!
• Epic polygon graphics
• Tons of weapons, consumables, grenades and other gear
• Customize your character loadout for each mission or multiplayer game - do you prefer sniper rifles, assault rifles, SMGs or shotguns?
• Upgrading weapons, vests, and helmets
• Real-time PvP battles
• Team Deathmatch Multiplayer mode - good old Allies vs. Axis PvP
• Leaderboard for competitive MP experience
• Daily missions - fight against endless hordes of German zombies

✅ Background Play : Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption. 
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights : Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.

Share the beauty of Sheikh Fares Abbad’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.

bluejetty:00127028:ios.description:
8mm is so realistic it was even used to film scenes in the Oscar-winning documentary Searching for Sugar Man!
We have established the de facto standard of real-time retro film emulation. It was featured by Apple in App of the Day, App of the Week, In the Director's Chair, App Store Essentials, etc.
8mm Vintage Camera captures the beauty and magic of old-school vintage movies right through your viewfinder. Dust and scratches, retro colors, flickering, light leaks, and even frame shake, all can be instantly added with a single tap of the finger.
SHOOT BOTH PHOTOS AND VIDEOS WITH SOPHISTICATED LIVE EFFECTS
• Combine effects of film color, halation, dust & scratch, film grain, and softening to create authentic old-school movies
• Adjust the strength of the effects to achieve your own unique visual style
• 10 Lenses (frame) effects: Projector, Vignetting, Light Leak, Color Fringing, Super 8, Screen, 16mm, Tube, color negatives of Super 8 and 16mm
• 21 Retro & Aged Films: 1920, Noir, 60s, 70s, Sakura, XPro, Siena, Pela, Indigo, Tuscan, Two-Color, 2-Strip, 3X, and monochromes
• Additional 21 filters that emulate real historical films and expired films - available with the 8mm Pro subscription
• Jitter Button to imitate real 8mm projectors frame shakes
• Sound Switch to add projector sound for extra authenticity or mute the video for a silent movie effect.
• Up to 4K 30fps with original unfiltered video recording on newer devices
A COMPACT EDITOR FOR MOVIE CREATION
- Apply film and frame effects to clips
- Trim video, pan & zoom photo
- Add a soundtrack from your music library
- Choose from 5 unique themes with matching titles, transitions
8MM PRO SUBSCRIPTION
- You can subscribe or make a one-time purchase for unlimited access to all current filters and future updates
- Start your subscription with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you’ll be charged an annual subscription fee
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions to turn auto-renew off

Turn your Smartwatch into the ultimate surf watch with Dawn Patrol
Dawn Patrol is a powerful surf tracker for Apple Watch and Garmin, giving you the tools to track, analyse and relive every surf session, right from your wrist.
Get today's Surfline forecast for your favourite beaches, track your waves and performance, and see your most important surf data at a glance. With beautiful smartwatch faces and glancable widgets, Dawn Patrol puts the information you need right where you need it.
The best part? The core Dawn Patrol experience is FREE for every surfer.
Upgrade to **Soul Surfer** to unlock our full suite of premium surf features.
FREE Features
* Track and analyse your surf sessions
* Record your surf workouts
* Automatically count your waves
* View every session on a map
* Track your top speed
* Beat your personal records
* Measure your wave time
* See your distance surfed per wave and across your entire session
* Track heart rate and calories burned through Apple Health and Activity
* Relive and share your surf sessions

Available with a monthly or yearly subscription.
Turn your smartwatch into a beautiful Surf Watch
- See the latest surf forecast for your favourite spots directly on your wrist.
Track your paddling
- Understand how much you paddle, how efficiently you paddle and how your paddling changes from session to session.
Advanced surf analytics
- Go deeper into your performance. Understand your speed, identify where you're gaining and losing speed, and learn how to generate more speed when you need it most.
Beautiful surf widgets
- Get surf conditions and forecasts at a glance with beautifully designed widgets for your phone and smartwatch.
Understand your local break
- Analyse your sessions alongside tide and wave conditions to understand how your local spot performs and when you surf it best.
Compare your boards
- Get deeper insights into your performance across different boards and see what works best for you.
Add photos to your sessions and boards
- Build a richer history of your surfing by adding your own photos to sessions and boards.
Get your Surfline Rewinds

bluejetty:00023410:ios.description:
REV YOUR ENGINES FOR NITRO JUMP RACING!
Get ready to put the pedal to the metal in the best racing game around! Trust us, we're playing it nonstop.
Are you ready to race? Nitro Jump Racing has got you covered. But it's not just a racing game: You can climb the rankings, conquer hills, and take part in intense player vs player action. Fast-paced gameplay, tons of customization options, and rewards waiting at every turn. Trust us, you'll love (and maybe even hate) every minute of it.
# MULTIPLAYER RACING ACTION
This game is all about competing against other players in high-octane multiplayer races. With up to four players on the track at once, the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. Whether you're racing for trophies or just trying to prove your skills, we’ve got something for everyone.
# CUSTOMISE EVERY CAR
Collect race rewards and upgrade your cars to make them your own. With more than 500 parts to choose from, you'll have no problem making your ride stand out on the track making it more fun to drive. Upgrade your car body, wheels, antennas and the perks. Unlock unique event content with Live Ops every week.
# RACE ACROSS 70 THRILLING TRACKS
Explore five amazing worlds and tackle more than 70 tracks. From cityscapes to mountain ranges, there's something for everyone in Nitro Jump Racing.
# LIMITED TIME EVENTS 
Get in on the action with limited time events where you can race against the clock or real opponents in 4 player multiplayer races. Earn amazing and exclusive rewards while you're at it.
# INSANE 3D GRAPHICS 
If you thought racing games looked good before, just wait until you see Nitro Jump Racing. The cars are sleek and detailed, the environments are stunning, and everything looks absolutely incredible in 3D. You'll feel like you're right in the middle of the action.
# NEW CONTENT ADDEDD ALL THE TIME 
We're always adding new stuff to Nitro Jump Racing to keep things fresh and exciting. Unlocked all 21 cars to drive in races? Expect new cars, and customization options every season. Keep an eye out for updates and never run out of new content to enjoy.
Bored of slow-paced hill climbing games? Not here! Nitro Jump Racing is all about fast-paced racing action. Download for free now and don't miss out on all the new content added in periodic updates. Start your engines and let's race!
PLEASE NOTE! Our game is free to download and play, however, if you like it and want to support its development you can purchase game items for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. Also, under our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, you must be at least 13 years of age to play or download NITRO JUMP RACING.
Having problems? Please let us know at support@byss.mobi
Join our #discord https://discord.gg/vTD7Mxf3s7

bluejetty:00076081:ios.description:
Svegliare is the alarm clock for people who actually need to get up. Solve a mission to turn it off, and it keeps coming back until you do.
On iOS 26 and later, Svegliare uses Apple's alarm system, so it rings loudly even when your iPhone is on Silent or in a Focus.
WAKE UP FOR REAL
• Puzzle & mission alarms: math, tap, shake, steps and more
• Chain several missions in one alarm (Premium)
• Ring guard: close the app or swipe the alert away and the alarm rings again until the mission is done
• Loud, gradual or extreme sounds, music, or your own recorded voice
ALARMS FOR EVERY LIFE
• Repeat – daily routines for work, school and the gym
• Pattern – rotating shifts for nurses, security staff and anyone off a 9-to-5
• Timezone – set the time where you'll be; Svegliare converts it
• Destination – a GPS alert when you near your stop on a train, bus or flight
• Medication – dose times for pills and supplements
• Never Forget – a reminder when you leave a place without something important
• Quick, Single and Bunch alarms, Dream Journal, widgets, Light and Dark themes, iPhone and iPad
FREE & PREMIUM
Basic alarms plus Math (Easy/Medium) and Tap missions are free. Premium unlocks every mission type, Hard and Random, and multiple missions per alarm. Choose a subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices vary by region. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy Policy: https://appreator.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00070777:ios.description:
Nova versão da Sueca Portuguesa! Gráficos melhorados e Inteligência Artificial reconstruída do zero para ser ainda mais competitiva!
A Sueca também é conhecida como Bisca ou Briscola é um jogo de cartas muito jogado nos países de língua portuguesa como Brasil, Portugal e Angola. Também é muito popular entre a diáspora portuguesa em França, na Suiça, Canadá e Estados Unidos da América.
A Sueca é um tradicional jogo de trunfo, em que tens de seguir o naipe da primeira carta posta na mesa, mas se não tiveres nenhuma carta do naipe, podes levar tudo com uma carta de trunfo! Joga e sente a expectativa, emoção e surpresa de saber se o teu Às ou Manilha vai passar!
Joga offline - não precisa de Internet! - contra o computador e tem acesso a estatísticas sobre o teu desempenho. Compete em campeonatos simulados em locais pelo mundo fora onde o Português é um das línguas oficiais. Acumula moedas ao derrotar os teus oponentes e contrata parceiros mais inteligentes. Diversão garantida com 35 conquistas para alcançar!

Command over 200 monstrous Phobies, each brimming with personality, bite, and twisted charm, and outwit opponents in tactical, turn-based arenas inspired by the odd corners of your subconscious.
Whether you’re sending a creepy crawler across molten tiles, launching nightmares into the abyss, or hatching galaxy-brain combos, every match becomes a deliciously devious duel of wits.
A TCG With Depth, Style, and a Wicked Imagination
Easy to learn but endlessly strategic, Phobies blends tactical board control with card-collecting progression. Summon Phobies with unique abilities—from teleporters and lobbers to healers, silencers, terraformers, and more. Build clever synergies, control the battlefield, and claim panic points before your opponent does.
And with new Phobies arriving regularly, there’s always something fresh to fear.
A World Crafted From Your Worst (and Best) Nightmares
Fight across whimsical, eerie, and inventive battleboards that challenge your tactics at every turn. Hazards, traps, and shifting terrain create countless opportunities to outplay, outmaneuver, and outthink your rivals. This is strategy at its most sinister—and its most fun.
Climb, Collect, Compete
Unlock weekly and seasonal rewards as you rise through the Mount Ego leaderboards. Level up your favorite Phobies to strengthen your roster, and expand your collection through packs, events, challenges, and more.
Battle Your Frenemies (and Millions More)
Play casually or competitively in multiple modes:
• Asynchronous PvP — Take turns at your own pace across multiple simultaneous matches.
• Arena Mode — Jump into real-time battles for fast, frantic, strategic showdowns.
• Challenge Mode — Puzzle-style PvE missions that sharpen your wits and test your creativity.
• Friend Duels — Prove dominance over your friends, coworkers, siblings, or sworn rivals.
With cross-platform play, your Phobies follow you anywhere—whether you’re commanding nightmares from your PC or unleashing chaos on the go.
Are You Brave Enough to Face Your Fears?
Build your ultimate roster, master the art of psychological warfare, and dive into a world where your imagination—and your fears—run wild.
Download Phobies today and enter the mind… if you dare.
COLLECT AND EVOLVE YOUR FEARS
• Unlock and upgrade over 200 Phobies inspired by classic, bizarre, funny, and terrifying fears
• Build powerful combinations and discover unexpected synergies
TACTICAL HORROR STRATEGY
• Hex-based gameplay with environmental hazards, control points, and positional tactics
• Use terrain—from pits to lava to pressure plates—to outsmart your foes
SHARPEN YOUR SKILLS
• Practice mode to refine strategies
• PvE challenges that offer puzzles, objectives, and clever brainteasers
FIGHT ANYONE, ANYWHERE
• Asynchronous PvP for strategic play at your pace
• Real-time Arena Mode for fast, intense battles
• Cross-platform: play seamlessly on PC and mobile
ENDLESS EVENTS & REWARDS
• Weekly leagues and seasonal updates
• Limited-time events with unique experiences
• Daily rewards, giveaways, quests, milestones, and more
Terms of Service: https://www.phobies.com/terms-of-service/ 
Privacy Policy: https://www.phobies.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00063531:ios.description:
Welcome to the Indie Goes Oracle Cards collection! In this app, you will find a large collection of oracle decks, covering many themes. If you already used our single apps, we recommend switching to this app instead. 
Key features:
- All your decks in one place
- Exclusive decks only available in this app!
- Get unlimited access to each deck for 7 days
- Explore different types of spreads
- Save your readings to a journal for further reference
- Get your "Card of the day", drawn from our decks collection
- Decks take 50% less space on your device, compared to multiple single apps
- Stay updated about new releases and sales
- Improved sharing and email features. 
- If you already purchased our single apps, you will be able to unlock the decks in this app for free!
Indie Goes is a French studio founded by Frédéric Calendini in 2012. We believe that in a fast-changing world, people need access to meaningful and inspiring experiences that help them connect with a deeper part of themselves. By making beautiful and uplifting content more accessible, we hope to help everyone find inspiration and follow their own inner guidance.
There are so many talented authors with wonderful things to share, and our joy is to help them reach a wider audience through high-quality and engaging projects. We strongly believe that technology and spirituality are not incompatible. That is why we create software — but software with a soul.
We hope you enjoy our creations, because they are truly made with love. Thank you!
Decks included:
Lessons of the Soul Oracle by Frédéric Calendini

bluejetty:00022390:ios.name: Fonts: Aesthetic Font Keyboard
bluejetty:00022390:ios.summary: Tired of typing in the basic system font? It's time to add style to your text and have friends amazed with eye-catching fonts and symbols. Fonts Keyboard lets you easily type in unique fonts perfect for Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, Messages
bluejetty:00022390:ios.description:
Tired of typing in the basic system font? It's time to add style to your text and have friends amazed with eye-catching fonts and symbols. Fonts Keyboard lets you easily type in unique fonts perfect for Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok, Messages, WeChat, Facebook, WhatsApp, and all other iPhone apps. If you wish to style your keyboard with custom images and colors, Fonts Keyboard lets you create your own keyboard design or select from dozens of keyboard themes. It's time to ditch the default keyboard and unlock a new world of aesthetic fonts, symbols, and text!
GROW YOUR SOCIAL MEDIA
Fonts Keyboard helps your text stand out. On social media, followers won’t stop asking how you have such stunning text; on messages, it livens up your chats by adding style and fun; on reminders and notes, you can design the perfect to-do lists; and on any other app you can think of, Fonts Keyboard lets you write in aesthetic text.
DOZENS OF FONTS & SYMBOLS
Type in dozens of fonts like Outline, Cursive, Manga, Clouds, Comic, Gothic, or make your own style. Also, enjoy hundreds of unique symbols ranging from hearts, smilies, animals, religious symbols, and so much more!
WORKS IN SECONDS
Setting up the Fonts Keyboard is easy, there are just 3 quick steps to follow. Then you’re all set to start typing in stylish fonts on the Fonts Keyboard, directly in any app you wish.
KEYBOARD THEMES
Spice up your keyboard with custom backgrounds and colors. Whether you like simple pastel colors, kittens, sunsets, galaxies, beaches, or countless other options, there’s a theme to suit everyone.
PRIVACY-FIRST
Privacy is our top priority, which is why we collect and store as little personal information as possible. We cannot and will never access the text you type. Learn more in our privacy policy & terms of use: https://mmappsinc.com/fonts-privacy.
FREE
Enjoy Fonts Keyboard for free, with optional upgrades to further boost your experience. If you decide to go Pro, enjoy a free 3-day trial, and then it renews at USD$4.99/week or USD$24.99/year.

bluejetty:00136370:ios.description:
~ Featured by Apple, 9to5Mac, and Macrumors ~
~ “A+ Apps for Students”, “Apps We Love Right Now”, “23 Apps for 2023”, and more from Apple
School Assistant by Sun Apps is a simple but powerful school planner app. It allows you to quickly and easily keep track of your homework and tests, manage your schedule, save all your class info, quickly access saved websites, and more.
First, as a student myself, I know how hard it can be to pay for these types of apps. So, School Assistant is 100% free: no subscriptions, no paywalls, no premium features, and no ads! There is a tip jar if you feel like supporting, though (these are the in-app purchases the App Store shows).
Schoolwork:
– Manage your upcoming assignments and tests
– Sort by due date, class, category, alphabetically, or manually
– Add a related class, due date, links, and notes
– Add Subtasks to your schoolwork to keep track of large assignments
– Schedule reminders
– Highlight upcoming and overdue schoolwork
– Keep an entire archive of your completed schoolwork
– View your upcoming schoolwork and classes right from your Home Screen / Desktop with Widgets 
Schedule:
– Keep track of your classes for every day
– Add associated teacher and room information (or, add a link for online classes)
– Automatically switch days based on the day of the week
– Automatically switch between two weeks (great for A/B week schedules)
– Manually switch between up to ten weeks
– See your current class and next class on the Dashboard and with Widgets
Classes:
– A dedicated place to manage all your class info
– Store your teacher’s name and email
– Store a title, class code, links, and notes for each class
– Assign an icon to each class, which also shows in Schoolwork
Siri AI and Shortcuts:
– Ask Siri about your schoolwork and classes
– Create and modify your schoolwork with Siri
– Ask Siri about on-screen content in the app
– Access, create, and modify your schoolwork and classes from the Shortcuts app
Apple Watch App:
– Super quick access to your most important information
– View your Schoolwork, automatically sorted into assignments and tests
– View your Schedule for any day
– View your current and next classes, and how long you have left
– Set a custom theme color to match your Watch, band, or outfit
– Designed for quick interactions 
Other features:
– Save website bookmarks for quick and easy access right in the app
– Set a custom accent color
– Theme the entire app with a color of your choosing
– Over 20 app icon choices 
– Liquid Glass design
– Full and automatic data syncing over iCloud
– Tight iOS and iPadOS integration with support for features like Slide Over and Split View, iPad cursor, keyboard shortcuts, system sidebars, Home Screen widgets, Dynamic Text, multi-window support, and full iPhone Duo support
– Support for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro
– Designed with quick and easy usability in mind
– Full support for Dark, Tinted, and Clear Home Screen modes

bluejetty:00114619:ios.summary:

A daily memory album that builds itself. Find out what your dog is thinking from a single photo. Personalized advice based on breed and personality. AI portraits yo
bluejetty:00114619:ios.description:
Your dog is one of a kind. BarkOS is the first app built around that idea.
A daily memory album that builds itself. Find out what your dog is thinking from a single photo. Personalized advice based on breed and personality. AI portraits you will actually want to send to your friends. Not for dogs in general. For yours.
A DAILY MEMORY, A MONTHLY MASTERPIECE
Take one photo a day. That is it. BarkOS organizes them into a monthly album and compiles a 30-second video montage at the end of each month. One second per day. A month of your dog's life in half a minute. Start today and thank yourself in 30 days.
WHAT YOUR DOG IS ACTUALLY THINKING
Snap a photo. Get an instant mood read. The quick result is fun, shareable, and surprisingly accurate. Go deeper with the full body language scan: eyes, ears, posture, tail, mouth. What each signal means and why your dog is feeling that way. You will learn something new about a dog you have had for years.
ADVICE THAT ACTUALLY KNOWS YOUR DOG
Build a profile with your dog's breed, personality, and quirks. Get back tips and guidance tailored to the dog you actually have. Not the breed in general. Not a Google search. Specific, personal, and surprisingly accurate. Like having a dog expert who has actually met your dog.
PORTRAITS YOU WILL ACTUALLY SHARE
Upload a photo, pick a style, and watch AI turn your dog into something worth sending. Renaissance paintings, watercolors, pop art, and more. Nine styles, three new portraits every day. The kind of photos your friends will not stop asking about.
EVERYTHING WORKS TOGETHER
The daily photo feeds the album and the mood reader. The profile shapes your advice. The portraits give you something to share and something to keep. BarkOS is not four separate tools. It is one app that revolves around your dog.
Download BarkOS. Take your first photo. The rest builds itself.
Disclaimers
BarkOS is for entertainment purposes only and not a substitute for professional veterinary care. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for health or behavioral concerns about your pet.
BarkOS requires a subscription for full access to features. Subscription details, auto-renewal information, and pricing are available in-app prior to purchase. Some features and content may be available only in selected subscription plans. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store settings.
Terms of Service:
https://www.trybarkos.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00017784:ios.description:
Easily and securely access your Credit Union of Colorado Visa credit and debit cards anytime, anywhere all from your phone! This app is free to download and is a great way to put more card controls in your hands.
Once you’ve created a secure username, passcode and have loaded your Credit Union of Colorado card, you’ll have access to:
• Put your card in the mobile wallet and start using it today. No need to wait for a plastic card in the mail.
• Change your card pin right from your phone.
• Turn your card on/off for enhanced security.
• Set dollar limits or block certain purchase types.
• Set up and manage your account alerts to help you monitor your account activity.
• Check your balance and recent transaction history.
• Use ATM locator.
All Credit Union of Colorado debit and credit cards are available for upload to the app. When you download the CUofCO Cards app, you will create a username and password for login. Use this app in addition to the Credit Union of Colorado app to get the most benefit out of your card. 
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This pertains to the use of the Location Match feature.

bluejetty:00026568:ios.name: Bend: Stretching & Flexibility
bluejetty:00026568:ios.summary: Bend is the simple, affordable way to make stretching & movement a part of your daily routine. With over 15 million users, our quick & convenient routines help improve your flexibility and maintain your natural range of motion as you get ol
bluejetty:00026568:ios.description:
Bend is the simple, affordable way to make stretching & movement a part of your daily routine. With over 15 million users, our quick & convenient routines help improve your flexibility and maintain your natural range of motion as you get older. We offer hundreds of exercises and easy-to-follow routines designed for all ages and experience levels. It's never too early to start stretching everyday!
“It’s like having a personal stretching coach in my pocket.” — The New York Times
“I could never stick to my stretching routine. Then I found this app.” — Wirecutter
STRETCHING IS IMPORTANT
A simple, daily stretching routine can have a huge impact on your quality of life. Every time you stretch, you invest in your long-term health and longevity.
Stretching benefits include:
⊕ Increase flexibility & mobility in your muscles and joints
⊕ Prevent and relieve pain in your lower back, neck, hips, shoulders and more
⊕ Reduce the risk of injury during outdoor activities and sports
⊕ Improve sleep quality and energy throughout the day
⊕ Improve posture and strengthen your core
⊕ Reduce stress & anxiety
⊕ Improve athletic performance
⊕ Improve circulation and blood flow
⊕ Accelerate muscle recovery
⊕ Improve balance & coordination
⊕ And more!
YOUR BODY'S FAVORITE APP
Bend offers dozens of daily stretching & mobility routines for every occasion.
⊕ “Wake Up”
Designed to maintain your body’s natural mobility and range of motion. Simple, quick, convenient, and effective, you can do it anytime, anywhere, everyday.
⊕ “Posture Reset”
Specifically designed to improve your posture with seated stretches that can correct habitual posture problems by increasing flexibility in the shoulders, back, and neck.
⊕ “Full Body”
Focused on improving overall flexibility, with more than 20 stretching exercises and poses that target key muscles and joints throughout your entire body.
⊕ “Sleep”
Gentle, long-hold stretches designed to help you unwind and de-stress after a long day at work through better quality of sleep, which is made possible by relieving muscle tension and relaxing the body.
⊕ “Expert”
Advance group of stretching exercises and yoga poses that cover all major muscle groups and extremities. Flexibility and range of motion can be improved significantly with their more complex movements.
⊕ "Hips"
Open and unlock tight hips with deep, focused stretches designed to improve hip flexibility and undo hours of inactivity from sitting at a desk, in a car, or on the couch.
⊕ "Hamstrings"
Improve hamstring flexibility with subtle stretches designed to reduce hamstring tightness and relieve pressure on the knees, pelvis, and lower back.
⊕ "Lower Back"
Reduce and prevent lower back pain with gentle stretches designed to increase flexibility in the lower back, pelvis, and hip flexors.
⊕ "Isometric"
isometric exercise routines that build muscle, strength, balance, and range of motion in targeted areas through static muscle contraction.
⊕ And more!
CREATE YOUR OWN
Create your own custom stretching routine suited to your specific needs. Choose from hundreds of stretches, yoga poses, and isometric exercises in our library.
EASY-TO-USE
Bend makes stretching simple. We use custom illustrations and a timer to guide you through each routine. Every stretch has detailed instructions, information about its benefits, and specific things to be cautious about! 
STREAKS & ANALYTICS
Our dashboard displays your streaks and analytics to track your progress and you can set reminders to help motivate you to stretch every day. Check your Bendometer as a quick way to see how consistent you’ve been stretching over the last few weeks.
APPLE HEALTH
Bend integrates with the Health app, giving users the option to sync health information and activity with Apple Health.
FEEDBACK & SUPPORT
If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to contact us at hello@bend.com!
LEGAL
Terms of Use: https://bend.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bend.com/privacy

bluejetty:00015037:ios.description:
Fasten your seatbelts, get your popcorn ready, and don’t forget your cotton candy, the countdown is starting, you're about to enter the mind-blowing city of Bibi.Pet, 3,2,1 …
Welcome!!
In this adventure the super friendly Bibi.Pet work with numbers, for a fun learning experience specially for children.
Imaginative architects, weird builders, brave fire fighters, acrobatic skaters, and many more characters are waiting for you, all set for 1,2,3, because everything is possible with numbers!! 
It is like standing in the middle of a huge playground, you'll be surprised at how many things you can discover and learn in this extraordinary metropolis, fun has no limits with Bibi.Pet!
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Characteristics:
- Numbers in 9 Languages
- First approach to numbers and counting
- Writing numbers intuitively
- Recognizing digits and ordering numbers
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- WRITING NUMBERS ---
The first step is to recognize the numbers and learn how to write them, following the trails left by Bibi.Pet learning will be fun and natural.
--- COUNTING ---
Recognizing the correct sequence of numbers is fundamental when children are learning to count, through simple games and with the help of different sizes, children can develop their first mathematical skills: counting, ordering and forming sets.
--- MATCHING A DIGIT TO ITS QUANTITY ---
The number is always connected to a quantity and learning how they are matched is essential when studying numbers. This is also true for the number zero, where the concept of empty or absence has to be introduced in a simple and intuitive way.
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colours and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

bluejetty:00144735:ios.name: Wedding photo app by Wedbox
bluejetty:00144735:ios.summary:
Wedbox – Your Ultimate Wedding Day Companion
Your wedding day deserves more than just memories. With Wedbox, you can collect every photo and video from your wedding or special event effortlessly. Guests can join with a simple QR code, and
bluejetty:00144735:ios.description:
Wedbox – Your Ultimate Wedding Day Companion
Your wedding day deserves more than just memories. With Wedbox, you can collect every photo and video from your wedding or special event effortlessly. Guests can join with a simple QR code, and all your memories are safely stored in one shared album. Upload, download, and enjoy every photo and video in original quality — with no storage limits.
Everything in One Beautiful Place
Create a shared album where everyone — guests and photographers alike — can contribute. Capture every laugh, tear, and dance move from every angle. Even guests who cannot attend the event can share their photos and videos.
How You Can Use Wedbox
- A selfie box for your party, capturing fun and spontaneous moments
- A way to collect photos and videos from your guests’ phones
- A way for your photographer to upload their professional photos with an invitation link
Powerful Features You’ll Love
1. Unlimited storage – 
Save unlimited wedding photos and videos without worrying about space.
2. Full quality – 
Every picture and video stays clear and sharp and in the original quality.
3. Live slideshow on big screen – 
Show your memories as they happen! Guests upload photos and videos, and they appear instantly in a beautiful slideshow at your wedding or party.
4. Instant access with QR codes – 
Share your wedding album with your guests with a simple scan of a QR code. 
5. Time Schedule – 
Sort and categorize your photos and videos like rehearsal dinner, wedding day schedule, reception, and ceremony, making it simpler to capture, collect, and share cherished memories.
6. Fun and interactive Photo Booth – 
Set up a light-hearted photo booth at your reception, complete with funny props, to entertain your guests and capture joyful memories.
7. Likes and comments – 
Guests can react and share their happy comments right in the photos and videos.
8. Perfect for bachelor or bachelorette events – 
Utilize Wedbox to capture memories from pre-wedding events, and use the memories to create a photo book and give a heartfelt gift for the wedding couple to cherish.
9. Multilingual Support – 
Wedbox is available in 18 languages, so all your international guests can easily use the app in their own language.
10. Closed and secure forum – 
Only invited guests and photographers can access the album.
11. Easy photo/video uploads – 
Upload via computer or directly from phones, keeping the quality intact.
12. Retain your rights – 
You keep full control of all your photos and videos.
Why Couples Love Wedbox
Because your wedding memories shouldn’t be limited — in quality, space, or time. With Wedbox, you can keep every moment in its original beauty, as long as your subscription is active.
Start your Wedbox journey today and see why thousands of couples trust us to preserve their most meaningful memories.
Download now and celebrate your love story — beautifully, securely, and without limits.
- We use Apple's standard terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy policy: https://wedbox.com/pages/privacy-policy
- Terms and conditions: https://wedbox.com/pages/terms

bluejetty:00025610:ios.name: Age of Strategy
bluejetty:00025610:ios.summary:
Age of Strategy is a free pixely turn based Strategy Game set in the age of empires and knights, vikings and samurais, winged hussars and Templars and many more!
If you find any problem, write me so i can fix immediately!
Loads of campaig
bluejetty:00025610:ios.description:
Age of Strategy is a free pixely turn based Strategy Game set in the age of empires and knights, vikings and samurais, winged hussars and Templars and many more!
If you find any problem, write me so i can fix immediately!
Loads of campaigns, skirmishes and multiplayer games are waiting for you!
NOT a pay to win game! The in-app payment option is for speeding up progress.
The game is a retro-like 16-bit game, so it is not pretty and it has no fancy animations. This is a pure gameplay-oriented turn based strategy.
***FEATURES***
- More than 500 Campaign maps to pass (Historical ones too! eg: Battle of Troy and so on)
- More than 140 Skirmish maps to fight on
- More than 350 units and buildings
- More than 120 technologies to invent
- Rewarding system: Collecting stars on each map (Based on your performance) will grant you gems used for unlocking new troops or buildings!
- Spell Upgrades: Do you find a map too hard? You can ease the difficulty with various spells that can be bought with gems! (Used on consumption)
- Battle against AI on skirmish maps like in classic strategy games!
- Battle against or with real players worldwide!
- Upgrades section containing hundreds of new units, technologies and buildings openable with gems (Including some fun units)!
***UNIT REQUESTS***
There are many requests for new and unique units (eg. historical heroes), I am pretty open to this since it's pretty easy to implement a new unit. Please join the
forum, post there the idea and i will make it!
***IF YOU INSTALL IT***
- Please be kind with the rating, since the developer is me alone, and i plan to fix every problem and bring in new things! (eg. mapeditor, unit editor)
- Feel free to send me any suggestions concerning any part of the game (Gameplay, units, unit properties, new unit suggestions, graphics etc...)
- If you would like to take part in creating this game (eg. maps, graphics, translation, ideas) send me an email and/or join the forums/discord!
***FOR A START***
1. Go to Single Player (Or skirmish)
2. Play a map
3. If you have any, send me suggestions!
4. If not, enjoy the game!
Have fun!

bluejetty:00062675:ios.description:
Simple but powerful Japanese-English, English-Japanese dictionary app. 
The app's features include:
● Over 170.000 dictionary entries with readings and english meaning
● Over 6.500 kanji characters with stroke order
● Over 730.000 Japanese names, place names and institution names
● Over 147.000 example sentences with translation
● Instantaneous search results
● Character input by kanji and kana handwriting recognition. Recognition algorithm can handle wrong stroke order and small mistakes.
● When multiple similar characters are found, you don't need to redo drawing after each character - just long press to see a preview
● Search by kanji radicals (for example 日 and 月 will find 明)
● Wildcard search - "*" can replace any number of characters and "?" can replace any single character. Works both with English and Japanese words.
● Search by kanji, kana and romaji - "じしょ", "じsho" and "jisho" will give the same search results
● Kanji lists by JLPT level and school grade (1 - 6)
● Multiple word lists divided by subject, grammatical function, JLPT level and more
App contains an in-app purchase that allows you to:
● Screen customization – reorder word and kanji sections to keep the information you care about immediately visible
● Extended flashcard content – choose what appears on flashcards, including conjugations, examples, related kanji, and readings after the flip
● Custom theming – personalize the app’s color theme more freely

bluejetty:00084203:ios.description:
HyperMax app gives you choices when it comes to shopping for groceries, electronics, household items, appliances, personal care, beauty, and more. Choose from a very large variety of fresh foods from all around the world that are ready to be delivered to your doorstep.
Instant Shopping
Enjoy instant shopping with just a couple of taps on your smartphone with the HyperMax app. You find it, you love it, and you buy it.
Fresh Groceries & Organic Food
If you don’t have the time to go running around for the item you need, you can get it on the app. Whether you are looking for vegetables, fruits, meat, chicken or anything else, it is available for purchase. And you can also buy them in bulk.
If you want to buy electronics, you can read all the specifications and features on the HyperMax app and pick the one that suits your budget and needs.
Nutritional Information for All Foods
Shopping for food online is as easy as buying it from the store. All our food products have nutritional values displayed under them on the app, so just like you read through these before you buy groceries in the supermarket, you can do the same with online shopping on our app.
A Wide Range of Products
We offer a wide spectrum of products from A to Z, starting from fruits and vegetables picked up fresh for you, food cupboard items and organic products, beauty products from well-known brands, fashion that keeps you warm in winter and light in summer, as well as health, personal care, fitness & wellness items. We also offer baby care products like wipes and diapers and necessities to raise your angels.
Earn Loyalty Points
With HyMax membership you can earn and redeem points on every purchase.
Benefits we deliver to you:
- Mobile shopping has never been easier with our app designed for your ease of use
- Create your shopping list with the HyperMax app instead of writing it down
- Get your grocery delivered in 60 min using Express service on eligible items.
- Locate all HyperMax stores near you with our store locator
Buying your groceries has never been easier! Download the HyperMax app today.
